(d) चुकीचे आहे — ISIS ने त्यांचा स्वतंत्र याजिदी धर्म अपसमर्थ म्हणून लक्ष्य केले, ख्रिश्चन धर्मातून घेतलेल्या घटकांमुळे नाही.

questions.text: 2022 - 23 च्या केंद्रीय अर्थसंकल्पात अर्थमंत्री निर्मला सितारामन यांनी क्रिप्टोकरन्सीवर किती टक्के कर लावण्याची घोषणा केली आहे ?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. अर्थसंकल्प 2022-23 ने आभासी डिजिटल मालमत्तेच्या (cryptocurrency) उत्पन्नावर 30% कर, अधिक surcharge आणि cess लागू केला; हस्तांतरणावरील 1% TDS वेगळी तरतूद — मुख्य दराशी गोंधळू नका.

questions.text: कोणत्या रेसिंग ड्रायव्हर ने मार्च 2022 मध्ये झालेली सौदी अरेबिया ग्रँड प्रिक्स स्पर्धा जिंकली ?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. 2022 सौदी अरेबियन ग्रां प्री (जेद्दा, मार्च 2022) Max Verstappen ने Charles Leclerc ला मागे टाकून जिंकली — त्या परीक्षेच्या काळातील महत्त्वाची क्रीडा चालू घडामोड.

questions.text:
पुलवामा क्षेत्रा विषयी पुढीलपैकी कोणते विधान अयोग्य आहे ?
(a) या भागाला काश्मीरचे "तांदळाचे भांडार" असे म्हणतात.
(b) वेशू आणि झेलम नदी पुलवामा मधून वाहतात.
(c) अहरबाल धबधबा आणि अवंतीश्वर मंदीर ही पुलवामामधील प्रसिद्ध पर्यटन क्षेत्रे आहेत.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D — एकही विधान चुकीचे नाही. पुलवामाला काश्मीरचे तांदूळ कट्टा म्हणतात, वेशू (वेशाव) आणि Jhelum या जिल्ह्यात वाहतात, आणि अहरबल धबधबा व अवंतीश्वर मंदिर प्रसिद्ध पर्यटनस्थळे आहेत.

questions.text:
योग्य पर्याय निवडा.
(a) त्रिनिदाद आणि टोबॅगोच्या डिओन लेंडर यांचे जानेवारी 2022 मध्ये कार दुर्घटनेत निधन झाले.
(b) लंडन ऑलिम्पीक, 2012 मध्ये डिओन लेंडर यांनी कांस्यपदक मिळविले होते.
(c) डिओन लेंडर हे बुद्धीबळपटू होते.
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. Trinidad चा धावपटू Deon Lendore जानेवारी 2022 मध्ये अपघातात मृत्यू पावला; London 2012 मध्ये 400 m relay bronze — (c) त्याला बुद्धिबळ खेळाडू म्हणणे स्पष्ट चुकीचे.

questions.text: कोणत्या राज्याने बॉलीवूड अभिनेता संजय दत्त ला आपल्या सुवर्ण जयंती समारंभासाठी ब्रँड ॲम्बेसेडर म्हणून करारबद्ध केले आहे ?
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तराप्रमाणे पर्याय D. बॉलीवूड अभिनेता Sanjay Dutt यांना अरुणाचल प्रदेशाच्या स्वर्णजयंती (50 वर्षे राज्य) साजर्यासाठी ब्रँड राजदूत म्हणून नियुक्त केले — 2022 चालू घडामोड.

questions.text: पुढीलपैकी संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघाच्या कोणत्या विशेषीकृत संघटनेने तिच्या स्थापनेची 100 वर्षे पूर्ण केली आहेत ?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. International Labour Organization (ILO) 1919 मध्ये Versailles कराराखाली स्थापन; 2019 मध्ये 100 वर्षे पूर्ण — WHO, FAO, UPU या वेळापत्रकाशी जुळत नाहीत.

questions.text:
खालील विधाने लक्षात घेऊन योग्य पर्याय निवडा :
(a) पद्मश्री पुरस्कार प्राप्त मिलिना साल्वीनी यांचा जन्म इटलीमध्ये झाला होता.
(b) त्या प्रख्यात कथकली नृत्यांगना होत्या व त्यांनी पॅरिसमध्ये 'सेंटर मंडप' नावाची नृत्यशाळा स्थापन केली होती.
(c) भारत सरकारने त्यांना 2019 मध्ये पद्मश्री सन्मान बहाल केला होता.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. इटलीत जन्मलेली Milena Salvini Kathakali नर्तकी, Paris मध्ये Centre Mandapa चालवत, 2019 मध्ये Padma Shri — तीनही विधाने बरोबर.

questions.text: ऑस्ट्रेलियाच्या व्हिक्टोरिया राज्यात कार्यालय असणारी पहिली भारतीय बँक कोणती ?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. State Bank of India ने Victoria, Australia मध्ये पहिले भारतीय बँक कार्यालय उघडले — 2022 चालू घडामोड.

questions.text: भारतीय दंड संहितेच्या कलम 377 मध्ये पुढील कोणत्या विषयाचा उल्लेख आहे ?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. IPC कलम 377 (Navtej Johar, 2018 नंतर अंशतः रद्द) नैसर्गिक क्रमाविरुद्ध संभोग — परीक्षेत homosexuality शी जोडले जाते, मंदिर प्रवेश, व्यभिचार किंवा surrogacy नाही.

questions.text: राष्ट्रीय पातळीवर 'ऑल इंडिया स्टेट्स पीपल्स काँग्रेस' ची स्थापना होण्यापूर्वी कोल्हापुरात जनतेची गाऱ्हाणी मांडण्यासाठी खालीलपैकी कोणती संघटना कार्यरत होती ?
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तराप्रमाणे पर्याय A. All India States Peoples' Conference (1927) पूर्वी कोल्हापूरात स्थानिक 'Lok Sabha' संस्था होत्या — राज्यातील लोकांच्या समस्यांसाठी; इतर पर्याय राष्ट्रीय संसदीय संस्था किंवा Paropakarini Sabha.

questions.text: पुढीलपैकी विजोड व्यक्ती ओळखा :
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. Dr. Laura D'Souza, Sudhatai Joshi आणि Hirve Guruji गोवा मुक्ती संग्रामाशी जोडले; Sane Guruji महाराष्ट्रातील मोठे समाजसुधारक, पण त्या मोहिमेत नव्हते — म्हणून वेगळे.

questions.text: 1957 च्या स्त्रीशिक्षण विषयक राष्ट्रीय आयोगाच्या अध्यक्षा कोण होत्या ?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. Durgabai Deshmukh यांनी 1957 च्या National Commission for Female Education चे अध्यक्षपद सांभाळले — Durgabai Bhagwat (साहित्य) किंवा Anutai Wagh / Shantabai Dani यांच्याशी गोंधळू नका.

questions.text:
डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकरांच्या पश्चात त्यांचे कोणते अनुयायी काँग्रेसचे सभासद झाले होते ?
(a) आर.डी. भंडारे
(b) राजाभाऊ भोळे
(c) दादासाहेब रुपवते
(d) बापूसाहेब राजभोज
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. Babasaheb Ambedkar यांच्या नंतर R.D. Bhandare, Rajabhau Bhole आणि Dadasaheb Rupwate Congress मध्ये गेले; Bapusaheb Rajbhoj वेगळ्या राजकीय मार्गावर — उत्तरतालिकेत वगळले.

questions.text: मुंबई मध्ये खालीलपैकी कोणत्या दोन ठिकाणी ब्रिटीशांच्या काळात मिठाच्या पेठा होत्या ?

options.A: छ. शिवाजी महाराज टर्मिनस व वडाळा

questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. ब्रिटिश काळात मुंबईत Bhendi Bazar आणि Wadala येथे मीठ बाजार होते — स्थानिक भूगोलाशी जोडलेले प्रश्न.

questions.text: सुरत येथे मानव धर्म सभा आणि मुंबईत परमहंस मंडळी कोणी स्थापन केली होती ?
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तराप्रमाणे पर्याय B. Dadoba Pandurang Tarkhadkar यांनी Manav Dharma Sabha (Surat, 1844) आणि Paramahansa Mandali (Bombay, 1849) स्थापन — Atmaram यांच्याशी अदलाबदल करू नका.

questions.text: उत्तर भारता विषयी तपशीलवार माहिती असलेला तहकिक-इ-हिंद हा ग्रंथ कोणी लिहीला ?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Al-Biruni यांचे Tahqiq-i-Hind (Kitab al-Hind) 11व्या शतकातील भारतीय समाज-धर्म-विज्ञानाचे वर्णन — Ghazni, Ibn Battuta किंवा Abdul Razzak नाही.

questions.text: राजस्थान मध्ये मध्याश्म युगाची संस्कृती असणारे मोठे ठिकाण कोणते ?

ड. धोक्यात आलेल्या प्रजातींच्या संवर्धनाची, स्वरूपात बदलाचे दुष्परिणाम प्रत्यवन करण्यासाठी प्रयत्नांची या करारमध्ये प्रतिपादन केलेली आहे.

title: MPSC Non-Gazetted Group B & C Combined Pre 2023 (English)

questions.text:
During the establishment of Labour Organisation 'Bombay Mill Hand Association' which of the following personalities supported Narayan Meghaji Lokhande?
a. Keshavrao Bagde, Keshavrao Bole
b. Raghu Bhikaji, Genu Babaji
c. Narayan Surkaji, Vitthalrao Korgaonkar
d. Krishnaji Arjun Keluskar, Ramchandra Shinde, Narayan Pawar
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. When Narayan Meghaji Lokhande set up the Bombay Mill Hand Association, mill-worker leaders such as Raghu Bhikaji, Genu Babaji, Narayan Surkaji, Vitthalrao Korgaonkar, Krishnaji Arjun Keluskar, Ramchandra Shinde, and Narayan Pawar rallied behind him — not the Keshavrao Bagde–Keshavrao Bole pair in statement (a).

questions.text: In 1857 uprising _______ Governor General said that, had Shinde and Nijam participated, then uprising would have been successful.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. After 1857, Governor General Lord Canning remarked that if Scindia of Gwalior and the Nizam of Hyderabad had joined the rebels, the revolt could have succeeded — a comment that underlines how decisive princely neutrality was.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are true about Prarthana Samaj?
a. Prarthana Samaj was established by Dadoba Tarkhadkar, Dr. Atmaram Pandurang, Vamani Abaji Modak, Bhau Mahajan, etc. on 31 March 1867 at Bombay.
b. Prarthana Samaj started 'Subodh Patrika'.
c. Through Prarthana Samaj N.M. Joshi established Social Service League to improve the conditions of labourers.
d. Prarthana Samaj established colleges at Mumbai, Solapur, Kolhapur.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Prarthana Samaj was founded at Bombay on 31 March 1867, and it brought out Subodh Patrika; through that reform milieu N.M. Joshi later shaped labour welfare via the Social Service League — statement (d) about its colleges is the one that does not belong.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are true about 'Hindu Mahasabha'?
a. On 9 April 1915 Maharaja of Kasim Bazar, Sir Mahindra Chand Nandi announced the formation of Hindu Mahasabha at Haridwar.
b. B.S. Munje was the President of the Hindu Mahasabha.
c. Dr. Munje, Dr. Hedgewar, Dr. Paranjape started a branch of Hindu Mahasabha in Nagpur on 11 November 1923.
d. 28, 29, 30 December 1938 the Grand Session of the Hindu Mahasabha was held at Pune.

options.D: All of the above are correct

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Hindu Mahasabha was announced at Haridwar in April 1915, B.S. Munje presided over it, and a Nagpur branch opened on 11 November 1923 with Munje, Hedgewar, and Paranjape — the claim that its December 1938 grand session was at Pune is what drops statement (d).

questions.text:
During the uprising of 1857 which British Superior Military Officers played an important role?
a. Neill, Havelock
b. Outram, Lawrence Brothers
c. Campbell, Sir Hume Rose
d. William Digby, Colin Clark
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. British commanders Neill and Havelock, Outram with the Lawrence brothers, and Campbell with Sir Hugh Rose were all central to crushing the 1857 revolt — William Digby and Colin Clark were not military officers in that campaign.

questions.text:
In which area did the peasant revolts of 1875 take place?
a. Bhimadi, Shirur, Parner, Nagar
b. Indapur, Haveli, Baglan, Satara
c. Tasgaon, Shirala, Jath, Malkapur
d. Shrigonda, Karjat, Solapur, Ratnagiri
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. The 1875 Deccan peasant unrest spread through Bhimadi–Shirur–Parner–Nagar, Indapur–Haveli–Baglan–Satara, and Shrigonda–Karjat–Solapur–Ratnagiri tracts — Tasgaon–Shirala–Jath–Malkapur in statement (c) sits outside this cluster.

questions.text:
In which of the following movements/agitations did Revolutionary Senapati Bapat participate?
a. Goa Liberation Movement
b. Hyderabad Liberation Movement
c. Samyukta Maharashtra Movement
d. Maharashtra – Mysore Border Agitation

options.D: All of the above are correct

questions.explanation: Go with option D. Revolutionary Senapati Bapat took part in the Goa liberation struggle, the Hyderabad liberation movement, the Samyukta Maharashtra agitation, and the Maharashtra–Mysore border dispute — all four listed movements match his long activist career.

questions.text:
In 1919 the British Government started the Constitutional Reforms because
a. Increased dissatisfaction among Indians due to the revolutionary movement
b. Alliance between Congress and Muslim League
c. Alliance between Extremist and Moderates
d. The political situation created by the First World War

options.D: All of the above are correct

questions.explanation: Pick option D. Montagu–Chelmsford reforms of 1919 responded to wartime political pressure, rising revolutionary unrest, the Congress–League rapprochement after Lucknow 1916, and the post-Extremist–Moderate unity mood — every reason in the stem pushed the British toward constitutional change.

questions.text: _______ attended the Delhi Durbar in 1877, dressed in Khadi for 'Shri Ganesha' of the Swadeshi Movement.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Ganesh Vasudev Joshi — popularly Sarvajanik Kaka — attended the 1877 Delhi Durbar dressed in khadi as a symbolic 'Shri Ganesha' of the coming swadeshi spirit, long before the formal Swadeshi Movement of 1905.

questions.text:
Match the Pairs:
Sessions of the National Congress – Place → President
a. 1889 – Fifth Session – Bombay → I. Anandacharlu
b. 1891 – Seventh Session – Nagpur → II. Shankaran Nair
c. 1895 – Eleventh Session – Pune → III. William Wedderburn
d. 1897 – Thirteenth Session – Amravati → IV. Surendranath Banerjee
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Fifth session 1889 Bombay — Wedderburn; seventh 1891 Nagpur — Anandacharlu; eleventh 1895 Pune — Surendranath Banerjee; thirteenth 1897 Amravati — Shankaran Nair, giving the code (III) (I) (IV) (II).

questions.text: White revolution started in India from _______ year.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. India's White Revolution — Operation Flood — was launched in 1971 under Verghese Kurien to build a nationwide milk grid and raise dairy production; 1972–1974 are later milestones, not the start year.

questions.text: The local rock used to construct houses in rural area on the Deccan Plateau of Maharashtra is
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Deccan Trap basalt — dark, hard volcanic rock from the Cretaceous lava flows — is the everyday building stone in Maharashtra's rural plateau villages; laterite appears on wetter fringes, not as the main plateau material.

questions.text:
Match the following:
State → Population Density per sq. k.m. (2011)
a. Haryana → i. 123
b. Himachal Pradesh → ii. 414
c. Jharkhand → iii. 573
d. Bihar → iv. 1106
questions.explanation: On this one, option B. 2011 Census density figures pair Haryana with 573, Himachal Pradesh with 123, Jharkhand with 414, and Bihar with 1106 per sq km — sequence (iii) (i) (ii) (iv). Bihar tops the list; Himachal stays sparsely peopled.

questions.text:
Match the following:
Peak, Place → Height (meter)
a. Mangi-Tungi → i. 1567
b. Trambakeshwar → ii. 1416
c. Saptashringi → iii. 1304
d. Salher → iv. 1100
questions.explanation: Go with option A. According to the answer key, Salher gets the highest figure (1567 m), then Trambakeshwar (1416 m), Saptashringi (1304 m), and Mangi-Tungi (1100 m) — code (iv) (iii) (ii) (i); treat the listed metres as the paper's matching set.

questions.text: The row-row transportation started firstly in India on which railway route?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Ro-Ro (roll-on/roll-off) ferry services for loaded road trucks on rail wagons were first introduced on the Konkan Railway route, cutting travel time across the difficult western-ghats section.

questions.text:
Match the following:
State → Tourist Centre
a. Jammu and Kashmir → i. Taran Taran, Baba Bakala
b. Himachal Pradesh → ii. Ambala, Bhadkal lake
c. Punjab → iii. Avantipur, Alachigompa
d. Haryana → iv. Triloknath, Nainadevi
questions.explanation: Pick option B. Kashmir's Buddhist sites Avantipur and Alachigompa, Himachal's Triloknath and Naina Devi, Punjab's Sikh centres Tarn Taran and Baba Bakala, and Haryana's Ambala with Bhadkal lake fit as (iii) (iv) (i) (ii) — the states and shrines were scrambled in the list.

questions.text: As per the Champion and Seth's classification, how many major types of forests are present in Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Champion & Seth's forest classification for Maharashtra recognises six broad types — moist deciduous, dry deciduous, thorn, littoral, grassland, and alpine zones — not four or five.

questions.text: Which city of India has been declared as cleanest city for three consecutive years (2019 to 2021) by Swachh ranking of Government of India?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Indore topped the Swachh Survekshan clean-city rankings for three straight years from 2019 through 2021, ahead of Surat, Pune, and other contenders in that period.

questions.text:
Match the following:
Thermal Power Station → District
a. Koradi → i. Thane
b. Paras → ii. Nagpur
c. Uran → iii. Jalgaon
d. Fekari → iv. Akola
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. Koradi sits near Nagpur, not Thane; Uran is in Raigad; Paras and the Fekari pairing do not line up cleanly with the districts printed — the match list itself is unreliable.

questions.text: Railseema Plateau is located in _______ region.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Rayalaseema (often written 'Railseema' in papers) is the plateau tract in Andhra Pradesh lying east of the Karnataka plateau, not north, west, or south of it.

questions.text: For 2011-12 planning commission had defined poverty line with the help of following criteria.

options.A: ₹816 and ₹1,000 per capita income per month in rural areas and urban areas respectively
options.B: ₹47 and ₹32 per capita income per day in rural areas and urban areas respectively
options.C: ₹49.63 and ₹56.64 per capita income per day in rural areas and urban areas respectively

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. For 2011–12 the Planning Commission fixed the poverty line at about ₹816 per capita per month in rural areas and ₹1,000 in urban areas — the daily-rupee figures in (b) and (c) belong to other presentations of the same threshold.

questions.text:
Special Area Development Programme has been formulated for
a. Poverty eradication and employment growth
b. To develop hilly and tribal area
c. To develop drought prone area
d. Industrialization in the rural area
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. Special Area Development Programmes target backward tracts — especially hilly and tribal belts and drought-prone regions — rather than general poverty removal alone or a standalone rural-industrialisation brief.

questions.text:
Which are the instruments of fiscal policy?
a. Public spending and public debt
b. Democracy and federal structure
c. Taxation and budget
d. Parliament and administration
questions.explanation: Go with option D. Fiscal policy works through government spending, taxation, public debt, and the budget — democracy, federal structure, and parliamentary administration are constitutional or political arrangements, not fiscal tools.

questions.text: Who launched Ujwal Discom Assurance Yojana?
questions.explanation: Pick option A. Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana (UDAY) was launched by the Central Government in 2015 to help state power distribution companies restructure debt and improve operational efficiency — not by MSEB or LIC alone.

questions.text: Which of the following committee was appointed to recommend tax reforms in India in August 1991?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Dr Raja J. Chelliah chaired the Tax Reforms Committee appointed in August 1991 to overhaul India's direct and indirect tax structure; Narasimham handled banking reforms, Chakravarty monetary policy, and Abid Hussain trade/industry.

questions.text: What was the share of self employed, regular employees and casual labours in the total workforce in 2011-12?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. NSSO employment data for 2011–12 put self-employed workers at about 52% of the workforce, regular wage/salaried employees at 18%, and casual labour at 30%. India's labour market is still dominated by self-employment — the other splits in the options invert or exaggerate that pattern.

questions.text: National Mission on Edible oil-oil palm was launched in
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The National Mission on Edible Oils–Oil Palm (NMEO-OP) was launched in August 2021 to cut India's dependence on imported edible oils and expand oil-palm cultivation in suitable states. The 2020 and 2022 dates are near-miss distractors around the actual launch month.

questions.text: Crop Diversification Programme was implemented since 2013-14 as a sub-scheme of
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The Crop Diversification Programme has run since 2013–14 as a sub-scheme under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY), targeting paddy/wheat areas where farmers shift to alternative crops. Operation Greens and ODOP are separate flagship programmes.

questions.text:
During 2021-22, M₃ included
a. Post Office Saving Bank Deposit
b. Total Post Office Deposits
c. Time Deposits with Banks
d. Demand Deposits with Banks
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Broad money M₃ equals M₁ plus time deposits with banks — so it covers demand deposits (in M₁) and time deposits (c and d). Post Office savings are not part of M₃; they sit outside the RBI's monetary aggregate definition used in 2021–22.

questions.text:
Which of the following are priorities of budget 2023-24?
a. Inclusive development
b. Green growth
c. Youth power
d. Financial sector
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Union Budget 2023–24 listed seven priorities, and all four in the stem — inclusive development, green growth, youth power, and financial sector — were among them. Picking only two pairs (a–b or b–c) misses the full set the Finance Minister announced.

questions.text: The 12th Finance Commission recommended the continuance of the scheme of National Calamity Relief Fund with contributions from the Centre and the States in the ratio of
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. The 12th Finance Commission recommended continuing the National Calamity Relief Fund with Centre–State contributions in a 75 : 25 ratio — three-fourths from the Centre and one-fourth from the States. The 50 : 50 and 90 : 10 splits are common traps from other finance-commission recommendations.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/s is/are incorrect?
a. UTGST, is collected by Central Government and Union Territory Governments.
b. IGST, is collected by Central Government and State Governments.

options.C: Both a and b are incorrect

questions.explanation: Go with option C. Both statements misstate GST collection: UTGST is levied and collected by the Union Territory administration (not jointly by Centre and UTs as worded), and IGST is collected by the Central Government on inter-State supplies — States do not co-collect it at source. Neither (a) nor (b) is correctly framed.

questions.text:
Multidimensional poverty index has three dimensions mirroring in the Human Development index
a. Health
b. Income
c. Education
d. Living standards
questions.explanation: Pick option C. The Multidimensional Poverty Index uses three dimensions aligned with HDI thinking — health, education, and living standards — not income as a separate dimension. Statement (b) wrongly adds income; the other three together form the MPI structure NITI Aayog reports on.

questions.text: In September 2001 the schemes of Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana and Employment Assurance Scheme have been integrated with
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. In September 2001 the Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana and the Employment Assurance Scheme were merged into the Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) to unify rural wage-employment programmes. SGSY and PM Gramoday were different-generation schemes.

questions.text: The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003 (FRBM Act, 2003) stipulates that the Central Government must take appropriate measures to eliminate the revenue deficit by
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The original FRBM Act, 2003 required the Centre to eliminate the revenue deficit by 2008–09 (and cap fiscal deficit at 3% of GDP by that year). Later amendments shifted targets, but the Act as passed pointed to 2008–09.

questions.text: India's first gold ATM has been inaugurated in which city?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. India's first gold ATM was inaugurated in Hyderabad (by GRT Jewellers in late 2022), dispensing coins and small bars against digital payment. Varanasi, Lucknow, and Kochi are plausible metro distractors but not the launch city.

questions.text: Who among the following was awarded the Rajiv Gandhi Khelratna Award 2020?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Rohit Sharma received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna (now Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna) for 2020 — the ceremony was delayed by the pandemic but the award year was 2020. Tendulkar, Dhoni, and Kohli had been honoured in earlier cycles.

questions.text: During the lockdown in 2020, the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare launched this mobile application for easy transportation of agricultural products.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. During the 2020 lockdown the Ministry of Agriculture launched the Kisan Rath mobile app to connect farmers and traders with transport providers for moving perishable produce. Kisan Express and Krishi Network are name-similar distractors.

questions.text: Prabha Atre, who was conferred the Padma Vibhushan is associated with which field?
questions.explanation: On this one, option B. Prabha Atre — a doyen of Hindustani classical music — was conferred the Padma Vibhushan; she is a vocalist in the Kirana gharana tradition, not a litterateur, sportsperson, or civil servant.

questions.text: Which city is the host of 'All-India Official Language Conference' held in 2022?
questions.explanation: Go with option A. The All-India Official Language Conference in 2022 was hosted at Surat (Gujarat), bringing together departments working on Rajbhasha implementation. Ahmedabad, Mumbai, and Pune are other major Gujarat/Maharashtra cities but not that year's venue.

questions.text: Who has been named as 'India's most valuable test player of the 21st century' by Wisden?
questions.explanation: Pick option C. Wisden named Ravindra Jadeja India's most valuable Test player of the 21st century, citing his all-round impact with bat, ball, and fielding. Kohli and Dhoni dominate limited-overs lore; Ashwin is a spin rival, but the keyed Wisden pick was Jadeja.

questions.text: Which institution releases the 'Annual Status of Education Report' (ASER)?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Pratham, the Mumbai-based NGO, publishes the Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) surveying rural children's schooling and learning outcomes each year. NITI Aayog, Oxfam, and UNICEF work on related issues but do not release ASER.

questions.text: Which institution established the high-level Kyiv-Moscow Dialogue on Nuclear Safety?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) established the high-level Kyiv–Moscow Dialogue on Nuclear Safety after the 2022 conflict raised risks around Ukraine's nuclear facilities. UNICEF, IMF, and UNSC handle different mandates.

questions.text: When and where was the first patient of Covid-19 epidemic found in India?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. India's first confirmed COVID-19 case was reported on 30 January 2020 in Kerala (a student returning from Wuhan). The December 2019 dates pre-date India's timeline, and Goa was not the first state.

questions.text: Al Mohad Al Hindi the first naval exercise between which two countries was held in August 2021?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Al-Mohed Al-Hindi, the first bilateral naval exercise of that name, was held between India and Saudi Arabia in August 2021. Iran, Oman, and Afghanistan pairings are regional distractors — the inaugural edition was with Riyadh.

questions.text: Who is the first male Tennis star to win 21 Grand Slam titles?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Rafael Nadal became the first man to reach 21 Grand Slam singles titles (2022 Australian Open), edging past Federer and Djokovic who were on 20 each at that milestone. Agassi retired well below that count.

questions.text: Which technology platform launched the 'Jagruk Voter' campaign?
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. Twitter (now X) launched the 'Jagruk Voter' campaign in India to promote informed electoral participation ahead of polling season. Facebook, Microsoft, and Google run their own civic initiatives but not this branded drive.

questions.text: Ashok Chakra was posthumously awarded in 2021 for the extra ordinary bravery displayed during the war to
questions.explanation: Go with option B. ASI Babu Ram was posthumously awarded the Ashok Chakra in 2021 for extraordinary gallantry in counter-insurgency operations in Jammu & Kashmir. Altaf Hussain Bhatt, Jyotikumar Nirala, and Ashwini Kumar Dixit were honoured in other contexts or years.

questions.text: Who was the Marathi Literaturer to win the Gyanpeeth Award in 2021-22?
questions.explanation: Pick option A. Konkani writer Damodar Mauzo won the Jnanpith Award for 2021 (announced in 2022) — the first from Goa and a Marathi-Konkani literary figure in that cycle. Khandekar, Joshi, and Karandikar were earlier Marathi Jnanpith laureates.

questions.text: Which Indian State has been selected by WHO for World No Tobacco Day Award – 2022?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Jharkhand was selected by WHO for the World No Tobacco Day Award 2022 for strong tobacco-control measures at the state level. Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha were not the recipients that year.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement is not correct about the Advocate General?
(1) The 'Advocate General' is appointed by the President of India
(2) He gives advice to the Government of the State on such legal matters which are referred to him by the Governor
(3) He perform such other duties of a legal character that is assigned to him by the Governor
(4) He discharges the functions conferred on him by the Constitution or any other law
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Under Article 165 the Advocate General is appointed by the Governor of the State, not the President — statements (2), (3) and (4) correctly describe his advisory and statutory role.

questions.text: Which among the following statement is not correct about a High Court in India?

options.A: High Courts may accept a petition related to 'Public Interest Litigation'
options.B: Every Judge of a High Court is appointed by the President
options.C: Governor of the State appoints the Judges of a High Court
options.D: The age of retirement of a High Court Judge is 62

questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. High Court judges are appointed by the President after consultation with the Chief Justice of India and the Governor; the Governor does not appoint them, and PIL, presidential appointment, and retirement at 62 are all correct.

questions.text: Which of the following day is celebrated by the Government of India every year on 24th April?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. The Government of India observes 24 April as National Panchayat Raj Day to mark the coming into force of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment in 1993.

questions.text:
Which among the following States do not have Vidhan Parishad?
a. Bihar
b. Karnataka
c. Kerala
d. Rajasthan
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Kerala and Rajasthan have only Vidhan Sabhas — no Legislative Council. Bihar and Karnataka do have Vidhan Parishads.

questions.text:
Match the pairs correctly.
A. 61st Constitutional Amendment → 1. Retirement age of Members of State Public Service Commission increased from 60 to 62 years
B. 44th Constitutional Amendment → 2. Three tier Panchayat Raj System
C. 41st Constitutional Amendment → 3. Voter age changed from 21 to 18 years
D. 73rd Constitutional Amendment → 4. Controversy in Supreme Court and High Court regarding election of President, Vice President and Prime Minister
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Match them by amendment: 61st — voting age 21 to 18; 44th — curbed emergency powers after the 42nd; 41st — SPSC members' retirement age raised to 62; 73rd — three-tier Panchayat Raj. That gives A–3, B–4, C–1, D–2.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements about the powers and duties of Sarpanch.
a. To implement the resolutions passed in the Gram Sabha.
b. Protect the property owned by Gram Panchayat.
c. To supervise primary schools in the Gram Panchayat area.
Select the incorrect statements given above.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. A Sarpanch must implement Gram Sabha resolutions and protect Panchayat property, but directly supervising primary schools is not listed among core Sarpanch duties — that falls under the education administration.

questions.text: Who among the following was not a member of Sarkaria Commission?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Justice R.S. Sarkaria chaired the Commission; B. Sivaraman and Dr S.R. Sen were members. Rama Subramaniam was not on the Sarkaria Commission — Rama Swamy served instead.

questions.text: Which article was amended to clarify duties of the Election Commission?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. The key points to Article 324 in Part XV (Elections); amendments to this article clarified the Election Commission's role without overriding the President's and Governor's powers of appointment.

questions.text:
Match the correct pairs.
I. Thomas Hobbes → A. Anglo-Austrian Philosopher
II. Friedric Hayek → B. Father of French Revolution
III. Robert Nozick → C. British Philosopher
IV. Rousseau → D. American Philosopher
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Hobbes was British (I–C), Hayek Anglo-Austrian (II–A), Nozick American (III–D), and Rousseau is linked to the ideas behind the French Revolution (IV–B).

questions.text: Who among the following headed the Committee on the functions of the Constituent Assembly of India?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. G.V. Mavalankar headed the Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly — the panel that streamlined the Assembly's day-to-day legislative work.

questions.text: The first draft of the Constitution of India was prepared in _______ by the Advisory Branch of the Constituent Assembly.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. B.N. Rau's Advisory Branch of the Constituent Assembly prepared the first draft of the Constitution in October 1947, before the full Drafting Committee revisions.

questions.text:
Arrange in appropriate order as per Sr. No. of articles of Directive Principles of the State Policy given in the Constitution of India.
a. Protection and improvement of environment.
b. Improving living status and public health.
c. Protection of economic interests of SC, ST and weaker section.
d. To implement uniform civil code for all the people.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Order the DPSP articles: Uniform Civil Code (44), economic interests of SC/ST (46), public health and living standard (47), environment (48A) — so d, c, b, a.

questions.text: The report on Indian Constitutional Reforms known as the Montague-Chelmsford, was published in
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. The Montagu-Chelmsford Report on Indian constitutional reforms was published in July 1918, following the August 1917 declaration.

questions.text:
Which pair is/are incorrectly matched?
a. Prohibition of discrimination – Article 15
b. Right to Association – Article 19
c. Right to Protection of Life – Article 20
d. Right to Constitutional Remedies – Article 32
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. 'Right to Protection of Life' belongs to Article 21, not Article 20 — Article 20 covers conviction and self-incrimination. The other three pairings are correct.

questions.text:
Which of the following is not included in the Concurrent List?
a. Contracts
b. Forests
c. Tolls
d. Bankruptcy and insolvency
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Contracts and bankruptcy and insolvency sit on the Concurrent List, and forests were moved there too; tolls remain a State List subject, not concurrent.

questions.text: 'Chaetophorales' group belong to which of the algal class?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Chaetophorales is an order of green algae placed under Chlorophyta — filamentous forms common in freshwater habitats.

questions.text: A plant is killed by over watering because

options.A: Water neutralizes the pH of the soil
options.B: The roots are deprived of oxygen
options.C: Water supports the growth of root parasites
options.D: Water does not have all the necessary mineral for plant growth

questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Waterlogged soil fills air spaces in the root zone, so roots cannot get oxygen and the plant suffocates — classic over-watering damage, not pH change or parasites.

questions.text: Which group of Algae plays a dominant role in Nitrogen Fixation?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Blue-green algae (Myxophyceae / Cyanophyceae) fix atmospheric nitrogen through specialised cells — they dominate biological nitrogen fixation among algae.

questions.text: Which is the correct order of phases of meiosis?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Prophase I runs: Leptotene → Zygotene → Pachytene → Diplotene → Diakinesis — pairing and crossing-over sit in the middle of that sequence.

questions.text: Antimony compounds are recommended for the treatment of
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Antimony compounds such as antimonials are the classic drugs against schistosomiasis (bilharzia), a trematode infection — not elephantiasis or fasciolopsiasis.

questions.text: Normally in porifera the gametes are formed by
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. In Porifera, archaeocytes (amoebocytes) give rise to gametes during reproduction, while choanocytes mainly handle feeding and water circulation.

questions.text: For each 1°C rise in temperature, the speed of sound in air increases by _______ cm/s.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. In air, the speed of sound rises by roughly 0.6 m/s for each 1 °C increase — that is about 61 cm/s per degree Celsius.

questions.text: Unit of specific heat in C.G.S. system is
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Specific heat in the CGS system is measured in calories per gram per degree Celsius — cal/(g·°C) — because it is heat per unit mass per unit temperature rise.

questions.text: The power expended by a current in a resistance is proportional to

options.A: Square of the current in the resistance
options.B: Cube of the current in the resistance
options.C: Square root of the current in the resistance
options.D: Square of the potential difference across it

questions.explanation: MPSC officially cancelled this question — no marks were awarded. Joule heating gives P = I²R (option A) but also P = V²/R (option D), so more than one option fits depending on how the stem is read; treat it as a withdrawn item.

questions.text: Whooping cough disease is caused by which of the following bacterial infection?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Whooping cough (pertussis) is caused by Bordetella pertussis — a Gram-negative bacterium spread by respiratory droplets, distinct from staphylococcal or streptococcal infections.

questions.text: Which of the following vitamin acts as an antioxidant?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Vitamin E (tocopherol) is the fat-soluble vitamin best known as a membrane antioxidant — it neutralises free radicals and protects cell lipids; A and D have other roles, and K is mainly for blood clotting.

questions.text: _______ are drugs which bind to receptors present in central nervous system and gastro-intestinal-tract.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Opioids as a drug class bind opioid receptors in the CNS and GI tract to relieve pain — morphine is one opioid, not the class name; cannabinoids and coca alkaloids use different receptor systems.

questions.text: German Silver is alloy of
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. German silver (nickel silver) is an alloy of copper, nickel and zinc — it contains no silver; the Cu–Zn–Sn mix is bronze, and plain Cu–Zn is brass.

questions.text: Chemical name of aspirin is
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Aspirin is acetylsalicylic acid — salicylic acid with an acetyl (–COCH₃) group on the hydroxyl; the ethyl, methyl and benzoyl variants are different esters.

questions.text: The terms Hard and Soft – Acids and Bases were given by
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Ralph Pearson introduced Hard and Soft Acids and Bases (HSAB) theory in 1963 — it classifies Lewis acids and bases by polarisability; Brønsted and Lewis defined earlier acid–base models.

questions.text: If area of circle is 'x' sq.cm and perimeter of corresponding circle is 'x' cm, then which of the following will be radius of circle?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Set πr² = x and 2πr = x; dividing gives r = 2 cm. A quick check: area 4π and circumference 4π both equal when r = 2.

questions.text: A shopkeeper sold 15 shirts for Rs. 2,340. He suffered a loss of Rs. 60. What is cost price of each shirt?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Selling price is 2340 ÷ 15 = Rs. 156 per shirt; adding back the Rs. 60 total loss (Rs. 4 per shirt) gives cost price Rs. 160.
Working through it, option B is the one. Numerator: 0.001 + 0.000008 = 0.001008; denominator: 0.008 + 0.000064 = 0.008064; the ratio simplifies to 0.125.

questions.text: The sum of present ages of 3 persons is 72 yrs. Seven years ago, their ages were in the ratio 4 : 6 : 7. What are their present ages in years?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Seven years ago the sum was 72 − 21 = 51; with ratio 4 : 6 : 7, k = 3 gives ages 12, 18 and 21 then — add seven to get 19, 25 and 28 today.

questions.text: A man took a loan from a bank at the rate of 12% p.a. simple interest. After 3 years, he had to pay Rs. 5,400 as interest. Find the amount borrowed by him.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Simple interest: 540 = P × 12 × 3 ÷ 100, so P = 540 × 100 ÷ 36 = Rs. 15,000 — re-read whether the stem asks for principal or total repayment.

questions.text: The value of machine decreases at the rate of 5% every year. If the value of machine is Rs. 16,000, what will it be after two years?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Two successive 5% depreciations: 16000 × 0.95 × 0.95 = Rs. 14,440 — do not apply a flat 10% on the original value.

questions.text: The railway fare increased by 20%. Again in next two successive months, it is increased by 10% and 25% respectively. What is the percentage increase in the original fare?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Compound the three hikes: 1.20 × 1.10 × 1.25 = 1.65, so the fare is 65% above the original — successive percentage changes must be multiplied, not added.
Working through it, option D is the one. Group the expression as [(-5)×8÷(-5)] ÷ [(-10)÷(-12)] = 8 ÷ (5/6) = 9.6 — the printed operator order is ambiguous, but the key assumes this bracketing.

questions.text: A batsman makes a score of 98 runs in the 19th innings and thus increases his average by 4. What is his average after 19th innings?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. The 98-run innings raised the average by 4, so the prior 18-innings total was 18 × 22 = 396; new total 494 ÷ 19 = 26.

questions.text: Find the radius of circle whose area is equal to the sum of areas of three circles of radii 3 cm, 4 cm and 12 cm.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Sum of squared radii: 9 + 16 + 144 = 169, so the equivalent circle has r = 13 cm — areas add, radii do not.

questions.text: How many squares are there on a chess board?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. An 8×8 board has squares of all sizes: 1² + 2² + … + 8² = 204 — 1296 counts every cell once, not every square.

questions.text:
Find out the wrong term in the given series.
15, 21, 24, 30, 32, 39, 51
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. The pattern alternates +6 and +3: after 30 the next term should be 33, not 32 — 32 breaks the rhythm.

questions.text:
Two statements and two conclusions are given below. Find out suitable alternative.
Statements: A. All teachers are artists. B. Few artists live happily.
Conclusions: C. All teachers live happily. D. All those who live happily are artists.

options.C: Both C and D are false
options.D: Both C and D are true

questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. 'All teachers are artists' plus 'Few artists live happily' does not prove all teachers are happy (C), nor that every happy person is an artist (D) — both conclusions overreach.

questions.text: Ankita's mother's age is two and half times Ankita's age and four times her brother's age. Their total age is 66 years. What will be Ankita's brother's age after 2 years?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Let Ankita's age be x: mother 2.5x, brother 2.5x/4; 4.125x = 66 gives x = 16, brother = 10 now, so 12 after two years.

questions.text:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting on a wall and all of them are facing east.
i. C is the immediate right of D.
ii. B is at extreme end and E as his neighbour.
iii. G is between E and F.
iv. D is sitting third from the south end.
Who is sitting to the right of 'G'?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. From the south end: A–C–D–F–G–E–B (all facing east); G's immediate right (southward) is F — map D third from south, then place C, B/E at the north end with G between E and F.

questions.text: The International Yoga Day falls on Tuesday in 2016, then on which day will the National Science Day fall in the same year?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Yoga Day is 21 June 2016 (Tuesday); National Science Day is 28 February 2016 — counting back from June, 28 Feb falls on a Sunday in that leap year.

questions.text: If the series 4, 5, 8, 13, 14, 17, 22,..., is continued in same pattern, which of the following is not a term of this series?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. The cycle is +1, +3, +5, repeating: …22, 23, 26, 31, 32, 35… — 33 never appears because no step in the pattern lands on it.

questions.text: If all the letters of the word "UNIDENTIFIED" are arranged in alphabetical order, then the position of how many letters will remain unchanged?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. UNIDENTIFIED sorted alphabetically gives D D E E F I I I N N T U — only the I at position 8 stays in the same slot; scan each position against the sorted string.

questions.text: Sanvi walks some distance towards East and turns left in 90°. Then she walks 50 m. Now she turns right in 135° and walks 15 m. Now her left hand indicates which direction?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. East → left 90° faces North; a further right turn of 135° faces south-east; when facing SE, the left hand points north-east.

questions.text: Below Venn-diagram and three words are given in options. Which option represents the Venn-diagram correctly? (Three overlapping circles)
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Flowers, Fragrant and White fit three overlapping sets — some flowers are fragrant, some white flowers are fragrant, etc.; India⊂Asia breaks containment logic, and cup–saucer–tea lacks proper subset overlap.

title: MPSC अराजपत्रित गट-ब व गट-क संयुक्त पूर्व परीक्षा 2023 (मराठी)

questions.text:
नारायण मेघाजी लोखंडे यांनी 'बॉम्बे मिल हँण्ड असोसिएशन' ही कामगार संघटना स्थापन करीत असताना त्यांना खालीलपैकी कोणत्या व्यक्तींचे सहकार्य मिळाले होते?
अ. केशवराव बागडे, केशवराव बोले
ब. रघु भिकाजी, गेणू बाबाजी
क. नारायण सुर्काजी, विठ्ठलराव कोरगांवकर
ड. कृष्णाजी अर्जुन केळूसकर, रामचंद्र शिंदे, नारायण पवार
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. नारायण मेघाजी लोखंडे यांनी Bombay Mill Hand Association स्थापन केल्यावर रघु भिकाजी, गेनू बाबाजी, नारायण सुरकाजी, विठ्ठलराव कोर्गावकर, कृष्णाजी अर्जुन केळुस्कर, रामचंद्र शिंदे, नारायण पवार यांसारख्या mill-worker नेत्यांनी पाठिंबा दिला — विधान (a) मधील केशवराव बागडे–केशवराव बोले जोडी नाही.

questions.text: इ.स. 1857 च्या उठावात शिंदे व निजाम यांनी भाग घेतला असता तर उठाव यशस्वी झाला असता असे __________ हा गव्हर्नर जनरल म्हणाला.
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. 1857 नंतर गव्हर्नर जनरल लॉर्ड कॅनिंग म्हणाले की ग्वालियरचे शिंदे व हैदराबादचा निजाम बंडखोरांसोबत उभे राहिले असते तर उठाव यशस्वी झाला असता — राजघराण्यांच्या तटस्थतेचे महत्त्व दाखवणारे विधान.

questions.text:
प्रार्थना समाजाबद्दल पुढीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत?
अ. दादोबा तर्खडकर, डॉ. आत्माराम पांडुरंग, वामन आबाजी मोडक, भाऊ महाजन, इत्यादींनी 31 मार्च 1867 रोजी मुंबई येथे प्रार्थना समाजाची स्थापना केली.
ब. प्रार्थना समाजामार्फत 'सुबोध पत्रिका' सुरू केली.
क. प्रार्थना समाजाच्या माध्यमातून ना. म. जोशी यांनी मजुरांची स्थिती सुधारण्यासाठी 'सोशल सर्व्हिस लीग'ची स्थापना केली.
ड. प्रार्थना समाजाने मुंबई, सोलापूर, कोल्हापूर येथे महाविद्यालयांची स्थापना केली.
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. प्रार्थना समाज 31 मार्च 1867 रोजी Mumbai येथे स्थापन, Subodh Patrika सुरू, आणि या सुधारणा परिसरातून N.M. Joshi यांनी Social Service League द्वारे कामगार कल्याणासाठी काम केले — विधान (d) मधील महाविद्यालयांचा दावा योग्य नाही.

questions.text:
हिंदू महासभेच्या संदर्भातील पुढीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत?
अ. 9 एप्रिल, 1915 रोजी हरिद्वार येथे कासिम बाजारचे महाराज सर महिंद्रचंद नंदी यांनी हिंदू महासभेची स्थापना केल्याचे घोषित केले.
ब. हिंदू महासभेचे अध्यक्ष बा.शि.मुंजे होते.
क. डॉ. मुंजे, डॉ. हेडगेवार, डॉ. पारंजपे यांनी नागपूरला 11 नोव्हेंबर 1923 रोजी हिंदू महासभेची शाखा सुरू केली.
ड. 28, 29, 30 डिसेंबर 1938 मध्ये हिंदू महासभेचे मध्य अधिवेशन पुणे येथे पार पडले.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. हिंदू महासभेची Haridwar येथे 1915 मध्ये घोषणा, B.S. Munje अध्यक्ष, 11 नोव्हें 1923 ला Nagpur शाखा Munje–Hedgewar–Paranjape यांच्यासह — डिसें 1938 चे grand session Pune येथे होते असे विधान (d) चुकीचे आहे.

questions.text:
इ.स. 1857 च्या उठावाच्या वेळी इंग्रजांच्या कोणत्या कर्दबगार सेनानींनी महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावली होती?
अ. नील, हॅवलॉक
ब. औटरॅम, लॉरेन्स बंधू
क. कॅम्पबेल, सर ह्यूम रोज
ड. विल्यम डिग्बी, कॉलिन क्लार्क
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. ब्रिटिश सेनापती Neill–Havelock, Outram व Lawrence brothers, Campbell व Sir Hugh Rose — हे 1857 उठाव दाबण्यात महत्त्वाचे; William Digby व Colin Clark त्या लष्करी मोहिमेचे अधिकारी नव्हते.

questions.text:
इ.स. 1875 मधील शेतकऱ्यांचे उठाव कोणत्या भागामध्ये झाले होते?
अ. भिमाडी, शिरूर, पारनेर, नगर
ब. इंदापूर, हवेली, बागलाण, सातारा
क. तासगांव, शिराळा, जत, मलकापूर
ड. श्रीगोंदा, कर्जत, सोलापूर, रत्नागिरी
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. 1875 चा दखलनामा उठाव Bhimadi–Shirur–Parner–Nagar, Indapur–Haveli–Baglan–Satara, Shrigonda–Karjat–Solapur–Ratnagiri या भागांत पसरला — विधान (c) मधील Tasgaon–Shirala–Jath–Malkapur या गटात नाही.

questions.text:
क्रांतीकारक सेनापती बापट यांनी खालीलपैकी कोणत्या चळवळी/आंदोलना मध्ये भाग घेतला होता?
अ. गोवा मुक्ती संग्राम
ब. हैद्राबाद मुक्ती संग्राम
क. संयुक्त महाराष्ट्र चळवळ
ड. महाराष्ट्र – म्हैसूर-सीमा आंदोलन
questions.explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. क्रांतिकारक सेनापती बापट Goa मुक्ती, Hyderabad मुक्ती, Samyukta Maharashtra चळवळ व Maharashtra–Mysore सीमा वाद — चारही यादीत नमूद चळवळींमध्ये सहभागी; त्यांच्या दीर्घ कार्याचा भाग.

questions.text:
इ. स. 1919 मध्ये ब्रिटीश सरकारने घटनात्मक सुधारणा दिल्या कारण
अ. क्रांतीकारकांच्या चळवळी मधून भारतीयांच्यात असंतोष वाढला
ब. काँग्रेस व मुस्लीम लीग यांच्यातील युती
क. जहाल व मवाळ यांच्यातील युती
ड. पहिल्या महायुद्धाने निर्माण केलेली राजकीय परिस्थिती
questions.explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. 1919 चे Montagu–Chelmsford reforms — युद्धकाळाचा राजकीय दबाव, वाढती क्रांतिकारी असंतोष, Lucknow 1916 नंतर Congress–League जवळीक, Extremist–Moderate एकता — प्रत्येक कारण ब्रिटिशांना घटनात्मक सुधारणांकडे ढकलले.

questions.text: __________ यांनी स्वदेशी चळवळीचा 'श्री गणेशा' करून्‌ खादीचा पोशाख घालून सन 1877 मधील दिल्ली दरबारात हजेरी लावली.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A. गणेश वासुदेव जोशी — सर्वजनिक काका — 1877 च्या Delhi Durbar ला khadi मध्ये 'श्री गणेश' म्हणून हजर; 1905 च्या अधिकृत Swadeshi चळवळीपूर्वीच स्वदेशी भावनेचे प्रतीक.

questions.text:
जोड्या लावा:
राष्ट्रीय सभेची अधिवेशने – ठिकाण → अध्यक्ष
अ. 1889 – पाचवे अधिवेशन – मुंबई → I. आनंदाचार्लू
ब. 1891 – सातवे अधिवेशन – नागपूर → II. शंकरन नायर
क. 1895 – अकरावे अधिवेशन – पुणे → III. विल्यम वेडरबर्न
ड. 1897 – तेरावे अधिवेशन – अमरावती → IV. सुरेन्द्रनाथ बॅनर्जी
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. पाचवे 1889 Bombay — Wedderburn; सातवे 1891 Nagpur — Anandacharlu; अकरावे 1895 Pune — Surendranath Banerjee; तेरावे 1897 Amravati — Shankaran Nair; क्रम (III) (I) (IV) (II).

questions.text: भारतात श्वेत क्रान्तीला सुरुवात __________ सालापासून करण्यात आली.
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. भारताची White Revolution — Operation Flood — 1971 मध्ये Verghese Kurien यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली सुरू; राष्ट्रव्यापी दूध जाळा व उत्पादन वाढ; 1972–1974 नंतरचे टप्पे, सुरुवातीचे वर्ष नाहीत.

questions.text: महाराष्ट्राच्या दख्खन पठारावर ग्रामीण भागामध्ये घर बांधणीसाठी या स्थानिक दगडाचा वापर केला जातो.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. Deccan Trap basalt — Cretaceous lava flows चा गडद, कठीण दगड — Maharashtra plateau गावांमध्ये घर बांधण्याचा मुख्य दगड; laterite ओले कडेकडे, plateau चा मुख्य दगड नाही.

questions.text:
योग्य जोड्या जुळवा:
राज्य → लोकसंख्या घनता दर चौ. कि.मी. (2011)
a. हरियाणा → i. 123
b. हिमाचल प्रदेश → ii. 414
c. झारखंड → iii. 573
d. बिहार → iv. 1106
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. 2011 जनगणनेनुसार Haryana–573, Himachal Pradesh–123, Jharkhand–414, Bihar–1106 प्रति च. कि. मी.; क्रम (iii) (i) (ii) (iv). Bihar सर्वाधिक; Himachal विरळ.

questions.text:
योग्य जोड्या जुळवा:
शिखर, ठिकाण → उंची (मीटर)
a. मांगी-तुंगी → i. 1567
b. त्र्यंबकेश्वर → ii. 1416
c. सप्तशृंगी → iii. 1304
d. साल्हेर → iv. 1100
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. उत्तरतालिकेनुसार Salher सर्वोच्च (1567 m), मग Trambakeshwar (1416 m), Saptashringi (1304 m), Mangi-Tungi (1100 m) — क्रम (iv) (iii) (ii) (i); उंचीचे आकडे paper मधील जोड्या म्हणून ठेवा.

questions.text: रो-रो वाहतुकीची सुरुवात भारतात सर्वप्रथम कोणत्या रेल्वेमार्गावर झाली?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय C चिन्हांकित केला. Ro-Ro (roll-on/roll-off) — भरलेले truck rail wagons वर — India मध्ये प्रथम Konkan Railway मार्गावर; पश्चिम घाटाचा कपटी भाग ओलांडण्याचा वेळ कमी.

questions.text:
योग्य जोड्या जुळवा:
राज्य → पर्यटन स्थळ
a. जम्मु व काश्मिर → i. तारण तारण, बाबा बकाला
b. हिमाचल प्रदेश → ii. अंबाला, भडकल सरोवर
c. पंजाब → iii. अवंतीपूर, अलचीगोम्पा
d. हरियाणा → iv. त्रिलोकनाथ, नैनादेवी
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Kashmir — Avantipur, Alachigompa; Himachal — Triloknath, Naina Devi; Punjab — Tarn Taran, Baba Bakala; Haryana — Ambala, Bhadkal lake; जोडी (iii) (iv) (i) (ii) — यादीत राज्ये व स्थळे मिसळलेली होती.

questions.text: चॅम्पिअन आणि सेठ यांच्या वर्गीकरणानुसार महाराष्ट्र राज्यात जंगलांचे किती प्रमुख प्रकार आहेत?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Champion & Seth च्या Maharashtra forest classification मध्ये सहा मुख्य प्रकार — moist deciduous, dry deciduous, thorn, littoral, grassland, alpine — चार किंवा पाच नाहीत.

questions.text: भारतातील कोणते शहर भारतीय शासनाच्या स्वच्छ क्रमवारीत सलग तीन वेळा (2019 ते 2021) स्वच्छ शहर म्हणून घोषित करण्यात आले?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Indore ने 2019 ते 2021 पर्यंत Swachh Survekshan मध्ये सलग तीन वर्षे सर्व स्वच्छ शहर; Surat, Pune व इतरांपेक्षा पुढे.

questions.text:
योग्य जोड्या जुळवा:
औष्णिक विज केंद्र → जिल्हा
a. कोराडी → i. ठाणे
b. पारस → ii. नागपूर
c. उरण → iii. जळगांव
d. फेकरी → iv. अकोला
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला — फक्त सरावासाठी. Koradi Nagpur जवळ, Thane नाही; Uran Raigad; Paras व Fekari जिल्हा-जोड्या paper मधील यादीशी नीट जुळत नाहीत — जोडणी यादी अविश्वसनीय.

questions.text: रायलसीमा पठाराचे स्थान __________ येथे आहे.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Rayalaseema (paper मध्ये 'Railseema') हा Andhra Pradesh मधील plateau Karnataka plateau च्या पूर्वेकडे आहे — उत्तर, पश्चिम किंवा दक्षिण नाही.

questions.text: खालील निकषांच्या आधारे 2011-12 या वर्षासाठी नियोजन आयोगाने दारिद्र्य रेषा निश्चित केली.

options.A: दरडोई उत्पन्न प्रतिमहिना ग्रामीण भागासाठी ₹ 816 व शहरी भागासाठी ₹ 1,000
options.B: दरडोई उत्पन्न प्रतिदिनी ग्रामीण भागासाठी ₹ 47 व शहरी भागासाठी ₹ 32
options.C: दरडोई उत्पन्न प्रतिदिनी ग्रामीण भागासाठी ₹ 49.63 व शहरी भागासाठी ₹ 56.64

questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. 2011–12 साठी Planning Commission ने ग्रामीण ₹816 व शहरी ₹1,000 प्रति व्यक्ती दरमहा poverty line ठरवली — (b) व (c) मधील दैनिक रुपये त्याच threshold च्या इतर मांडणी.

questions.text:
विशेष प्रदेश विकास कार्यक्रम यासाठी तयार करण्यात आला
अ. दारिद्र्य निर्मूलन व रोजगार वाढ
ब. डोंगराळ व आदिवासी भागाचा विकास
क. दुष्काळग्रस्त भागाचा विकास
ड. ग्रामीण भागात औद्योगिकीकरण
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. Special Area Development Programmes मागास भाग — विशेषतः hilly–tribal व drought-prone — साठी; फक्त सर्वसामान्य गरीबी निवारण किंवा एकट्या rural industrialisation साठी नाहीत.

questions.text:
राजकोषीय नीतीची साधने कोणती?
अ. सार्वजनिक व्यय आणि सार्वजनिक कर्ज
ब. लोकशाही आणि संघराज्यात्मक रचना
क. करारोपण आणि अंदाजपत्रक
ड. संसद आणि प्रशासन
questions.explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. Fiscal policy — public spending, taxation, public debt, budget — यांद्वारे; democracy, federal structure, Parliament–administration हे राजकीय/घटनात्मक व्यवस्था, fiscal साधने नाहीत.

questions.text: उज्ज्वल डिस्कॉम अश्युरन्स योजना कोणी सुरू केली?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana (UDAY) 2015 मध्ये Central Government ने सुरू — state power distribution companies चे debt restructuring व कार्यक्षमता; MSEB किंवा LIC एकट्याने नाही.

questions.text: ऑगस्ट 1991 मध्ये भारतातील कर सुधारणा शिफारसीसाठी खालीलपैकी कोणती समिती नियुक्त करण्यात आली होती?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. ऑगस्ट 1991 मध्ये नियुक्त Tax Reforms Committee चे अध्यक्ष डॉ. Raja J. Chelliah — direct व indirect tax structure सुधारणा; Narasimham banking, Chakravarty monetary, Abid Hussain trade/industry.

questions.text: 2011-12 मध्ये एकूण श्रमशक्तीमध्ये स्वयंरोजगार, नियमीत रोजगार आणि प्रासंगिक रोजगाराचा काय हिस्सा होता?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. 2011–12 च्या NSSO रोजगार आकडेवारीनुसार स्व-रोजगार 52%, नियमित वेतनभोगी 18% आणि कामगार 30% होते. भारताच्या कामगार बाजारात अजूनही स्व-रोजगार प्रमुख आहे — इतर पर्याय हे प्रमाण उलट किंवा अतिरंजित करतात.

questions.text: खाद्य तेलांवरील राष्ट्रीय मिशन-तेल पाम __________ मध्ये सुरू करण्यात आले.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. National Mission on Edible Oils–Oil Palm (NMEO-OP) ऑगस्ट 2021 मध्ये सुरू झाली, खाद्यतेलाच्या आयातीवर अवलंबित्व कमी करण्यासाठी आणि योग्य राज्यांमध्ये ऑयल पाम लागवड वाढवण्यासाठी. 2020 व 2022 च्या तारखा जवळच्या फसवणुका आहेत.

questions.text: पीक विविधीकरण कार्यक्रम 2013-14 पासून __________ ची उपयोजना म्हणून राबविण्यात आला.
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Crop Diversification Programme 2013–14 पासून Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) अंतर्गत उप-योजना म्हणून राबवली जाते, जिथे शेतकरी धान्य/गहू ऐवजी पर्यायी पिकांकडे वळतात. Operation Greens आणि ODOP वेगळ्या ध्वजीय योजना आहेत.

questions.text:
2021-22 दरम्यान एम-3 (M₃) मध्ये __________ समाविष्ट आहेत.
अ. पोस्ट ऑफिस बचत बँक ठेवी
ब. पोस्ट ऑफिसच्या एकूण ठेवी
क. बँकाकडील मुदत ठेवी
ड. बँकाकडील मागणी ठेवी
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. व्यापक चलन M₃ = M₁ + बँकांमधील मुदत ठेवी; म्हणजे मागणी ठेवी (M₁ मध्ये) आणि मुदत ठेवी (c व d) समाविष्ट. Post Office बचत M₃ चा भाग नाही — त्या RBI च्या चलन-संकल्पनेत बाहेर राहतात.

questions.text:
2023-24 च्या अर्थसंकल्पात खालीलपैकी कोणते प्राधान्य क्रम आहेत?
अ. सर्वसमावेशक विकास
ब. हरित वाढ
क. युवा शक्ती
ड. आर्थिक क्षेत्र
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. केंद्रीय अर्थसंकल्प 2023–24 मध्ये सात प्राधान्ये होती, आणि प्रश्नातील चारही — समावेशक विकास, हरित वाढ, युवा शक्ती आणि वित्तीय क्षेत्र — त्यात होती. फक्त दोन जोड्या निवडणे अपूर्ण उत्तर ठरते.

questions.text: 12 व्या वित्त आयोगाने राष्ट्रीय आपत्ती निवारण निधीची योजना केंद्र आणि राज्यांच्या योगदानासह __________ च्या प्रमाणात चालू ठेवण्याची शिफारस केली.
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. 12 व्या वित्त आयोगाने National Calamity Relief Fund सुरू ठेवण्याची शिफारस केंद्र–राज्य 75 : 25 या प्रमाणात योगदानासह केली — 75% केंद्राकडून, 25% राज्याकडून. 50 : 50 व 90 : 10 इतर आयोग-शिफारसींमधील सामान्य फसवणुका.

questions.text:
खालीलपैकी कोणते/ती विधान/ने अयोग्य आहे/त?
अ. युटीजीएसटी, केंद्र सरकार आणि केंद्रशासित प्रदेश सरकारांद्वारे गोळा केले जोतात.
ब. आयजीएसटी, केंद्र सरकार आणि राज्य सरकारे गोळा करतात.

options.C: दोन्ही अ आणि ब अयोग्य आहेत

questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. दोन्ही विधाने GST संकलन चुकीचे सांगतात: UTGST केंद्रशासित प्रदेश प्रशासनाने वसूल केले जाते (प्रश्नात सांगितलेल्या प्रमाणे केंद्र व UT एकत्र नाही), आणि IGST आंतर-राज्य पुरवठ्यावर केंद्र सरकार वसूल करते — राज्ये थेट संकलित करत नाहीत. (a) आणि (b) दोन्ही चुकीची आहेत.

questions.text:
मानवी विकास निर्देशांकामध्ये बहुआयामी दारिद्र्य निर्देशांकाचे __________ तीन आयाम प्रतिबिंबित होतात.
अ. आरोग्य
ब. उत्पन्न
क. शिक्षण
ड. राहणीमान
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Multidimensional Poverty Index तीन आयामांवर आधारित — आरोग्य, शिक्षण आणि जीवनमान — उत्पन्न स्वतंत्र आयाम नाही. विधान (b) चुकीचे आहे उत्पन्न जोडते; (a), (c) व (d) एकत्र MPI ची रचना दर्शवतात.

questions.text: सप्टेंबर 2001 मध्ये जवाहर ग्राम समृद्धी योजना आणि रोजगार शाश्वती योजना __________ या योजनेत एकत्रित करण्यात आल्या.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. सप्टेंबर 2001 मध्ये Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana आणि Employment Assurance Scheme यांचे Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) मध्ये विलीनीकरण झाले. SGSY आणि PM Gramoday वेगळ्या पिढीच्या योजना होत्या.

questions.text: वित्तीय जबाबदारी आणि अंदाजपत्रक व्यवस्थापन कायदा, 2003 (एफ आर बी एम कायदा, 2003) असे नमूद करतो की केंद्र सरकारने __________ पर्यंत महसूली तूट दूर करण्यासाठी योग्य उपाययोजना करणे आवश्यक आहे.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. मूळ FRBM कायदा, 2003 नुसार केंद्र सरकारने revenue deficit 2008–09 पर्यंत शून्य करणे अपेक्षित होते (आणि fiscal deficit 3% पर्यंत). नंतरच्या दुरुस्त्या लक्ष्ये बदलली, पण कायदा म्हणजे 2008–09.

questions.text: भारतातील पहिल्या सोन्याच्या एटीएम चे उद्घाटन कोणत्या शहरात करण्यात आले?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. भारतातील पहिला gold ATM हैदराबादात (2022 च्या शेवटी GRT Jewellers) सुरू झाला, डिजिटल पेमेंटवर नाणी व लहान दंडे देतो. वाराणसी, लखनऊ, कोची शक्य शहरे आहेत पण प्रक्षेपण शहर नाहीत.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणाला राजीव गांधी खेलरत्न पुरस्कार 2020 ने सन्मानित करण्यात आले?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. रोहित शर्मा यांना 2020 साठी Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna (आता Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna) मिळाले — समारंभ महामारीमुळे उशीरा झाला, पण पुरस्कार वर्ष 2020 होता. तेंदुलकर, धोनी, कोहली यांना आधीच्या चक्रात सन्मान मिळाले होते.

questions.text: 2020 मधील लॉकडाऊन दरम्यान, कृषी व शेतकरी कल्याण मंत्रालयाने कृषी उत्पादनांच्या सुलभ वाहतुकीसाठी हे मोबाईल ॲप्लिकेशन सुरू केले.
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. 2020 लॉकडाउन दरम्यान कृषी मंत्रालयाने Kisan Rath अॅप सुरू केले, शेतकरी-व्यापारी व वाहतूक प्रदाते जोडून क्षयशील उत्पादने हलवण्यासाठी. Kisan Express आणि Krishi Network नाव-सारख्या फसवणुका.

questions.text: पद्मविभूषण पुरस्काराने सन्मानित झालेल्या प्रभा अत्रे कोणत्या क्षेत्राशी संबंधित आहेत?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. प्रभा आत्रे — हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय संगीताची दिग्गज — यांना Padma Vibhushan मिळाले; त्या Kirana घराण्यातील गायिका, साहित्यिक/खेळाडू/नोकरशहा नाहीत.

questions.text: 2022 मध्ये आयोजित 'अखिल भारतीय राजभाषा परिषदेचे' यजमान कोणते शहर आहे?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. 2022 मधील All-India Official Language Conference सुरत (गुजरात) येथे झाली, राजभाषा अंमलबजावणीवर काम करणाऱ्या विभागांचा मेळावा. अहमदाबाद, मुंबई, पुणे मोठी शहरे आहेत पण त्या वर्षाचे स्थळ नाहीत.

questions.text: विस्डेनने 21 व्या शतकातील भारताचा सर्वात मौल्यवान कसोटी खेळाडू म्हणून कोणाला निवडले आहे?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Wisden ने रवींद्र जडेजा यांना 21 व्या शतकातील भारताचा सर्वात मौल्यवान कसोटी खेळाडू म्हणून निवडले — फलंदाजी, गोलंदाजी व क्षेत्ररक्षणाचा संयुक्त परिणाम. कोहली/धोनी मर्यादित षटकांत; अश्विन स्पिन स्पर्धक, पण Wisden निवड जडेजा.

questions.text: कोणती संस्था 'ॲन्‌युअल स्टेटस ऑफ एज्युकेशन रिपोर्ट' (ASER) प्रसिद्ध करते?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. मुंबईतील Pratham ही NGO दरवर्षी Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) प्रकाशित करते, ग्रामीण मुलांच्या शिक्षण व अध्ययन परिणामांचा सर्वेक्षण. NITI Aayog, Oxfam, UNICEF संबंधित काम करतात पण ASER प्रकाशित करत नाहीत.

questions.text: कोणत्या संस्थेने आण्विक सुरक्षेवर उच्चस्तरीय किव्ह-मॉस्को संवाद स्थापन केला?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) ने 2022 च्या संघर्षानंतर Ukraine च्या अणुऊर्जा सुविधांभोवती धोके वाढल्यामुळे Kyiv–Moscow Dialogue on Nuclear Safety सुरू केली. UNICEF, IMF, UNSC वेगळ्या कार्यक्षेत्राचे.

questions.text: कोव्हीड-19 या महामारीचा पहिला रुण भारतामध्ये केव्हा व कोठे आढळला?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. भारतातील पहिला पुष्ट COVID-19 रुग्ण 30 जानेवारी 2020 रोजी केरळात (वुहानहून परतलेला विद्यार्थी) नोंदवला. डिसेंबर 2019 तारखा भारताच्या वेळापत्रकापूर्वी; गोवा पहिले राज्य नव्हते.

questions.text: अल् मोहद-अल् हिंदी हा पहिला नौदल सराव खालीलपैकी कोणत्या दोन देशांमध्यान ऑगस्ट 2021 मध्ये पार पडला आहे?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Al-Mohed Al-Hindi — या नावाचा पहिला द्विपक्षीय naval exercise — ऑगस्ट 2021 मध्ये भारत व Saudi Arabia यांच्यात झाला. Iran, Oman, Afghanistan जोड्या प्रादेशिक फसवणुका — पहिला आवृत्ती रियाधसोबत.

questions.text: 21 ग्रँड स्लॅम जेते पदे जिंकणारा पहिला पुरुष टेनिस स्टार कोण आहे?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. Rafael Nadal 21 Grand Slam singles titles गाठणारा पहिला पुरुष ठरला (2022 Australian Open), Federer व Djokovic 20 वर होते. Agassi या संख्येपेक्षा खूप कमी.

questions.text: कोणत्या तंत्रज्ञान प्लॅटफॉर्म ने 'जागरूक व्होटर' मोहीम सुरू केली?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. Twitter (आता X) ने भारतात 'Jagruk Voter' मोहीम सुरू केली, मतदानापूर्वी जागरूक मतदानास प्रोत्साहन. Facebook, Microsoft, Google स्वतःची civic उपक्रम करतात पण ही branded मोहीम नाही.

questions.text: युद्धकाळात गाजविलेल्या असामान्य शौर्याबद्दल 2021 मध्ये अशोकचक्र हा सन्मान यांना मरणोत्तर प्रदान करण्यात आला.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. ASI Babu Ram यांना 2021 मध्ये Jammu & Kashmir मधील counter-insurgency ऑपरेशन्समधील अतुलनीय शौर्यासाठी Ashok Chakra (मरणोनंतर) मिळाला. Altaf Hussain Bhatt, Jyotikumar Nirala, Ashwini Kumar Dixit इतर संदर्भ/वर्षांत.

questions.text: 2021 – 22 चा ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार जिंकणारे मराठी साहित्यिक कोण होते?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. कोंकणी लेखक दामोदर माउजो यांना 2021 साठी Jnanpith (2022 मध्ये जाहीर) — गोव्यातील पहिले. Khandekar, Joshi, Karandikar आधीचे Marathi Jnanpith laureates.

questions.text: जागतिक तंबाखू विरोधी दिन पुरस्कार - 2022 साठी जागतिक आरोग्य संघटनेने कोणत्या भारतीय राज्याची निवड केली आहे?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. WHO ने World No Tobacco Day Award 2022 साठी झारखंड निवडले, राज्य-स्तरावर तंबाखू नियंत्रण उपायांसाठी. मध्य प्रदेश, छत्तीसगड, ओडिशा त्या वर्षी प्राप्तकर्ते नव्हते.

questions.text: महाधिवक्त्या बद्दल खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान असत्य आहे?

options.B: राज्यपालांनी त्यांना संदर्भित केलेल्या अशा कायदेशीर बाबींवर ते राज्यसरकारला सल्ला देतात
options.C: राज्यपालांनी त्यांना नेमून दिलेली कायदेशीर वैधिष्ट्ये असलेली अशी इतर कर्तव्ये ते पार पाडतात
options.D: संविधान किंवा इतर कोणत्याही कायद्याने त्यांना दिलेली कार्ये ते पार पाडतात

questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. कलम 165 नुसार राज्याचे महाधिवक्ता राज्यपाल नेमतात, राष्ट्रपती नाहीत — विधाने (2), (3) आणि (4) त्यांची कायदेशीर सल्लागार व कर्तव्ये बरोबर सांगतात.

questions.text: भारतातील उच्च न्यायालयाबाबत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर नाही?

options.A: उच्च न्यायालये 'जनहित याचिकांशी' संबंधित याचिका स्विकारू शकतात
options.B: उच्च न्यायालयाच्या प्रत्येक न्यायाधिशाची नियुक्ती राष्ट्रपती करतात
options.C: राज्याचे राज्यपाल उच्च न्यायालयाच्या न्यायाधिशांची नियुक्ती करतात
options.D: उच्च न्यायालयाच्या न्यायाधिशांचे निवृत्तीचे वय 62 आहे

questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. उच्च न्यायालयाचे न्यायाधीश राष्ट्रपती नेमतात — CJI आणि राज्यपालाच्या सल्ल्यानंतर; राज्यपाल नेमत नाहीत. PIL, राष्ट्रपतीची नियुक्ती आणि 62 वर्षांवर निवृत्ती — हे सर्व बरोबर.

questions.text: भारत सरकारकडून प्रत्येक वर्षी 24 एप्रिल हा दिवस खालीलपैकी कोणता दिवस म्हणून साजरा केला जातो?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. 73 व्या घटनादुरुस्ती 1993 मध्ये लागू झाल्याच्या स्मरणार्थ भारत सरकार 24 एप्रिल राष्ट्रीय पंचायत राज दिन म्हणून साजरा करते.

questions.text:
खालीलपैकी कोणत्या राज्यांमध्ये विधानपरिषद हे सभागृह नाही?
अ. बिहार
ब. कर्नाटक
क. केरळ
ड. राजस्थान
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. केरळ आणि राजस्थान येथे फक्त Vidhan Sabha — Vidhan Parishad नाही. बिहार आणि Karnataka मध्ये Vidhan Parishad आहे.

questions.text:
अचूक जोड्या लावा.
अ. 61 वी घटनादुरुस्ती → 1. राज्य लोक सेवा आयोगातील सदस्यांचे सेवा निवृत्तीचे वय 60 वरून 62 वर्षे
ब. 44 वी घटनादुरुस्ती → 2. त्रिस्तरीय पंचायत राज व्यवस्था
क. 41 वी घटनादुरुस्ती → 3. मतदाराचे वय 21 वरून 18 वर्षे केले
ड. 73 वी घटनादुरुस्ती → 4. राष्ट्रपती, उपराष्ट्रपती आणि पंतप्रधान यांच्या निवडणुकी विषयी चाद सर्वोच्च व उच्च न्यायालयात
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. घटनादुरुस्ती जुळवा: 61वी — मतदान वय 21 ते 18; 44वी — 42 नंतर आपातकालीन अधिकार मर्यादित; 41वी — SPSC सदस्यांचे निवृत्तीवय 62; 73वी — तीन-स्तरीय पंचायत राज. A–3, B–4, C–1, D–2.

questions.text:
सरपंचाचे अधिकार आणि कर्तव्ये याबाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या.
अ. ग्रामसभेत मंजुर झालेल्या ठरावांची अंमलबजावणी करणे.
ब. ग्रामपंचायतीच्या मालकीची मालमत्तेचे संरक्षण करणे.
क. ग्रामपंचायत क्षेत्रातील प्राथमिक शाळांवर देखरेख ठेवणे.
वरीलपैकी अयोग्य विधाने निवडा.
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. Sarpanch ला Gram Sabha ठराव लागू करणे आणि पंचायत मालमत्तेचे संरक्षण करणे अपेक्षित, पण प्राथमिक शाळांचे थेट supervision त्याच्या मुख्य कर्तव्यांमध्ये नाही — ते शिक्षण प्रशासनाचे क्षेत्र.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणा सरकारिया आयोगाचे सदस्य नव्हते?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. न्यायमूर्ती R.S. Sarkaria अध्यक्ष; B. Sivaraman आणि Dr S.R. Sen सदस्य. Rama Subramaniam Sarkaria आयोगात नव्हते — त्याऐवजी Rama Swamy होते.

questions.text: निवडणूक आयोगाची कर्तव्ये स्पष्ट करण्यासाठी कोणत्या कलमात सुधारणा करण्यात आली?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. उत्तरतालिका कलम 324 (भाग XV — निवडणूक) दर्शवते; या कलमातील दुरुस्तीने Election Commission ची भूमिका स्पष्ट केली, राष्ट्रपती/राज्यपालाच्या नियुक्ती अधिकारांवर परिणाम न होण्याची खात्री.

questions.text:
अचूक जोड्या लावा.
I. थॉमस हॉब्ज → अ. ॲंग्लो-आस्ट्रियन तत्त्वज्ञ
II. फ्रेडरिक हायेक → ब. फ्रेंच राज्यक्रांतीचा जनक
III. रॉबर्ट नॉझिक → क. ब्रिटिश तत्त्वज्ञ
IV. रूसो → ड. अमेरिकन तत्त्वज्ञ

options.A: I – ब, II – अ, III – ड, IV – क
options.B: I – क, II – अ, III – ड, IV – ब
options.C: I – ड, II – क, III – ब, IV – अ
options.D: I – ड, II – अ, III – ब, IV – क

questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. Hobbes ब्रिटिश (I–C), Hayek Anglo-Austrian (II–A), Nozick American (III–D), Rousseau French Revolution च्या विचारांशी (IV–B).

questions.text: भारताच्या संविधान परिषदेच्या कार्यविषयी समितीचे अध्यक्ष कोण होते?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. G.V. Mavalankar यांनी Committee on the Functions of the Constituent Assembly चे अध्यक्षपद सांभाळले — संविधान सभेच्या दैनंदिन कामकाजाची रचना करणारी समिती.

questions.text: संविधान परिषदेच्या सल्लागार शाखेने भारतीय राज्यघटनेचा पहिला मसुदा __________ मध्ये तयार केला.
