options.B: ते निश्चितपणे 92 मी. च्या सर्वात जास्त जवळ असणार.
options.C: ते निश्चितपणे 91 मीटरच्या सर्वात जास्त जवळ असणार.
options.D: ते निश्चितपणे 110 मी. पेक्षा कमी असणार.

questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. Positions: C (−40, 0), E (50, 20) — अंतर = √(90² + 20²) ≈ 92.2 m; पर्यायांमध्ये 92 m जवळ.

questions.text: A ही B ची मुलगी आहे, C ही A ची बहीण आहे, B ही D ची मुलगी आहे आणि E हा C चा भाऊ आहे. तर E व D मधील नातेसंबंध सांगा.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. A, C — B च्या मुली; E त्यांचा भाऊ — E, B चा मुलगा; B, D ची मुलगी — E, D चा grandson; D, E ची grandmother.

questions.text: एका संख्येतून 5 वजा करून 7 ने भागल्यास उत्तर 2 येते. तर त्या संख्येतून 4 वजा करून 3 ने भागल्यास उत्तर किती येईल?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A चिन्हांकित केला. (x − 5) ÷ 7 = 2 → x = 19; मग (19 − 4) ÷ 3 = 5 — आधी x काढा, नंतर दुसऱ्या expression मध्ये.

questions.text:
A, B, C आणि D हे मार्कच्या मळ्यात काम करतात. त्या सर्वांना मिळून त्याने एकूण वीस कलिंगडे दिली. त्यापैकी एकाला दोन मिळाली, दुसऱ्याला चार मिळाली, तिसऱ्याला सहा आणि चौथ्याला आठ मिळाली. A ला B पेक्षा जास्त कलिंगडे मिळाली. D ला C पेक्षा कमी कलिंगडे मिळाली. जर C ला D पेक्षा किमान दोन कलिंगडे जास्त मिळाली तर नेहमीच सत्य ठरेलच असे/अशी विधान/ने निवडा.
(a) A ला नेहमीच C पेक्षा जास्त कलिंगडे मिळतील.
(b) C ला कधीही A ला मिळाली तितकी कलिंगडे मिळणार नाहीत.
(c) D ला त्याच्या बरोबर काम करणाऱ्या कोणाही व्यक्तीपेक्षा जास्त कलिंगडे मिळणे शक्य नाही.
(d) B ला नेहमीच A पेक्षा कमी कलिंगडे मिळतील.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. Melons 2, 4, 6, 8; A > B दिले — B नेहमी A पेक्षा कमी. A ने C वर नेहमी नाही; D ला 6, दुसऱ्याला 8 शक्य.

questions.text:
C₁ आणि C₂ या दोन महाविद्यालयांतील एकूण 480 विद्यार्थ्यांचे ते वापरत असलेल्या संगणकाच्या प्रकाराबाबत सर्वेक्षण करण्यात आले. त्या सर्वेक्षणातून गोळा झालेली काही माहिती पुढील तक्त्यात दर्शविली आहे. C₁ आणि C₂ या महाविद्यालयातील विद्यार्थ्यांचे प्रमाण 9 : 7 आहे.

महाविद्यालय | डेस्कटॉप | लॅपटॉप | दोन्ही | कोणतेही नाही
C₁ | — | — | — | 15
C₂ | 120 | — | 30 | —
एकूण | — | 195 | 70 | 40

C₁ महाविद्यालयातील किती विद्यार्थ्यांकडे किमान एक प्रकारचा संगणक आहे?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय D. 480, ratio 9 : 7 → C₁ = 270; C₁ मध्ये 15 ला system नाही — किमान एक system = 270 − 15 = 255.

questions.text: परिसंवादासाठी जमलेल्या सहभागींपैकी 32 व्यक्ती चहा पितात, 35 व्यक्ती कॉफी पितात आणि 22 जण चहा आणि कॉफी पितात तर परिसंवादासाठी जमलेल्या व्यक्तींची संख्या निवडा.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. Inclusion–exclusion: 32 + 35 − 22 = 45 — फक्त tea, फक्त coffee, किंवा both.

questions.text:
एक भाग लपवलेला आहे अशी षटकोनाकार प्रतिमा पूर्ण करण्यासाठी प्रतलातील स्थिती न बदलता वा उलटवता ठेवण्यासाठी उचित त्रिकोणाकार प्रतिमा निवडा.
[आकृती: षटकोन सहा समभुज त्रिकोणांमध्ये विभागलेला; एक त्रिकोण लपवलेला (क्रॉस-हॅच). उर्वरित पाच त्रिकोणांमध्ये प्रत्येकी शिरस्थानी तीन चिन्हे — काळा भरलेला हिरा, पांढरा रिकामा हिरा, आणि घड्याळाच्या दिशेने वक्र बाण — परिभ्रमण पद्धतीने. चार उत्तर पर्याय उमेदवार त्रिकोण दर्शवितात.]
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A (figure मधील Option 1) चिन्हांकित केला. लपलेले triangle मध्ये solid diamond, hollow diamond, clockwise arrow — hexagonal pattern पूर्ण करणारा rotation; figure नसल्यास scoring साठी अधिकृत पर्याय.

questions.text:
दिलेल्या संख्या मालिकेतील प्रश्नचिन्हाऐवजी उचित पर्याय निवडा.
4, 13, 38, __?__, 168, 289, 458
समीरने जुना टि.व्ही. ₹ 4,700 ला विकत घेतला. त्यासाठी ₹ 800 दुरुस्ती खर्च झाला. त्याने तो ₹ 5,800 ला विकला तर त्याचा शेकडा नफा किती ?

समान उंचीचे दोन खांब 80 मी. रुंद असलेल्या रस्त्याच्या विरुद्ध दिशेला आहेत. त्या खांबांमधील रस्त्यावर असलेल्या एका बिंदूने त्यांच्या टोकांशी केलेला उन्नत कोन अनुक्रमे 60° व 30° आहेत. तर खांबांची उंची किती?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. समान poles, 80 m अंतर: point एका base पासून 20 m — height = 20 tan 60° = 20√3 m; 60° आणि 30° समान height.
थेट उत्तर — पर्याय D. प्रत्येक term = मागील × 2 + 1: 31 × 2 + 1 = 63; 63 → 127 → 255 → 511 same rule.

questions.text: स्वाती आणि प्रिती यांच्या आजच्या वयाचे गुणोत्तर 3 : 5 आहे. 7 वर्षांनंतर त्यांच्या वयाचे गुणोत्तर 11 : 16 होईल. तर प्रितीचे आजचे वय काय?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. सध्याचे वय 3x, 5x; 7 years नंतर (3x + 7)/(5x + 7) = 11/16 → x = 5; Priti = 5 × 5 = 25 years.

questions.text: एका रकमेवर दोन वर्षांकरिता 4% दराने मिळालेल्या चक्रवाढ व्याज व सरळ व्याज यातील फरक ₹ 8 आहे. तर ती रक्कम किती?
Who among the following has been awarded as the 'Best actor' (male) at the BRICS film festival 2021?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Dhanush won Best Actor (Male) at the BRICS Film Festival 2021 for 'Asuran'. Nawazuddin, Akshay Kumar, and Pankaj Tripathi were strong names in Indian cinema that year but did not take this particular award.

questions.text: Who is the first Indian Physicist to win the Prestigious Boltzmann Medal for the year 2022?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Professor Deepak Dhar became the first Indian physicist to receive the Boltzmann Medal in 2022, awarded by IUPAP for outstanding contributions to statistical physics. Ashok Kumar Barua, Bimla Buti, and D.D. Bhawalkar are respected physicists but not Boltzmann Medal winners.

questions.text: Who is the First Indian Woman to win two medals in the Tokyo 2020 (held in Aug-Sep 2021) Paralympics Games?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Avani Lekhara became the first Indian woman to win two Paralympic medals at Tokyo 2020 — gold in 10m air rifle SH1 and bronze in 50m rifle 3 positions SH1. Bhavina Patel also shone in table tennis but did not double-medal.

questions.text: Which Credit Scheme is launched for Prisoners of Yerwada Central Jail in 2022 as a Pilot Scheme?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Bank of Maharashtra launched 'Jivhala' as a pilot credit scheme for inmates of Yerwada Central Jail in 2022, helping them access formal banking on release. Sahanubhuti, Aage Badho, and Bank for Prisoners are distractors from other welfare contexts.

questions.text: As per Report 2021 of Global Observatory on Donation and Transplantation (GODT), India has been ranked _______ in Organ donation and transplantation in World.
questions.explanation: On this one, option C is correct. The Global Observatory on Donation and Transplantation (GODT) Report 2021 placed India third in the world for organ donation and transplantation activity. First and second are typically taken by leading Western and East Asian programmes — fifth is too low for India's volume.

questions.text: Who is the author of the book, 'Beyond Possible'?
questions.explanation: Go with option B. 'Beyond Possible' is the memoir of Nimsdai Purja, the Nepalese-British mountaineer who climbed all fourteen 8000-metre peaks in record time. Bernadette McDonald, Arunima Sinha, and Stephen Alter have written on mountains and adventure but not under this title.

questions.text: Which of the following option is associated with Amrit Sarovar Mission?
questions.explanation: Pick option A. Mission Amrit Sarovar aims to develop and rejuvenate at least 75 water bodies in every district — a water-conservation push tied to Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav. Soil conservation, air pollution, and fishery are separate government agendas.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are correct about the 'Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana'?
(a) This scheme is initiated by Delhi government in 2018.
(b) Any citizen of India can avail this scheme.
(c) Ayodhya is recently included in the list of places that one can visit under this scheme.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Delhi's Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana started in 2018 and later added Ayodhya to its pilgrimage list — so (a) and (c) hold. Statement (b) is incorrect because the scheme is for eligible Delhi residents, not any citizen of India.

questions.text: Rajiv Gandhi Orang National Park, which has been renamed as Orang National Park, is located in which Indian State?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Orang National Park — earlier Rajiv Gandhi Orang National Park — sits on the north bank of the Brahmaputra in Assam and is often called the 'Mini Kaziranga'. Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Uttarakhand host other famous parks but not Orang.

questions.text:
Select the correct statement/s - (India - Central Asia Summit)
(a) The First India - Central Asia Summit held in January, 2022
(b) Republic of Tajikistan, Republic of Uzbekistan were present for the Summit.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. The first India–Central Asia Summit was held virtually in January 2022, with leaders including the Presidents of Tajikistan and Uzbekistan among the five Central Asian republics invited. Both statements in the stem are therefore correct.

questions.text: Who has been appointed as a new Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog in May 2022?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Suman K. Bery was appointed Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog in May 2022, succeeding Rajiv Kumar. Ramesh Chand served as NITI member-agriculture; Jayati Ghosh and Rajiv Kumar held other roles but not this May 2022 vice-chair appointment.

questions.text: Which of the following Organisation is organising a special programme for school children called 'Young Scientist Programme' 'Yuva Vigyani Karyakram' 'YUVIKA'?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. ISRO runs YUVIKA — Yuva Vigyani Karyakram — a residential programme to groom school students in space science. UNICEF, BARC, and DRDO run youth or research initiatives but not this specific Young Scientist Programme.

questions.text: 'Remove laws that harm, create laws that empower' is the theme of which day?
questions.explanation: On this one, option A is correct. Zero Discrimination Day (1 March), observed by UNAIDS, carried the theme 'Remove laws that harm, create laws that empower'. World AIDS Day, World Equality Day, and World Social Justice Day use different annual themes.

questions.text: _______ has been appointed as the chairman of the ISRO, the Indian Space Research Institute in January, 2022.
questions.explanation: Go with option B. Dr S. Somnath took over as ISRO Chairman in January 2022, replacing Dr K. Sivan. Radhakrishnan and Prof. MGK Menon were earlier chairmen — useful timeline anchors when MPSC asks 'who in January 2022'.

questions.text: Which operation was launched by Punjab's Excise Department in 2020 to curb illicit liquor trading related crimes?
questions.explanation: Pick option B. Punjab's Excise Department launched Operation Red Rose in 2020 to crack down on illicit liquor trade and related crime. Black Cobra, Black Bull, and Prahar sound plausible but belong to other enforcement drives in different states or years.

questions.text: Which of the following amendments imposed restrictions on the Fundamental Rights of the citizens to protect the sovereignty and integrity of the country?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. The 16th Amendment (1963) added 'the sovereignty and integrity of India' as a ground to restrict freedoms under Article 19, tightening limits on speech and association. The 14th, 24th, and 39th Amendments dealt with citizenship, property, and emergency-era changes — not this specific restriction.

questions.text: What are all the nine Articles covered under Part XVII of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Part XVII of the Constitution covers the Official Language and runs from Article 343 to Article 351 — nine articles in all. The other ranges either spill into Part XVI on special provisions or start Part XVIII on emergency provisions.

questions.text: In which year the British accepted the demand for making the constituent assembly of India?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. The August Offer of 1940 was the first time the British formally accepted the principle of a constituent assembly for framing India's constitution. 1938–39 saw Congress demands but no acceptance; 1942 brought the Quit India movement, not this concession.

questions.text: _______ round-table conferences were held in London from 1930 to 1932 to see how best Indians could administer their country.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Three Round Table Conferences met in London between 1930 and 1932 to discuss constitutional reform and Indian self-government under the Simon Commission aftermath. Two or four conferences is a common count trap — memorise 'three' for MPSC chronology.

questions.text: According to the article 154 of the Indian Constitution executive power of State is vested in the hands of _______.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Article 154 vests the executive power of the State in the Governor, who exercises it either directly or through officers subordinate to him. The Chief Minister and Council of Ministers aid and advise the Governor — they do not hold the constitutional vesting clause.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Habeas-corpus → (i) To transfer a case from lower to higher court
(b) Mandamus → (ii) To look into legality of a post
(c) Quo warranto → (iii) To command authority to Perform its duty
(d) Certiorari → (iv) To look into legality of arrest
questions.explanation: On this one, option B is correct. Match the pairs: Habeas corpus checks the legality of detention — (iv); Mandamus commands a public authority to perform its duty — (iii); Quo warranto questions the legality of holding a public office — (ii); Certiorari transfers a case up or quashes a lower court's order — (i).

questions.text: According to article 243 E of the Indian Constitution every gram panchayat unless dissolved earlier under any law for the time being in force, shall continue for five years from _______.

options.A: the date of declaration of election results
options.B: the date of declaration of election
options.C: the date appointed for its first meeting after elections
options.D: the beginning of first financial year after the Panchayat elections

questions.explanation: Go with option C. Article 243E fixes the five-year term of a gram panchayat from the date appointed for its first meeting after elections — not from result declaration, poll day, or the next financial year. That first-meeting date is the statutory starting point.

questions.text: Fundamental duties were included on the recommendation of which Committee?
questions.explanation: Pick option C. The Swaran Singh Committee (1976) recommended inserting Fundamental Duties, which the 42nd Amendment added as Part IVA Article 51A. Devraj, Karan Singh, and Kripalani committees touched other constitutional reforms but not this list.

questions.text: Which of the following is not the functions of Gram Sevak?

options.A: Proper utilization of Gram Panchayat Funds
options.C: Collection of Various Taxes prescribed by the Government

questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Gram Sevaks routinely handle panchayat fund use, gram sabha reporting, and government-prescribed tax collection — all three listed items are standard duties. Since none of A, B, or C is a 'non-function', 'None of these' is the correct choice.

questions.text: By which Amendment the 11th Fundamental Duty was later added to the list? (51A(K))
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. The 11th Fundamental Duty — Article 51A(k), making parents/guardians provide education to children aged 6–14 — came through the 86th Amendment Act, 2002. The 42nd Amendment added the original ten duties in 1976; 52nd and 62nd dealt with anti-defection and reservation tenure.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are true about Narayan Meghaji Lokhande?
(a) Founder of Labour Movement
(b) Establishment of Bombay mill hands Association in 1884
(c) 'Raobahadur' award by the British Government
(d) Establishment of Maharashtra Labour Union
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande is remembered as a pioneer of the Bombay labour movement, he helped set up the Bombay Mill-Hands' Association (1884), and the British honoured him with the title 'Raobahadur' — statements (a), (b) and (c) stand. The Maharashtra Labour Union came much later and is not his work, so (d) drops out.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Rand and Ayerst's Murder → (i) V.D. Savarkar
(b) Abhinav Bharat → (ii) Anant Laxman Kanhere
(c) Justice Jackson's Murder → (iii) Madan Lal Dhingra
(d) Curzon Wyllies Murder → (iv) Chaphekar Brothers
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Pair each incident with its actor: Rand and Ayerst (Chapekar brothers), Abhinav Bharat (Savarkar), Justice Jackson (Anant Laxman Kanhere), Curzon Wyllie (Madan Lal Dhingra) — sequence (iv), (i), (ii), (iii).

questions.text:
Identify the person based on the following description:
(a) First Journalist in Marathi
(b) The teacher of Prince of Akkalkot
(c) Founder of Marathi Newspapers
(d) Director of Colaba Weather Observatory
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Balshastri Jambhekar edited the first Marathi newspaper Darpan, taught the Akkalkot prince, launched early Marathi journalism, and headed the Colaba Observatory — all four clues fit one name.

questions.text: In which Session of National Congress the two groups came together again?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. After the 1907 Surat split, Moderates and Extremists reunited at the Lucknow Session of 1916 under the joint leadership of Tilak and Annie Besant.

questions.text: Who was the Chairman of first All Bengal Students Council held in 1928?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. The inaugural All Bengal Students' Conference in September 1928 was presided over by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru; Pramod Kumar Ghoshal became president of the association itself, not chairman of that opening session.

questions.text: Name the Social Reformer who got married to a Widow?
questions.explanation: On this one, option D is correct. Maharshi Dhondo Keshav Karve married a widow in 1893 and made widow remarriage a lived example of his social-reform mission — the other names are reformers but not remembered chiefly for this act.

questions.text:
Deindustrialization of India in British Period means:
(a) Decline of Handicraft Industry in India
(b) Decline of Cottage Industry
(c) Development in rural life
(d) Development in agriculture
questions.explanation: Go with option A. 'Deindustrialisation' under British rule chiefly means the ruin of Indian handicrafts and cottage industries through factory competition and one-way trade — not rural uplift or agricultural 'development' in the positive sense.

questions.text:
Match the following:
Revolt Centre → Leadership
(a) Kolhapur → (i) Appasaheb Patvardhan
(b) Jamkhandi → (ii) Chimasaheb
(c) Aurangabad → (iii) Babasaheb Bhave
(d) Nargund → (iv) Phida Ali
questions.explanation: Pick option B. Per the official answer, the 1857 revolt centres map as Kolhapur–Chimasaheb, Jamkhandi–Appasaheb Patvardhan, Aurangabad–Phida Ali, Nargund–Babasaheb Bhave — code (ii), (i), (iv), (iii). Match from the list the paper gave rather than reshuffling from memory.

questions.text: Who was the first Indian Lady, who received Degree in Medical Science in America?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Anandibai Joshi graduated from the Women's Medical College of Pennsylvania in 1886 — the first Indian woman to earn a medical degree in America.

questions.text:
Which of the following programmes were started by Mahatma Gandhi with Non-cooperation Movement?
(a) To Propagate Swadeshi
(b) Hindu - Muslim Unity
(c) Prohibition of liquor
(d) Removal of Untouchability
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Gandhi linked the Non-cooperation Movement with swadeshi propaganda, Hindu–Muslim unity, liquor prohibition, and the fight against untouchability — all four programmes were on his agenda.

questions.text: Which institution was formed with a view to provide Political Education to the People?
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The printed key pointed to Deccan Sabha (A) before MPSC withdrew the item; some textbooks credit Sarvajanik Sabha for political education, so do not count it in scoring.

questions.text: Where was the first Revolt of the Peasants occured on 12th May, 1875?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. The Deccan agrarian disturbances of 1875 began on 12 May at Supe (Supa) in Pune district when peasants attacked moneylenders' shops and debt bonds — the spark for the wider riots.

questions.text:
Which of the following Famous Personalities were produced by 'Bharat Sevak Samaj'?
(a) Shrinivas Shastri
(b) Pandit Hridaynath Kunjru, Thakkarbappa
(c) N.M. Joshi, Kakasaheb Limaye
(d) Vishnushastri Chiplunkar, Keshavrao Bagde
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Bharat Sevak Samaj (1915) nurtured social workers such as Shrinivas Shastri, Hridaynath Kunjru and Thakkarbappa, and trade-union figures like N.M. Joshi and Kakasaheb Limaye — not Chiplunkar or Bagde.

questions.text: Which Commission was appointed by the Bombay Government to inquire into the on going Peasant discontent in the South?
questions.explanation: On this one, option B is correct. Alarmed by peasant violence in the Deccan, the Bombay Government appointed the Deccan Riots Commission (1876) to probe the causes of the 1875 disturbances.

questions.text: Who was the President of 'Asprushyata Nivarak Parishad' held in Mumbai in 1918?
questions.explanation: Go with option C. Maharshi Vitthal Ramji Shinde organised the Asprushyata Nivarak Parishad at Bombay in March 1918 and Maharaja Sayajirao Gaikwad presided over the session.

questions.text: Which of the following state has more geographical area?
questions.explanation: Pick option A. Rajasthan covers about 3.42 lakh sq km — the largest state by geographical area among the four listed; Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh all rank below it.

questions.text: Which of the following State Shares its boundary with two Countries?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Mizoram shares international borders with Bangladesh and Myanmar — two countries; Tripura, Manipur and Nagaland each touch only one foreign neighbour in this set.

questions.text:
Match the following:
Iron and Steel Industry → State
(a) Bokaro → (i) Karnataka
(b) Durgapur → (ii) Odisha
(c) Rourkela → (iii) West Bengal
(d) Bhadrawati → (iv) Bihar
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Bokaro lies in Bihar (now Jharkhand), Durgapur in West Bengal, Rourkela in Odisha, and Bhadrawati in Karnataka — sequence (iv), (iii), (ii), (i).

questions.text: Which of the following is the correct descending order of mountain peaks according to their heights in Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Kalsubai (1646 m) tops Maharashtra, followed by Salher, then Mahabaleshwar and Trimbakeshwar in descending height — the order the key expects.

questions.text: As per Census 2011, which of the following district has high sex-ratio?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Census 2011 placed Satara among the higher sex-ratio districts of Maharashtra — well above Aurangabad, Buldhana and Jalgaon in that comparison.

questions.text:
Match the correct pairs of Hot water spring and its locational districts in Maharashtra:
(a) Salbardi → (i) Jalgaon
(b) Sav → (ii) Thane
(c) Vajreshwari → (iii) Raigad
(d) Changdev → (iv) Amaravati
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Per the official answer: Salbardi–Amravati, Sav–Raigad, Vajreshwari–Thane, Changdev–Jalgaon — code (iv), (iii), (ii), (i). If your district list differs slightly, defer to the official answer for this item.

questions.text: Which district is largest and smallest in terms of geographical area in Aurangabad administrative division?
questions.explanation: On this one, option B is correct. Within the Aurangabad administrative division, Beed is the largest district by area and Hingoli the smallest — the pair the official answer selects.

questions.text: In which mountain range of Maharashtra 'Asthamba Peak' is located?
questions.explanation: Go with option C. Asthamba peak (about 1,325 m) stands in the Satpuda range at Nandurbar — not in the Sahyadri, Harishchandra or Mahadev sub-ranges of western Maharashtra.

questions.text: How many districts of Maharashtra have borders with state of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Pick option C. Seven Maharashtra districts touch Karnataka: Nanded, Latur, Osmanabad (Dharashiv), Solapur, Sangli, Kolhapur and Sindhudurg — a standard border-count fact for MPSC maps.

questions.text: One inch air pressure means how much?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. One inch of mercury column equals roughly 33.86 millibars, rounded to 34 mb in exam keys — not the smaller values in options A and B.

questions.text:
Observe the following statements:
(a) The existence of jet streams in 30° to 40° North latitudes belt is responsible for blowing of Monsoon winds in India.
(b) The Vast continental area of India is responsible for blowing of Monsoon winds.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. The subtropical westerly jet over the 30°–40° N belt shifts north in summer and helps pull the monsoon trough inland, while India's huge landmass heats up faster than the surrounding oceans and builds the low-pressure engine that draws in moist winds. Both mechanisms work together in standard monsoon theory.

questions.text:
Which city/cities in Maharashtra Mumbai-Agra highway does not pass through?
(a) Amalner (b) Daund (c) Nashik (d) Dhule
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The Mumbai–Agra highway (NH 3 corridor) runs through Nashik and Dhule in north Maharashtra, but it does not pass Amalner or Daund — Amalner sits on a Dhule–Jalgaon branch route and Daund lies on the Pune–Mumbai line. Only (a) and (b) are off the main Agra road.

questions.text: The first railway to run on electricity in Maharashtra _______.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. India's first electric train service started on 3 February 1925 between Bombay (Mumbai) and Kurla on the Harbour line — that is the landmark date for Maharashtra. Byculla–Thane and Dadar–Borivali sections were electrified in later phases, not as the inaugural run.

questions.text: Nannaj Sanctuary in Solapur district is famous for which bird?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Nannaj Bird Sanctuary near Solapur is a stronghold of the Great Indian Bustard, locally called Maldhok — one of the rarest grassland birds in India. Peacocks and flamingos draw tourists elsewhere; this reserve is bustard country.

questions.text:
The Jyotiba Mountain in Kolhapur district is recognised as _______.
(a) Wadi Ratnagiri (b) Karvir (c) Panhala (d) The hill of Kedareshwar
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Jyotiba hill in Kolhapur district is traditionally known as Wadi Ratnagiri — the sacred hill of the Jyotiba temple. Karvir is the old name for Kolhapur town, Panhala is a separate fort-hill, and Kedareshwar labels another shrine, not this peak.

questions.text:
Repo rate is the rate at _______.
(1) Commercial banks lend to public
(2) The rate which is charged for Government lending
(3) R.B.I. lends to commercial banks
(4) The rate is charged on saving deposits with commercial banks
questions.explanation: On this one, option C is correct. Repo (repurchase) rate is the short-term lending rate at which the RBI supplies funds to commercial banks against government securities — it is the headline policy rate, not the rate banks charge the public or pay on savings deposits.

questions.text:
Which of the following is not the reason for Population Explosion in India?
(a) Illiteracy (b) The Universalization of Marriage
(c) Joint Family System (d) Upliftment in Life Style
questions.explanation: Go with option D. Illiteracy, early universal marriage, and the joint-family norm all push larger family sizes and faster population growth. Rising lifestyle and education usually delay marriage and cut fertility — so upliftment in lifestyle is not a driver of population explosion.

questions.text: When was the FRBM Act brought into effect?
questions.explanation: Pick option D. Parliament passed the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act in 2003, and its operational provisions took effect from 5 July 2004 — that notification date is what MPSC keys. January 2000 and December 2003 are near-miss distractors around the rollout.

questions.text: On July 19, 1969 fourteen commercial banks with deposits worth ₹ _______ or more were nationalised.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. On 19 July 1969 the Union government nationalised fourteen major commercial banks whose deposits stood at ₹50 crore or more — the threshold written in every banking-history note. ₹75 crore and ₹100 crore are scaled-up distractors.

questions.text:
Which of the following is the department of Public Finance?
(a) Public Expenditure (b) Public Revenue
(c) Public Debt (d) Public Health
Which of the above statement/s is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Public finance covers how the government raises money (public revenue), spends it (public expenditure), and handles borrowing (public debt). Public health is a programme sector, not a branch of public-finance theory — so (a), (b), and (c) fit, not (d).

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The population density of India in 2011 was 382 per sq. km.
(b) As per the census 2011, the literacy rate in the country is 73.0 percent.
(c) The sex ratio in the country has always remained favourable to females.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are incorrect?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Census 2011 did put India's density at 382 per sq km and overall literacy at about 73% — those figures check out. Only Statement (c) is incorrect: India's sex ratio has long been male-heavy (fewer females per 1,000 males), not continuously favourable to females.

questions.text: Credit Authorisation Scheme was introduced in _______.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. RBI introduced the Credit Authorisation Scheme in November 1965 to vet large bank advances during the credit-squeeze era — before later liberalisation. The 1979, 1980, and 1982 dates belong to other monetary reforms.

questions.text: Money Market faces shortage of funds due to:
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. When household and corporate saving stays low, the money market — the market for short-term funds — cannot meet the demand for working capital and trade credit. Growing cash demand and an unorganised sector add friction, but inadequate saving is the textbook root cause here.

questions.text:
Capital Receipt of State Government includes _______.
(a) Market loans
(b) Borrowing from Central Government
(c) Small Saving of the public and provident fund contribution
(d) G.S.T. share from Central Government
Which of the above option is correct?
questions.explanation: On this one, option C is correct. State capital receipts are borrowings and similar inflows: market loans (a), loans from the Centre (b), and small savings plus provident-fund flows (c). GST devolution from the Union is a revenue receipt — a tax share — not capital receipt, so (d) drops out.

questions.text: Public Expenditure of any Government shows following trend:
questions.explanation: Go with option B. As economies develop, governments take on welfare, defence, infrastructure, and subsidy bills — so public expenditure almost everywhere shows a long-run rising trend, not a flat, falling, or purely random path.

questions.text: Which Committee was appointed in 2011-2012 to re-examine the issue of poverty?
questions.explanation: Pick option D. The C. Rangarajan Committee (2011–12) was asked to revisit poverty-line estimation after the Tendulkar line drew criticism — it recommended higher rural and urban poverty thresholds. Lakdawala and Chakravarty belong to earlier poverty-measurement exercises.

questions.text: How much calories does a rural Indian man need from his daily diet?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Planning-Commission poverty norms used 2,400 kilocalories per day for a rural adult man as the minimum energy requirement — 2,000 is closer to sedentary urban norms, and 2,500–2,750 are upper-band distractors.

questions.text: By which financial institution, monetary policy is implemented in India?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Monetary policy — repo, bank rate, CRR, SLR, open-market operations — is formulated and executed by the Reserve Bank of India. LIC, UTI, and co-operative banks are financial intermediaries, not the nation's monetary authority.

questions.text: National Oilseeds Development Project (NODP) was launched in the year _______.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. The National Oilseeds Development Project (NODP) was launched in 1985–86 to expand area, productivity, and processing for oilseeds under the Technology Mission framework. The 1980–81 and 1989–90 windows are year-shift distractors.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) Reserve Bank of India use the Dear Money Policy during the period of inflation.
(b) Reserve Bank of India use the Cheap Money Policy during the period of depression.
(c) The R.B.I. started with a Cheap Money Policy with a Bank rate of 3% in 1951.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Dear money (tighter, costlier credit) fights inflation; cheap money (lower bank rate, easier credit) supports recovery in a depression — and RBI did pursue a cheap-money phase with a 3% bank rate around 1951. All three statements match standard RBI history.

questions.text: _______ are used to know the speed of any vehicle.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Speedometers and similar gauges use eddy currents — when a rotating magnet moves near a metal disc, induced eddy currents create a drag proportional to speed, and the dial reads that effect. Ordinary conduction or bare magnetic induction alone does not drive the meter.

questions.text: A normal eye is not able to see objects closer than 25 cm because:

options.A: the focal length of the eye is 25 cm.
options.B: the distance of the retina from the eye-lens is 25 cm.
options.C: the eye is not able to decrease the distance between the eye-lens and the retina beyond a limit.
options.D: the eye is not able to decrease the focal length beyond a limit.

questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The official option A (focal length equals 25 cm) conflicts with standard optics: the 25 cm near point arises because the ciliary muscles cannot shorten the eye-lens focal length beyond a limit — option D is the textbook reason. MPSC withdrew the item rather than score one letter.

questions.text: Whenever there is a relative motion between a source of sound and an observer, there is apparent change in Frequency of a sound emitted by a source and as heard by the observer. This is called _______.
questions.explanation: On this one, option C is correct. When a sound source and observer move relative to each other, the heard frequency shifts — higher on approach, lower on receding. That is the Doppler effect; Huygens, Joule, and Raman describe diffraction, heating, and scattering, not motion-induced pitch change.

questions.text: Which of the following element was responsible for Minamata epidemic caused in Japan?
questions.explanation: Go with option D. The Minamata disaster in Japan (1950s–60s) came from industrial mercury (Hg) dumped into Minamata Bay, which biomagnified through fish and caused severe neurological disease. Gold (Au), platinum (Pt), and silver (Ag) were not the toxic agents in that epidemic.

questions.text: Phosphorous pentachloride formed by _______ hybridisation.
questions.explanation: Pick option D. Phosphorus in PCl₅ forms five σ-bonds with no lone pair on the central atom — trigonal bipyramidal geometry — so the hybridisation is sp³d. sp²d and sp²d² under-count bond directions; sp³d² fits octahedral six-coordinate molecules such as SF₆, not PCl₅.

questions.text: If the valence shell of an element has only one electron having the following set of quantum numbers: n = 2, l = 0, m = 0, s = +1/2, then the element is _______.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. n = 2, l = 0, m = 0, s = +½ describes a 2s electron; with only one valence electron that configuration belongs to lithium (1s² 2s¹).

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Salamander → (i) Poikilothermic
(b) Duckbilled Platypus → (ii) Sanguivorous
(c) Leech → (iii) Asymmetrical
(d) Paramecium → (iv) Egg laying mammal
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Salamander is poikilothermic, duck-billed platypus is an egg-laying mammal, leech is sanguivorous, and Paramecium shows asymmetry — giving (i), (iv), (ii), (iii).

questions.text: In heteroneresis the gonads are developed in the posterior part of the body. These gonads bearing segments are called:
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. In heteronereis the posterior, gonad-bearing swimming segments formed during reproduction are called epitokes; the anterior non-reproductive part is the atoke.

questions.text: Which of the following fish belongs to class Osteichthyes?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Catla is a bony fish (class Osteichthyes); shark, sting ray and electric ray belong to cartilaginous fishes (Chondrichthyes).

questions.text:
_______ insecticide is present in neem plant.
(a) DDT (b) Azadirachtin (c) Aldrin (d) B.H.C.
Which of the option/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Neem's natural insecticidal compound is azadirachtin — not DDT, aldrin or BHC, which are synthetic organochlorines.

questions.text:
A plant that does not produce fruit is called _______.
(a) acarpous (b) fertile (c) apocarpus (d) parthenocarpus
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Acarpous means a plant that does not set fruit; fertile, apocarpous and parthenocarpic describe other reproductive conditions.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
Statement I: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) is a microbial pesticide.
Statement II: Beaveria bassiana is a fungus used as a pesticide.

options.A: Statement I is correct and Statement II is incorrect
options.B: Statement I is incorrect and Statement II is correct

questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Bacillus thuringiensis is a bacterial bio-pesticide, and Beauveria bassiana is a fungus used similarly — both statements hold.

questions.text: The search for effective Malarial Vaccine is hampered due to the fact that:

options.A: Plasmodium lives inside cells hidden from immune response
options.C: Plasmodium requires two hosts to complete life cycle

questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Vaccine development against malaria is hard because Plasmodium hides inside host cells and also switches its surface antigens — both hurdles apply.

questions.text: Which of the following WBC type has lowest percentage in blood of healthy human?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Among normal WBC types, basophils form the smallest fraction (well under 1%), below lymphocytes, monocytes and eosinophils.

questions.text:
How does Insulin reduces blood glucose?
(a) Promoting uptake of glucose (b) Glycogen formation
(c) Protein synthesis (d) Fat storage
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Insulin lowers blood glucose by promoting cellular uptake, glycogen synthesis, protein synthesis and fat storage — all four routes count.

questions.text:
According to the available data, quantum of pollution caused by various categories of vehicles on the road of certain city reveals that the private four wheeler vehicles cause the maximum pollution, this is followed by the pollution caused by the buses, the trucks and finally the two wheelers.
(a) The number of two wheelers is less than the number of four wheelers plying on the city roads.
(b) Pollution caused by a single private vehicle would be more than the pollution caused by any single bus.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Total pollution by vehicle category depends on fleet size and per-trip emissions together — you cannot infer either vehicle counts or per-vehicle pollution from totals alone.

questions.text: A person walks along a road having lamp post at regular intervals. He took 6 minutes to walk from the first to fourth lamp post. At which lamp post would the person be if he walked continuously at a constant rate for 20 minutes?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. First to fourth post spans three equal gaps in 6 minutes, so one gap takes 2 minutes; 20 minutes covers ten gaps from the start — the 11th lamp post.

questions.text:
[Passage based] There is an increased demand for fish as it is a good source of protein. About 70% of world's marine fish stocks are now overfished. Aquaculture is continuously expanded but it is necessary to manage environmental risks. For this the aquaculture sector needs to devise effective and environment friendly methods.
Select the most appropriate conclusion:

options.A: People should adopt total vegan diet for avoiding environmental problems.
options.B: Aquaculture of predator fishes should be banned till other environment friendly devise is designed for rearing them.
options.C: People should consume freshwater fish varieties to avoid pressure on oceans.
options.D: The farming of only certain kind of varieties is damaging the biodiversity of ecosystems.

questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. The passage stresses managing aquaculture's environmental risks; banning predator-fish farming until safer rearing methods exist follows that logic most closely.

questions.text: Ashok jumped higher than Mohan but not higher than Chetan. Naresh jumped higher than Krishna but not as high as that of Mohan. Then what is the correct descending order of players considering their jump?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Chetan > Ashok > Mohan from the first clue, and Mohan > Naresh > Krishna from the second — full order: Chetan, Ashok, Mohan, Naresh, Krishna.

questions.text: Some persons are sitting on a bench. V is sitting next to An and S is next to G. G is not sitting with Aj. Aj is on the left end of the bench and S is in second position from right hand end. V is on the right side of An and to the right side of Aj. V and S are sitting together. If G and V exchange their positions select the statement that is not true.

options.A: Positions cannot be ascertained as the direction they face is not known.
options.D: An occupies the second position from one of the end.

questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. With Aj at the left end and the other conditions, the row fixes as Aj–An–V–S–G; after G and V swap, positions are known — so saying they 'cannot be ascertained' is the false statement.

questions.text: If 10 people can do a piece of work in 5 days, working 2 hours a day, how long will 2 people take to do the same work, working 5 hours a day?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Total work = 10 × 5 × 2 = 100 person-hours; two workers at 5 hours/day supply 10 person-hours daily, so 100 ÷ 10 = 10 days.

questions.text:
Given below are 5 statements followed by options composed of 3 statements put together in a specific order. Choose the option that indicates logically valid argument.
(a) Some vehicles are not hazardous to the environment.
(b) Vehicular traffic leads to emission of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
(c) Carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases are hazardous to the environment.
(d) Some vehicular traffic does not emit Carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
(e) Vehicular traffic is hazardous to the environment.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Greenhouse gases harm the environment (c); vehicular traffic emits them (b); therefore traffic is environmentally hazardous (e) — a valid chain in that order.

questions.text:
Replace the question mark (?) by an appropriate alternative in the following series:
32, 33, 37, 46, 62, ___?___
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Successive gaps are +1, +4, +9, +16 (squares of 1–4); the next add-on is +25, so 62 + 25 = 87.

questions.text: The average age of three person is 60 years. Their ages are in the ratio of 2 : 3 : 4. What is the difference between the ages of the youngest and the eldest person?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Ages in ratio 2: 3: 4 with average 60 give 40, 60 and 80 years — the youngest–eldest gap is 40 years.

questions.text:
A street vendor sold 2 dolls more than half the number of dolls she has on one day. The next day she sold 2 dolls less than half of the remaining dolls available with her. If she was left with 26 dolls.
Select the number of dolls she did initially have.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. If she started with 100 dolls, day-one sale leaves 48; day-two sale (half minus 2 of 48) leaves exactly 26 — working backwards confirms 100.

questions.text: If the ratio of two numbers is 3 : 4 and the sum of their squares is 400, then which are these numbers?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Numbers 3k and 4k give 9k² + 16k² = 25k² = 400, so k = 4 and the pair is 12 and 16.

questions.text: Neha's salary was first reduced by 10% and then increased by 30% due to upturn. So what percent increase in original salary?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. A 10% cut then 30% rise on the reduced salary gives 0.9 × 1.3 = 1.17, i.e. a net 17% increase over the original.

questions.text: Soma moves 10 km to East and then turns to South and moves 2 km. He again turn East and walks 2 km. After this, he turns to North and walks 7 km. Then the distance from his starting point to the present point is _______.

options.D: Can not be determined from the given data

questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Net displacement is 12 km east and 5 km north from the start (√(12² + 5²) = 13 km), using east–west and north–south legs as given.

questions.text: The difference between the simple and compound interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹ 750. What is the sum?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. For 2 years the compound-minus-simple interest gap equals P × (R/100)² = P × 0.01; with ₹750 difference, P = ₹75,000.
The examiner has marked option C. Factor the sum: 1/(856×592) + 1/(856×264) − 1/(592×264) simplifies to 856/(856×592×264) − 856/(856×592×264) = 0.

title: MPSC गट-क सेवा संयुक्त पूर्व परीक्षा 2022 (मराठी)

questions.text: 2021 च्या ब्रिक्स फिल्म फेस्टिवल मध्ये खालीलपैकी कोणाला उत्कृष्ट पुरुष अभिनेत्याचा पुरस्कार मिळाला?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. Dhanush यांना 'Asuran' साठी BRICS Film Festival 2021 मध्ये Best Actor (Male) पुरस्कार मिळाला. Nawazuddin, Akshay Kumar, Pankaj Tripathi त्या वर्षी भारतीय चित्रपटात मोठे नाव होते, पण हा विशिष्ट पुरस्कार त्यांना नव्हता.

questions.text: 2022 सालचे प्रतिष्ठित बोल्ट्झमन पदक प्राप्त करणारे पहिले भारतीय भौतिकशास्त्रज्ञ कोण आहेत?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Professor Deepak Dhar 2022 मध्ये Boltzmann Medal मिळवणारे पहिले भारतीय भौतिकशास्त्रज्ञ झाले — IUPAP ने statistical physics मध्ये उत्कृष्ट योगदानासाठी. Ashok Kumar Barua, Bimla Buti, D.D. Bhawalkar नामवंत भौतिकशास्त्रज्ञ, पण Boltzmann Medal विजेते नाहीत.

questions.text: टोकियो 2020 (प्रत्यक्षात ऑगस्ट-सप्टेंबर 2021 मध्ये झालेल्या) पॅरालिम्पिक गेम्स मध्ये दोन पदके जिंकणारी पहिली भारतीय महिला कोण आहे?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. Avani Lekhara Tokyo 2020 Paralympics मध्ये दोन पदके जिंकणारी पहिली भारतीय महिला — 10m air rifle SH1 मध्ये सुवर्ण, 50m rifle 3 positions SH1 मध्ये कांस्य. Bhavina Patel table tennis मध्ये चमकल्या, पण दोन पदके नव्हती.

questions.text: येरवडा मध्यवर्ती कारागृहातील कैद्यांसाठी 2022 मध्ये कोणती ऋण योजना प्रायोगिक तत्वावर सुरू करण्यात आली?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Bank of Maharashtra ने 2022 मध्ये Yerwada Central Jail कैद्यांसाठी 'Jivhala' ही pilot credit scheme सुरू केली — सुटकेनंतर formal banking मिळवण्यासाठी. Sahanubhuti, Aage Badho, Bank for Prisoners इतर कल्याण योजनांच्या संदर्भातील फसवणुका.

questions.text: ग्लोबल ऑब्झर्वेटरी ऑन डोनेशन ॲन्ड ट्रान्सप्लटेशन (GODT) या संस्थेच्या 2021 च्या अहवालानुसार अवयवदान आणि प्रत्यारोपणामध्ये भारताचा जगात _________ क्रमांक आहे.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणता पर्याय अमृत सरोवर मोहीमेशी संबंधित आहे?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. Mission Amrit Sarovar प्रत्येक जिल्ह्यात किमान 75 water bodies विकसित/पुनरुज्जीवित करण्यासाठी — Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav शी जोडलेले water conservation. Soil conservation, air pollution, fishery वेगळ्या सरकारी agenda.

questions.text:

questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. Delhi ची Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana 2018 मध्ये सुरू, नंतर Ayodhya यादीत — (a) व (c) बरोबर. विधान (b) चुकीचे; ही योजना पात्र Delhi रहिवाशांसाठी, भारतातील कोणत्याही नागरिकासाठी नाही.

questions.text: राजीव गांधी ओरांग राष्ट्रीय उद्यान, ज्याचे नाव ओरांग राष्ट्रीय उद्यान असे करण्यात आले आहे, ते कोणत्या भारतीय राज्यात आहे?

questions.text:

questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. पहिला India–Central Asia Summit January 2022 मध्ये virtual; Tajikistan, Uzbekistan सह पाच Central Asian republics नेते. प्रश्न मधील दोन्ही विधाने बरोबर.

questions.text: मे 2022 मध्ये नीती आयोगाच्या उपाध्यक्षपदी खालीलपैकी कोणाची नियुक्ती करण्यात आली?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Suman K. Bery May 2022 मध्ये NITI Aayog चे Vice Chairman — Rajiv Kumar यांच्यानंतर. Ramesh Chand NITI member-agriculture; Jayati Ghosh, Rajiv Kumar इतर भूमिका, May 2022 vice-chair नियुक्ती नाही.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणती संस्था शाळेय मुलांसाठी 'यंग सायंटिस्ट प्रोग्राम' 'युवा विज्ञानी कार्यक्रम' 'युविका' नावाचा विशेष कार्यक्रम आयोजित करत आहे?

options.A: युनिसेफ - संयुक्त राष्ट्र आंतरराष्ट्रीय बालकांचा आपातकालीन निधी
options.B: भाभा अटॉमिक रिसर्च सेंटर (BARC) (भाभा अणुशक्ती संशोधन केंद्र)
options.C: इंडियन स्पेस रिसर्च ऑर्गनायझेशन (ISRO) (भारतीय अंतराळ संशोधन संघटना)
options.D: डिफेन्स रिसर्च ॲंड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑर्गनायझेशन (DRDO) (संरक्षण संशोधन आणि विकास संघटना)

questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय C. ISRO 'YUVIKA' — Yuva Vigyani Karyakram — शाळकरी विद्यार्थ्यांना space science मध्ये घडवणारा residential programme. UNICEF, BARC, DRDO youth/research initiatives चालवतात, पण हा विशिष्ट Young Scientist Programme नाही.

questions.text: 'हानीकारक कायदे हटवा, सशक्त करणारे कायदे बनवा' ही कोणत्या दिवसाची थीम आहे?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय A. Zero Discrimination Day (1 March), UNAIDS कडून, 'Remove laws that harm, create laws that empower' हे theme. World AIDS Day, World Equality Day, World Social Justice Day वेगळे वार्षिक theme.

questions.text: भारतीय अवकाश संशोधन संस्थेचे म्हणजे 'इस्त्रो' चे अध्यक्ष म्हणून _________ यांची जानेवारी, 2022 मध्ये नियुक्ती झालेली आहे.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Dr S. Somnath January 2022 मध्ये ISRO Chairman — Dr K. Sivan यांच्यानंतर. Radhakrishnan, Prof. MGK Menon पूर्व अध्यक्ष — 'January 2022 मध्ये कोण' असा MPSC प्रश्न विचारतो.

questions.text: पंजाबच्या उत्पादन शुल्क विभागाने 2020 सालात अवैध दारू व्यापार संबंधित गुन्ह्यांना आळा घालण्यासाठी कोणती मोहीम सुरू केली?
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Punjab Excise Department ने 2020 मध्ये Operation Red Rose — illicit liquor व्यापार व संबंधित गुन्ह्यांवर. Black Cobra, Black Bull, Prahar वाजवी वाटतात, पण इतर राज्ये/वर्षांच्या enforcement drives.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणत्या घटनादुरुस्तीनुसार देशाचे सार्वभौमत्व आणि एकात्मता यांच्या रक्षणासाठी नागरिकांच्या मूलभूत हक्कांवर बंधने घालण्यात आली?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. 16 वी घटनादुरुस्ती (1963) ने Article 19 अंतर्गत 'भारताचे sovereignty and integrity' हे मर्यादा घालण्याचे आधार म्हणून जोडले. 14 वी, 24 वी, 39 वी — citizenship, property, emergency-era बदल; ही विशिष्ट मर्यादा नाही.

questions.text: राज्यघटनेच्या भाग XVII अंतर्गत सर्व नऊ कलमे कोणती आहेत?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. भाग XVII Official Language — Article 343 ते 351, एकूण नऊ कलमे. इतर ranges Part XVI (special provisions) किंवा Part XVIII (emergency) मध्ये जातात.

questions.text: भारताची संविधानसभा बनवण्याची मागणी इंग्रजांनी कोणत्या वर्षी मान्य केली?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. August Offer 1940 — British ने constituent assembly तत्त्व पहिल्यांदा औपचारिक स्वीकारले. 1938–39 मध्ये Congress मागणी, स्वीकार नाही; 1942 Quit India, ही concession नाही.

questions.text: भारतीय लोक आपल्या देशाचे प्रशासन किती उत्तम प्रकारे चालवू शकतात हे पाहण्यासाठी 1930 ते 1932 च्या दरम्यान लंडनमध्ये _________ गोलमेज परिषदा घेण्यात आल्या.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. 1930–1932 दरम्यान London मध्ये तीन Round Table Conferences — Simon Commission नंतर constitutional reform व Indian self-government. दोन किंवा चार — सामान्य count trap; MPSC साठी 'तीन' लक्षात ठेवा.

questions.text: भारतीय संविधानाच्या कलम 154 प्रमाणे राज्याची कार्यकारी सत्ता _________ यांच्याकडे देण्यात आली आहे.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय C. Article 154 नुसार राज्याची executive power Governor मध्ये — थेट किंवा subordinate officers द्वारे. Chief Minister व Council of Ministers सल्ला देतात; constitutional vesting त्यांच्याकडे नाही.

questions.text:
खालील जोड्या जुळवा:
(a) बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण → (i) खटला कनिष्ठ न्यायालयाकडून वरिष्ठ न्यायालयाकडे हस्तांतरित करणे
(b) परमादेश → (ii) पदाची कायदेशीरता तपासणे
(c) अधिकार पृच्छा → (iii) अधिकाऱ्यास कार्य करण्याचा आदेश देणे
(d) उत्प्रेक्षण → (iv) अटकेची कायदेशीरता तपासणे
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. जोड्या: Habeas corpus — अटकेची legality (iv); Mandamus — authority ला कर्तव्य पार पाडण्याचा आदेश (iii); Quo warranto — public office धरण्याची legality (ii); Certiorari — प्रकरण वर हस्तांतरण/खालच्या court चा order रद्द (i).

questions.text: भारतीय राज्यघटनेच्या कलम 243 E प्रमाणे प्रत्येक ग्रामपंचायत ती त्या वेळी अंमलात असलेल्या कोणत्याही कायद्यान्वये ती तत्पूर्वीच विसर्जित झाली नसेल तर, _________ पाच वर्षांपर्यंत अस्तित्वात राहील.

options.C: तिच्या निवडणुकीनंतरच्या पहिल्या बैठकीसाठी नियत केलेल्या दिनांकापासून
options.D: पंचायत निवडणुकांच्या नंतर सुरू होणाऱ्या पहिल्या आर्थिक वर्षापासून

questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Article 243E नुसार gram panchayat ची पाच वर्षांची muddat निवडीनंतर first meeting साठी नेमलेल्या तारखेपासून — result declaration, poll day, पुढचे financial year नाही. first meeting date हा statutory starting point.

questions.text: कोणत्या समितीच्या शिफारशीनुसार मूलभूत कर्तव्यांचा समावेश करण्यात आला?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Swaran Singh Committee (1976) ने Fundamental Duties शिफारस केली — 42 वी घटनादुरुस्तीने Part IVA Article 51A जोडले. Devraj, Karan Singh, Kripalani committees इतर reforms; ही यादी नाही.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणते काम ग्रामसेवकाचे नाही?

options.C: शासनाने निर्धारित केलेल्या विविध करांची वसुली करणे

questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. Gram Sevak panchayat निधी वापर, gram sabha report, सरकारी कर वसूली — तीनही listed items सामान्य कर्तव्ये. A, B, C पैकी 'non-function' नाही, म्हणून 'None of these' बरोबर.

questions.text: कोणत्या घटनादुरुस्तीन्वये 11 वे मूलभूत कर्तव्य यादीत नंतर समाविष्ट केले गेले? (51A(K))
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. 11 वे मूलभूत कर्तव्य — Article 51A(k), 6–14 वर्ष मुलांना शिक्षण — 86 वी घटनादुरुस्ती 2002. 42 वी 1976 मध्ये मूळ दहा कर्तव्ये; 52 वी, 62 वी anti-defection व reservation tenure.

questions.text:
नारायण मेघाजी लोखंडे यांच्या संदर्भातील कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत?
(a) कामगार चळवळीचे जनक
(b) 1884 मध्ये बॉम्बे मिलहँण्ड्स असोसिएशनची स्थापना
(c) ब्रिटीश सरकारचा 'रावबहादूर' किताब
(d) महाराष्ट्र लेबर युनियनची स्थापना
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. नारायण मेघाजी लोखंडे Bombay labour movement चे अग्रगण्य नेते, Bombay Mill-Hands' Association (1884) स्थापनेत सहभागी, British सरकारने 'रावबहादूर' पदवी दिली — (a), (b), (c) बरोबर. Maharashtra Labour Union नंतरच्या काळात आले, त्यांचे काम नाही, म्हणून (d) बाहेर.

questions.text:
जोड्या जुळवा:
(a) रँड व आयर्स्टचा खून → (i) वि.दा. सावरकर
(b) अभिनव भारत → (ii) अनंत लक्ष्मण कान्हेरे
(c) न्यायाधीश जॅक्सनचा खून → (iii) मदनलाल धिंग्रा
(d) कर्झन वायलीचा खून → (iv) चाफेकर बंधू
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Rand–Ayerst (चापेकर), Abhinav Bharat (सावरकर), Justice Jackson (Anant Laxman Kanhere), Curzon Wyllie (Madan Lal Dhingra) — क्रम (iv), (i), (ii), (iii).

questions.text:
खालील विवरणावरून व्यक्ती ओळखा:
(a) मराठीतील पहिले पत्रकार
(b) अक्कलकोटच्या युवराजांचे शिक्षक

(d) कुलाबा वेधशाळेचे संचालक
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. बाळशास्त्री जांभेकर — पहिले Marathi वृत्तपत्र Darpan, Akkalkot राजकुमाराचे शिक्षक, Marathi journalism ची सुरुवात, Colaba Observatory चे director — चारही clues एकाच नावाकडे.

questions.text: कोणत्या राष्ट्रीय सभेच्या अधिवेशनात दोन गट पुन्हा एकत्र आले?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. 1907 Surat split नंतर Moderates व Extremists 1916 Lucknow Session मध्ये Tilak व Annie Besant यांच्या joint leadership खाली पुन्हा एकत्र आले.

questions.text: 1928 मध्ये पहिल्या अखिल बंगाल विद्यार्थी परिषदेचे अध्यक्ष कोण होते?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. September 1928 च्या All Bengal Students' Conference चे अध्यक्षपद Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru यांनी सांभाळले; association चे president Pramod Kumar Ghoshal होते, opening session चे chairman नव्हेत.

questions.text: कोणत्या समाजसुधारकाने विधवेशी विवाह केला?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. Maharshi Dhondo Keshav Karve यांनी 1893 मध्ये विधवेशी लग्न केले आणि widow remarriage social-reform mission चे जिवंत उदाहरण ठेवले — इतर नावे reformers असली तरी ह्या कृतीसाठी ओळखले जात नाहीत.

questions.text:
ब्रिटीश काळातील भारताचे अनुद्योगीकरण म्हणजे:
(a) भारतातील हस्तोद्योगांचा ऱ्हास
(b) कुटिरोद्योगांचा ऱ्हास

questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. एकूण काम = 10 × 5 × 2 = 100 person-hours; 2 workers 5 तास/दिवस = 10 person-hours; 100 ÷ 10 = 10 दिवस.

questions.text:
पुढे 5 विधाने आणि नंतर 3 विधाने विशिष्ट क्रमाने एकत्र करून पर्याय जुळवलेले आहेत. त्यातून तार्किकदृष्ट्या यथार्थ युक्तिवाद निर्देशित करणारा पर्याय निवडा.
(a) काही वाहने पर्यावरणासाठी हानिकारक नाहीत.
(b) वाहनांची वाहतूक कार्बन डायऑक्साईड व अन्य हरितगृह वायूचा उत्सर्ग करते.
(c) कार्बन डायऑक्साईड व हरितगृह वायू पर्यावरणासाठी हानिकारक आहे.
(d) काही वाहनांची वाहतूक कार्बन डायऑक्साईड व हरितगृह वायूचा उत्सर्ग करत नाही.
(e) वाहनांची वाहतूक पर्यावरणासाठी हानिकारक आहे.
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Greenhouse gases harmful (c); vehicular traffic emits (b); म्हणून traffic hazardous (e) — त्या क्रमाने valid chain.
योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. सलग फरक +1, +4, +9, +16 (1–4 चे squares); पुढे +25, म्हणून 62 + 25 = 87.

questions.text: तीन व्यक्तींच्या वयाची सरासरी 60 वर्षे आहे. त्यांच्या वयाचे गुणोत्तर 2 : 3 : 4 असे आहे. सर्वात तरुण आणि सर्वात वयस्कर व्यक्तींच्या वयातील फरक किती?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय C. 2 : 3 : 4 ratio, सरासरी 60 → 40, 60, 80 वर्ष — लहान-मोठ्यात 40 वर्षांचा फरक.

questions.text:
रस्त्यावरच्या विक्रेतीने एके दिवशी तिच्याकडील बाहुल्यांच्या निम्म्याहून दोन बाहुल्या अधिक विकल्या. दुसऱ्या दिवशी तिने तिच्याकडे असलेल्या बाहुल्यांच्या निम्म्यापैकी दोन बाहुल्या कमी विकल्या. तिच्याकडे 26 बाहुल्या शिल्लक राहिल्या.
सुरुवातीला तिच्याकडे असलेल्या बाहुल्यांची संख्या निवडा.
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A चिन्हांकित केला. 100 dolls सुरुवात; पहिल्या दिवशी 48 उरतात; दुसऱ्या दिवशी (48 च्या अर्ध्या − 2) विक्रीनंतर 26 — मागून 100.

questions.text: दोन संख्याचे गुणोत्तर 3 : 4 या प्रमाणात आहेत व त्यांच्या वर्गांची बेरीज जर 400 असेल तर त्या संख्या कोणत्या?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. 3k व 4k: 9k² + 16k² = 25k² = 400, k = 4 — जोड 12 व 16.

questions.text: नेहाचा पगार अगोदर 10% नी कमी केला व नंतर तेजीमुळे तो 30% नी वाढवला तर मुळच्या पगारात किती टक्के वाढ झाली?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. 10% कपात, नंतर 30% वाढ: 0.9 × 1.3 = 1.17 — मूळ पगारावर 17% net वाढ.

questions.text: सोमा पूर्वेकडे 10 km चालत गेला. त्यानंतर वळून दक्षिणेकडे 2 km गेला. तो पुन्हा वळून पूर्वेकडे 2 km गेला. त्यानंतर तो वळून उत्तरेकडे 7 km गेला. तर त्याच्या सुरुवातीच्या स्थानापासून ते सध्याच्या स्थितीच्या स्थानापर्यंतचे अंतर _________ आहे.

options.D: दिलेल्या माहितीच्या आधारे काढणे शक्य नाही

questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A. सुरुवातीपासून 12 km पूर्व, 5 km उत्तर net displacement (√(12² + 5²) = 13 km).

questions.text: जर एक रक्कम द.सा.दे.शे. 10 दराने 2 वर्षांसाठी ठेवली तर त्यावर मिळणाऱ्या सरळव्याज व चक्रवाढ व्याज यातील फरक ₹ 750 आहे, तर ती रक्कम किती?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. 2 वर्षांसाठी CI − SI = P × (R/100)² = P × 0.01; ₹750 फरक → P = ₹75,000.

title: MPSC Subordinate Services Group B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Pre 2022 (English)

questions.text: Which space agency has released the first visible light images of the surface of venus from space?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. NASA's Parker Solar Probe captured the first visible-light images of Venus's surface from space during a flyby — peering through the planet's thick clouds in wavelengths our eyes can see. ESA and JAXA have Venus missions, but this particular first was NASA's.

questions.text: 'Sustainable international financing scheme' is associated with which global association?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The G20's sustainable finance agenda includes schemes to channel international financing toward climate and development goals — the phrase in the stem maps to that grouping, not ASEAN, BRICS, or SAARC.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement is incorrect in respect of the Consumer Protection Act 2019?
(a) This act came into force on 20th July 2020.
(b) Unfair trade prohibition rules on e-commerce platforms are included in this act.
(c) As per the rules of the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission no charges will be levied for complaints upto Rs. 10 lakhs.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Statements (a) and (b) hold: the Consumer Protection Act 2019 took effect from 20 July 2020 and covers e-commerce unfair-trade rules. Statement (c) is wrong — fee exemption for filing complaints applies up to ₹5 lakh, not ₹10 lakh, at the district commission level.

questions.text: NROL-85, which was launched recently, is an intelligence satellite of which country?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. NROL-85 is a National Reconnaissance Office payload — a US intelligence satellite launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9. The NROL prefix marks American reconnaissance missions, not Russian, Israeli, or French assets.

questions.text: India's First RT-PCR kit to detect the Omicron Variant, named 'Omisure' is developed by which company?
questions.explanation: On this one, option A. Tata MD developed 'Omisure', India's first RT-PCR kit to detect the Omicron variant of COVID-19. Piramal, Sun Pharma, and Apex Pharma were distractors from the wider pharma space.

questions.text:
Identify the person from the following description:
(a) In 2013 she acted in the film 'Mai' for the first time.
(b) The first Indian singer to be nominated for a Grammy Award.
(c) She was recently awarded the Maharashtra Bhushan Award 2021.
questions.explanation: Go with option B. Asha Bhosale acted in the 2013 film 'Mai', was the first Indian singer nominated for a Grammy, and received the Maharashtra Bhushan Award 2021 — all three clues point to her, not Lata Mangeshkar or the other names.

questions.text: Which institution has developed the 'Positive Pay System (PPS)' for Cheque Payment?
questions.explanation: Pick option A. NPCI developed the Positive Pay System for cheque truncation — account holders pre-confirm high-value cheque details before payment clears. RBI mandated it, but the technical system came from NPCI, not Niti Aayog or the Finance Ministry.

questions.text: Which one of the following country has provided instrumental support to India's ambitious space mission 'Gaganyan'?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. France has been a key partner for Gaganyaan — supplying equipment, training Indian astronauts, and supporting human-spaceflight infrastructure. Japan, South Korea, and UAE cooperate on other space fronts but France led this crewed-mission support.

questions.text: Who has been appointed as the chairman of the National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA)?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Ajay Bhushan Pandey — former Finance Secretary — was appointed chairman of the National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA), the audit-oversight body for listed companies and large firms. Nilekani, Premji, and Gopalakrishnan were never NFRA chairs.

questions.text: The Supreme Court has appointed Justice R.V. Ravindran Committee in October 2021 for which of the following purpose?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. In October 2021 the Supreme Court set up the Justice R.V. Ravindran committee to probe the Pegasus spyware snooping allegations. It was not for IPL fixing, Aadhaar policy, or any of the other listed purposes.

questions.text: Which Union Ministry launched 'My CGHS' Mobile application?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare launched the 'My CGHS' mobile app for Central Government Health Scheme beneficiaries — booking appointments, viewing records, and accessing empanelled hospitals. Education, Tourism, and Culture ministries have no CGHS mandate.

questions.text: Which country launched the 'COMPETES ACT' of 2022?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The America COMPETES Act of 2022 is US legislation aimed at boosting semiconductor manufacturing, R&D, and competitiveness against China — a congressional package, not a Russian, UK, or Australian law.

questions.text: 16th World Youth Archery Championship was held in August 2021 in which of the following nation?
questions.explanation: On this one, option B. The 16th World Youth Archery Championship was held in Wrocław, Poland, in August 2021. South Korea, India, and Australia have hosted other archery events but not this edition.

questions.text: Who has been awarded the 'International Gandhi Award for Leprosy-2021'?
questions.explanation: Go with option A. Dr Bhushan Kumar received the International Gandhi Award for Leprosy 2021 for his work in leprosy control. Dr G.P. Talwar, Dr M.D. Gupte, and Dr Atul Shah are respected names in the field but the 2021 award went to Dr Bhushan Kumar.

questions.text: According to livestock census 2019, what is the rank of Maharashtra in terms of livestock among the country?
questions.explanation: Pick option C. The 20th Livestock Census (2019) ranked Maharashtra seventh among states by total livestock population — behind leaders like Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan. First, third, and ninth are common traps from other census rankings.

questions.text:
Which of the following are the correct statements regarding the tenure of a Governor of the State?
(a) Governor remains in his office as long as President of India wishes.
(b) Governor may resign voluntarily.
(c) The appointment of Governor is generally for 05 years.
(d) Governor remains in his office until another person takes charge.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Every statement on gubernatorial tenure is constitutionally sound: a Governor holds office during the President's pleasure, may resign, is normally appointed for five years, and continues until a successor enters — Articles 156 and 157 together cover all four points.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/statements regarding State Public Service Commission is/are not correct?
(a) Provisions in Articles 315 to 323 of the Indian Constitution.
(b) These Commission are working for the State Government as well as the Central Government.
(c) The appointment of the administrative officers selected by this Commission is done by the Central Government.
(d) The chairman and the members of the Commission are appointed by the State Government.
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. State PSCs sit under Articles 315–323 and serve only the state; statement (a) is actually correct, while (b) and (c) are clearly wrong — the mixed wording made more than one option defensible, so MPSC withdrew it.

questions.text: Elections in India for Parliament and State Legislatures are conducted by _______.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Article 324 vests the conduct of elections to Parliament and state legislatures in the Election Commission of India. The President appoints governors; State Election Commissions handle panchayat and municipal polls — not Lok Sabha or Vidhan Sabha seats.

questions.text: Which Article of the Indian Constitution defines the duties of the Chief Minister?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Article 167 spells out the Chief Minister's duties toward the Governor — furnishing information, recommending legislative business, and communicating Council of Ministers' decisions. Article 163 covers CM–Governor relations broadly; 164 deals with appointment, not duties.

questions.text: Which of the following Committee is not related to the Panchayati Raj?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Rajmannar Committee (1971) examined Centre–State relations in Tamil Nadu's context — not Panchayati Raj reform. Ashok Mehta, Thungan, and L.M. Singhvi committees all fed directly into strengthening local self-government.

questions.text:
Make a group of correct sentences in the composition of the Gram Sabha:
(a) Gram Sabha is formed from all the adult citizens of the village.
(b) Every voter who completes 18 years of age becomes a member of Gram Sabha.
(c) Gram Sabha has election.
(d) All the voters of the Gram Panchayat are members of the Gram Sabha.
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. Gram Sabha membership comes from registered voters in the panchayat area — statements (a), (b), and (d) overlap, while (c) about 'election' is ambiguous — the stem did not allow one clean official choice.

questions.text:
New responsibilities given to Gram Panchayats as per 73rd Constitution Amendment Act, 1993.
(a) Enforcement of Land Reforms Act
(b) To develop forest industries, small and cottage industries
(c) Facilitate technical and vocational education
(d) To arrange entertainment for the people of the village
Which of the above statement/statements is/are incorrect?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The Eleventh Schedule lists 29 Panchayat subjects — land reforms, cottage industries, and vocational education appear there. Arranging village entertainment is not a constitutional Panchayat function, so only statement (d) is incorrect.

questions.text: Which article states that each state shall have an Advocate General?
questions.explanation: On this one, option D. Article 165 provides that each state shall have an Advocate General — the chief legal adviser to the state government. Articles 177, 194, and 197 cover other state-legislature and service matters, not this office.

questions.text: Who among the following was the members of the drafting committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Go with option C. Alladi Krishnaswamy Iyer was a member of the Constituent Assembly's Drafting Committee under B.R. Ambedkar. Patel, Nehru, and Rajendra Prasad chaired or presided but were not on that seven-member drafting panel.

questions.text: Which among the following features of Indian Constitution is not borrowed from British Constitution?
questions.explanation: Pick option D. Parliamentary government, Cabinet system, and Rule of Law all came from British constitutional practice. The Concurrent List — shared legislative field for Centre and States — was taken from the Government of India Act 1935 / Australian federal model, not Westminster.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the development of transport infrastructure in India?
(a) The Public Work Department was created during the time of Lord Dalhousie.
(b) During the reigns of Lord Cornwallis and John Shore road construction gained momentum.
(c) Broad gauge tracks were built during the early days of the railway.
(d) Nagpur Council presented 'Twenty Years Road Development Programme' to the Government.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Lord Dalhousie set up the Public Works Department and the Nagpur Road Plan framed a twenty-year road programme — statements (a) and (d) hold. Cornwallis and John Shore are not credited with a major road push in standard texts, and broad-gauge as an 'early railway' claim is what drops (b) and (c) from the set.

questions.text:
Match the pair.
(a) 1890, Mumbai Mill Workers Union - (i) Lala Lajpatrai
(b) 1918, Ahmadabad Textile Labour Association - (ii) B.P. Wadiya
(c) 1918, Madras Labour Union - (iii) Mahatma Gandhi
(d) 1920, All India Trade Union Congress - (iv) Narayan Meghaji Lokhande
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande led the 1890 Mumbai Mill Workers Union, Gandhi shaped the 1918 Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association, B.P. Wadiya organised the Madras Labour Union the same year, and Lala Lajpat Rai was linked with the 1920 AITUC — code (iv), (iii), (ii), (i).

questions.text:
Match the pair place of the Congress Session and his Presidents name.
(a) First Congress Session, Mumbai (1885) - (i) George Yul
(b) Second Congress Session, Calcutta (1886) - (ii) Badruddin Tayyabji
(c) Third Congress Session, Madras (1887) - (iii) Womeshchandra Banarjee
(d) Fourth Congress Session, Allahabad (1888) - (iv) Dadabhai Naoroji
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Bombay 1885 went to Womesh Chandra Banerjee, Calcutta 1886 to Dadabhai Naoroji, Madras 1887 to Badruddin Tyabji, and Allahabad 1888 to George Yule — the first English president — giving (iii), (iv), (ii), (i).

questions.text: In 1847 who was the first to demand the launch of a railway connecting the Mumbai port and the cotton producing regions?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. In 1847 the British free-trade advocate John Bright pressed for a railway linking the Bombay port with cotton-growing hinterland — an early commercial case for Indian rail expansion.

questions.text:
Government of India Act of 1935 provided for establishment of which institutes?
(a) Federal Court
(b) Reserve Bank of India
(c) Federal Railway
(d) High Commissioner
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. The Government of India Act, 1935 provided for a Federal Court, the Reserve Bank of India, and a Federal Railway authority — the High Commissioner post belonged to the earlier 1919 framework, not this Act.

questions.text:
Which of the following was the aim of 'Trading Economy' of British Government?
(a) No Trading competition
(b) Maximum profit
(c) Control on economic factors
(d) Economic growth of India
Which of the statement given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: On this one, option D. The British 'trading economy' in India was built around extracting maximum profit for the Company and Crown — monopoly, control, and Indian industrial growth were means or side-effects, not the stated aim in colonial policy.

questions.text: What Dr. Bhau Daji Lad was the proponent of?
questions.explanation: Go with option C. Dr Bhau Daji Lad — physician, scholar, and associate of the Paramhans Sabha — was a vocal champion of widow remarriage and social reform in mid-nineteenth-century Bombay.

questions.text:
Choose the correct option by matching the following:
(a) Acharya Bal Shastri Jambhekar - (i) Establishment of Manav Dharm Sabha at Surat
(b) Durgaram Manchharam, Dadoba Pandurang - (ii) Purification of Shripad Sheshadri Paralikar who was in the custody of Christi Missionary
(c) Annie Besant - (iii) Establishment of Normal School and Victoria Institute
(d) Keshavchandra Sen - (iv) Establishment of Central Hindu-College
questions.explanation: Pick option B. According to the answer key the pairs run (ii), (i), (iv), (iii) — Jambhekar with (ii), Dadoba–Durgaram with Manav Dharm Sabha at Surat, Annie Besant with Central Hindu College, and Keshav Chandra Sen with (iii). Match from the list the paper gave rather than reshuffling from memory.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are false regarding revolt of Santhala?
(a) Economic exploitation of Santhala is presented in Punjab Review.
(b) Santhala declared the decision of establishment of 'State of Truth'.
(c) Kanhu the leader of Santhala was treacherously kidnapped.
(d) O Mauli, the officer gave the report of duel of Santhala.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. The Santhal revolt did declare a 'State of Truth' and O Mauli's report on the struggle is on record — statements (a) about the Punjab Review and (c) about Kanhu's treacherous kidnapping are the false pair.

questions.text:
Match the following organizers of the Secret Militant Organizations in Maharashtra and their areas.
(a) Shridhar Paranjape - (i) Amravati
(b) Dr. Siddhanath Kane - (ii) Belgaum
(c) Dadasaheb Khaparde - (iii) Wardha and Nagpur
(d) Gangadhar Deshpande - (iv) Yavatmal
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Shridhar Paranjape worked around Wardha–Nagpur, Gangadhar Deshpande in the Belgaum belt, Dadasaheb Khaparde in Amravati, and Dr Siddhanath Kane in Yavatmal — secret militant networks mapped as (iii), (iv), (i), (ii).

questions.text:
Gopal Ganesh Agarkar was related with which of the following Newspapers?
(a) Kesari and Maratha
(b) Varhad Samachar
(c) Sudharak
(d) Swarajya
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Gopal Ganesh Agarkar edited or founded Kesari and Maratha (with Tilak), brought out Varhad Samachar, and ran Sudharak — Swarajya is not counted among his papers in the standard list.

questions.text:
Identify the person from following description:
(a) He started the Newspaper 'India'
(b) Establishment of Bombay Association
(c) Establishment of East India Association
(d) President of Indian National Congress
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Dadabhai Naoroji started the paper 'India', helped form the Bombay Association, founded the East India Association in London, and presided over the Indian National Congress — all four clues point to the 'Grand Old Man'.

questions.text:
Who made the following statements which caused the growth of Communalism?
(a) Hindu and Muslim are two nations and these are two opposite countries.
(b) The policy of divide and beat has to be adopted in India and Muslims should be kept away from Hindu.
(c) Mahatma Gandhiji's Civil-Disobedience Movement is not totally for freedom of India but to keep Indian Muslims under the domination of Hindu Mahasabha.
(d) Those who are recognizing India as their motherland, India is their nation.
