options.A: Principal Bake, Sir Sayyad Ahamad, V.D. Sawarkar, Mohamad Ali Jinnah
options.B: Sir Sayyad Ahamad, Principal Bake, Mohamad Ali Jinnah, V.D. Sawarkar
options.C: V.D. Sawarkar, Mohamad Ali Jinnah, Principal Bake, Sir Sayyad Ahamad
options.D: Mohamad Ali Jinnah, Sir Sayyad Ahmad, V.D. Sawarkar, Principal Bake

questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Statement (a) — two nations — fits Sir Syed Ahmad; (b) divide-and-beat goes to Principal Beck; (c) the attack on Civil Disobedience to Mohammad Ali Jinnah; and (d) motherland nationhood to V.D. Savarkar.

questions.text:
What was the aim of East India Association organisation, established on 1 November 1866?
(a) Female Education
(b) Political Education
(c) People Education
(d) Religious Education
Which of the statement given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. Dadabhai Naoroji's East India Association (1 November 1866) aimed at political awakening and educating British and Indian public opinion on Indian affairs — 'people education' in the broad civic sense, not a female- or religion-only brief.

questions.text:
Which of the following personalities were related with Bombay Presidency Association Organisation?
(a) Gopal Ganesh Agarkar
(b) Firojshah Mehta
(c) Badruddin Tayyabji
(d) Justice Telang
questions.explanation: Go with option B. The Bombay Presidency Association drew in Firozshah Mehta, Badruddin Tyabji, and Justice Telang — Agarkar was active in other reform circles but not listed among its core founders in textbook accounts.

questions.text: In the decade of 1911 to 1921 the Population Growth in the State of Maharashtra was negative. The reason behind it is _______.

options.A: Low birth rate during that period

questions.explanation: Pick option B. Maharashtra's population growth turned negative in the 1911–1921 decade chiefly because the influenza pandemic after World War I pushed up mortality — not low birth rate, floods, or lack of industry alone.

questions.text: Maharashtra State Agricultural Marketing Board is established in _______.
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The printed key points to 1986 for the Maharashtra State Agricultural Marketing Board, but MPSC withdrew the item; do not count it in scoring.

questions.text: In India _______ is called as a 'Golden Fiber' crop.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Jute is called the 'golden fibre' for its silky lustre and value in sacking and packaging — cotton is 'white gold', wool and silk carry different labels.

questions.text: Which is the mountain/hill situated on the North-South direction of western Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. The Sahyadri (Western Ghats) run north–south along western Maharashtra, forming the state's coastal–plateau divide; Satpura lies further east, Satmala and Shambhu Mahadev are sub-ranges, not the main N–S chain.

questions.text:
Following statements are correct or incorrect?
(a) Commercialisation of agriculture did not promote capitalist - agriculture.
(b) Commercialisation of agriculture intensified tenancy and share-cropping.

options.C: (a) is false and (b) is true statement
options.D: (a) is true and (b) is false statement

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. According to the answer key, both statements are false: commercialisation of agriculture did promote capitalist farming and the tenancy–share-cropping link in (b) is also rejected in the paper's framing. If your textbook wording differs, defer to the key for this item.

questions.text: Iron ore reserves in Maharashtra are located in the district of _______.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Maharashtra's workable iron-ore reserves are concentrated in the Sindhudurg–Gadchiroli belt on the Konkan–Vidarbha fringe; Wardha, Nashik, and Buldhana are not the districts named for ore in state geography notes.

questions.text: Following are some of the problems in the agriculture sector in Maharashtra. Which one is more social in nature?
questions.explanation: On this one, option D. Fragmentation of farmland is rooted in inheritance customs and family division — a social–institutional problem — whereas weather, research gaps, and capital shortage are economic or technical constraints.

questions.text: What is the percent share of tourism in India's domestic income as of 2019?
questions.explanation: Go with option D. Tourism's share in India's domestic income around 2019 was about 9.34% per the figures MPSC expected — the 7–9% band in other options are close but not the precise statistic on the key.

questions.text: One of the following is an important port situated on the west coast of India.
questions.explanation: Pick option C. Kandla (Deendayal Port) sits on the Gulf of Kutch on India's west coast; Chennai, Haldia, and Kolkata are east-coast or Hooghly ports.

questions.text: The average highest temperature in the month of May is recorded in _______ region of Maharashtra.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Eastern Vidarbha lies in the rain-shadowed interior Deccan and records the state's highest average May temperatures, while the coast and western Maharashtra stay relatively moderated by proximity to the sea.

questions.text: Bhilai Iron and Steel Industry is located in the state of _______.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. The Bhilai Steel Plant, built with Soviet collaboration under the Second Plan, stands near Bhilai in present-day Chhattisgarh (carved out of Madhya Pradesh in 2000). West Bengal has Durgapur; Odisha has Rourkela — Bhilai belongs to the Chhattisgarh belt.

questions.text: When State Government in Maharashtra has declared the Blue Revolution Mission?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Maharashtra declared its Blue Revolution (Neeli Kranti) Mission in 2017 to expand inland and marine fisheries, cold chains, and fish exports. The 2018–2020 years are near-miss distractors around the actual launch.

questions.text:
The population is decreasing continuously in rural area, because:
(a) The birth rate in rural area is low.
(b) The rural people are migrating to urban area.
(c) The employment is not available in rural area.
(d) The death rate is high in rural area.
Which statement/s of the above is true?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Rural headcount falls mainly because people move out to towns and cities for work and services — out-migration, not a uniquely low rural birth rate or a high rural death rate by itself. Employment scarcity (c) often pushes migration, but the keyed statement is the direct demographic fact: only (b).

questions.text: Which of the following physiographic factor predominantly influence on climate of Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The Sahyadri (Western Ghats) wall and the Satpuda range steer the southwest monsoon, orographic rain, and temperature contrasts across Konkan, plateau, and Vidarbha. The Deccan plateau and coastal plains matter locally, but these two ranges dominate Maharashtra's climate pattern.

questions.text: The multipurpose project of Gujarat 'Ukai' is situated on which River?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Ukai Dam — a major multipurpose project in south Gujarat — is built across the Tapti (Tapi) river near Ukai village. Sabarmati, Mahi, and Narmada host other famous dams but not Ukai.

questions.text: In which state the number of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies was highest at the end of March 2020?
questions.explanation: On this one, option D. NABARD data for March 2020 placed Maharashtra at the top among States in the number of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) — the short-term rural credit network is densest here. Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Gujarat rank lower on that count.

questions.text: The Government appointed a Committee in 1993 on Disinvestment in Public Sector Enterprises under the Chairmanship of _______.
questions.explanation: Go with option C. The Rangarajan Committee (1993) framed the early policy roadmap for disinvestment in public-sector enterprises under the Narasimha Rao reforms. G.V. Ramakrishna chaired a later Disinvestment Commission; Montek Ahluwalia and C.P. Chandrashekhar led other panels.

questions.text: During 2017-18 Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) was highest 23.6 percent in _______ sector in India.
questions.explanation: Pick option A. In 2017–18 communication services — telecom, media, and related digital infrastructure — drew the largest FDI share at about 23.6%, ahead of manufacturing and financial services. That spike reflected spectrum auctions, data growth, and liberalised telecom FDI norms.

questions.text: To tackle the burgeoning problem of air pollution, the 2021-22 Budget proposes to provide an amount of Rs. 2217 crore for _______ urban centres with a million-plus population.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Union Budget 2021–22 earmarked Rs 2,217 crore for air-quality management across 42 million-plus urban centres — cities above ten lakh population where pollution monitoring and mitigation were prioritised. The 32, 52, and 62 counts are arithmetic distractors.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Second largest agro based industry in India - (i) Cotton industry
(b) One of the oldest and organised industry in India - (ii) Iron and steel industry
(c) Industry leading to rapid industrialisation - (iii) Sugar industry
(d) Use of new technology - (iv) Automobile industry
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Match by industry profile: sugar is India's second-largest agro-based industry (a–iii); cotton textiles are among the oldest organised mills (b–i); iron and steel drove heavy industrialisation (c–ii); the automobile sector absorbed modern technology fastest (d–iv).

questions.text: Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) has a right to order conduct of supplementary audit and he may also comment upon the audit report within _______ days from the date of receipt of audit report.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Under CAG audit rules the Comptroller and Auditor General may order supplementary audit and must submit comments on the audit report within 60 days of receiving it — not 30, 90, or 120. MPSC often tests this fixed timeline.

questions.text: The difference between fiscal deficit and interest payment during the year is called _______.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Primary deficit equals fiscal deficit minus interest payments on past borrowing — it shows how much of today's borrowing funds current spending excluding debt-service. Fiscal and revenue deficits measure different gaps; budget deficit is a broader informal term.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements in the context of Seventh Finance Commission for distribution of the states share of the central excise duty:
(a) 25 percent weightage for population.
(b) 33.5 percent weightage for poor in each state.
(c) 16.5 percent weightage for increase in the per capita income of the state.
(d) 25 percent weightage for income equalisation between state.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. For sharing central excise duty the Seventh Finance Commission gave 25% weight to population (a) and 25% to income equalisation between States (d). The 33.5% 'poor' weight and 16.5% per-capita-income-growth weight belong to a different formula — not this excise-sharing scheme.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (Amendment) Act, passed by the Parliament in 2021.
(b) The deposit insurance premium is recovered from the depositors.
(c) The deposit insurance premium is compulsory for all insured banks.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?

options.D: All of the above are correct

questions.explanation: On this one, option B. Parliament passed the DICGC (Amendment) Act in 2021 (a), and the deposit-insurance premium is compulsory for all insured banks (c) — but the premium is paid by banks to DICGC, not recovered from depositors, so (b) is wrong.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) was launched September 2001.
(b) Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) was introduced in February 2006.
(c) The Nehru Rozgar Yojana (NRY) was launched in October 1989 for the benefit of the rural poor.
Which of the following statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Go with option C. SGRY was launched in September 2001 by merging earlier rural wage schemes, and MGNREGS/NREGA rolled out from February 2006 — both dates in the stem are correct. NRY (1989) is also true historically, but the keyed pair is (a) and (b) only.

questions.text: N.K. Singh Committee of 2016 is related to _______.

options.D: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act

questions.explanation: Pick option D. The N.K. Singh Committee (2016) reviewed the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act and recommended a debt-to-GDP anchor and escape clauses — not a Finance Commission or Five-Year Plan. FRBM compliance is a recurring MPSC budget topic.

questions.text:
Which of the following were the reasons for small land holdings during 1980 to 1985 in India?
(a) Law of inheritance
(b) Rapidly growing population
(c) Rural indebtedness
(d) Rapidly growing joint family system
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Fragmentation grew through inheritance laws splitting holdings (a), population pressure on the same land (b), and distress sales or debt forcing subdivision (c). A growing joint-family system (d) would tend to keep land together — the opposite of smaller plots.

questions.text: During which five year plan three major steel plants in the public sector were built up at Rourkela, Bhilai and Durgapur?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Rourkela, Bhilai, and Durgapur — the three integrated public-sector steel plants with foreign collaboration — were core projects of the Second Five Year Plan (1956–61). The First Plan focused on irrigation and agriculture; the Third carried forward other heavy industry.

questions.text: Which of the following is not objective of National Population Policy 2000?

options.D: Incentive to adopt two child small family

questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. National Population Policy 2000 targets lower infant mortality, universal immunisation, and incentives for a two-child norm — mid-day meals for poor children belong to the education/nutrition scheme, not NPP objectives.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a quantitative monetary measure of Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Bank rate, CRR, and SLR are quantitative tools — they change the volume or cost of bank reserves and credit by fixed rules. Moral suasion is qualitative: the RBI persuades banks without a mandatory ratio or rate change.

questions.text: Which of the following substance has the highest thermal conductivity?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Among common solids, silver has the highest thermal conductivity — free electrons carry heat efficiently. Aluminium conducts well but ranks below silver; wood and glass are thermal insulators by comparison.

questions.text: Light enters the eye through thin membrane called the _______.
questions.explanation: On this one, option D. The cornea is the transparent front membrane; light passes through it first before the pupil and lens focus an image on the retina. The iris controls pupil size; the retina is the screen, not the entry window.

questions.text: Echo is heard if the distance between the source of sound and the obstacle is _______.

options.B: More than or equal to 17 meters

questions.explanation: Go with option B. At roughly 340 m/s in air, sound needs about 0.05 s to travel 17 m and return — the minimum path for a distinct echo. Distances below 17 m merge the reflected sound with the direct note; 17 m or more separates them clearly.

questions.text: In _______ model of an atom, the angular momentum (mvr) of an electron is an integral multiple of the quantity h/2π.
questions.explanation: Pick option C. Bohr's model quantises angular momentum as mvr = n(h/2π) — only certain orbits are allowed. Rutherford had the nuclear atom without quantisation; Dalton treated atoms as indivisible spheres; Fermi is linked to nuclear statistics, not this orbital rule.

questions.text: Choose the incorrect answer:

options.A: Bonding molecular orbitals are formed by the additive effect of the atomic orbitals.
options.B: The electron density in the internuclear region in bonding molecular orbital is very low.
options.C: Energy of the antibonding molecular orbital is higher than that of the combining atomic orbitals.
options.D: Antibonding molecular orbitals are represented by σ*, π*, δ*, etc.

questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. In a bonding molecular orbital electron density rises in the internuclear region — that is why the bond forms. Statement (B) wrongly says density there is very low; that description fits an antibonding orbital. Options A, C, and D state standard MO theory correctly.

questions.text: During biological nitrogen fixation, nitrifying bacteria convert _______.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Nitrifying bacteria oxidise ammonium (NH₄⁺) stepwise to nitrate (NO₃⁻) — that is nitrification, not the conversion of atmospheric N₂ to ammonia. The stem mixes the term 'nitrogen fixation' with nitrifiers; follow the key's NH₄⁺ → NO₃⁻ pairing.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Python molurus - (i) Haemotoxic
(b) Naja naja - (ii) Blind snake
(c) Viper russelli - (iii) Neurotoxic
(d) Typhlops braminus - (iv) Non-poisonous
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Python molurus (Indian rock python) is non-poisonous; Naja naja (cobra) is neurotoxic; Viper russelli (Russell's viper) is haemotoxic; Typhlops braminus is the blind snake — giving (iv), (iii), (i), (ii).

questions.text: Which one of the following is the correct sequence of larval stages of Aurelia?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Aurelia (jellyfish) life cycle runs Planula → Hydratuba → Scyphistoma → Ephyra — the polyp scyphistoma stage precedes the free-swimming ephyra medusa.

questions.text:
Which of the following is/are group/groups of reptilian animals?
(a) Lizard, Snake, Frog and Loris
(b) Turtle, Gharial, Caiman and Tuatara
(c) Turtle, Crocodile, Salamander and Lizard
(d) Salamander, Catotes, Turtle and Frog
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. Only group (b) — Turtle, Gharial, Caiman and Tuatara — are all reptiles. The other lists mix in amphibians (Frog, Salamander) or a mammal (Loris).

questions.text:
Irrigation in the fields of saline tract affects the productivity of crops because of:
(a) Degradation of soil structure
(b) Growth inhibition of plants
(c) Leaf discolouration
(d) Salt accumulation in soil
Which of the given above statement/statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Saline-tract irrigation degrades soil structure and lets salts accumulate in the root zone — both (a) and (d). Leaf discolouration alone is not the pair the answer key selects.

questions.text: How the occurrence of Endemic pest is defined?

options.C: Occurs in the same area year after year
options.D: Occurs in an area in severe form

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. An endemic pest appears in the same locality year after year at a steady level — not merely 'severe' or 'in a few places' for one season.

questions.text: Plants whose seeds are naked, are classified in which group?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Gymnosperms bear naked seeds — not enclosed in a fruit — unlike angiosperms. Tracheophyta is the broader vascular-plant division.

questions.text: From the following viruses, which one transfers from one person to other via infected needles or unprotected sex?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Hepatitis B spreads through infected blood, needles and unprotected sex. Dengue and Hepatitis A use different routes; Rota virus mainly causes childhood diarrhoea.

questions.text: Which scientist discovered small pox vaccine?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Edward Jenner developed the smallpox vaccine in 1796 using cowpox material. Pasteur worked on rabies and anthrax; Fleming discovered penicillin.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to disinfect surfaces?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Ultraviolet (UV) light is widely used to disinfect exposed surfaces. Autoclaving is for heat sterilisation of instruments, not routine surface wipe-down.

questions.text:
Find out which assumption is correct from the given statement.
Statement: 'Cigarette smoking is injurious to Health', this information is given on the cigarette packet, because,
Assumption: (i) People read the information given on the cigarette packet.
(ii) Many people take seriously the warning given on cigarette packet.

options.D: Both (i) and (ii) assumptions are not correct

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. The warning on a cigarette pack only works if people read it and take it seriously — both assumptions (i) and (ii) must hold for the label to serve its purpose.

questions.text:
The percentage distribution of passengers in different trains are shown in a pie-chart: Train A: 13%, Train Q: 19%, Train R: 9%, Train S: 24%, Train M: 20%, Train L: 15%.
Total number of passengers = 8500. What is the average number of passengers in Trains S, M and L together?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Trains S, M and L carry 24% + 20% + 15% = 59% of 8500, i.e. 5015 passengers; divided by 3 gives 1672 on average.

questions.text:
Mango tree is in the middle of Gauva and Lemon tree. Papaya tree is near the Lemon tree but not near the Mango tree and Gauva tree. At the right side of Papaya tree is Coconut tree but at the left side of Gauva tree no any tree.
Which statement/s of following is/are correct?
(i) Lemon tree is between the Papaya and Mango tree.
(ii) Papaya tree is between Coconut and Lemon tree.
(iii) Papaya tree is near Coconut tree.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Left to right the row is Guava–Mango–Lemon–Papaya–Coconut: Lemon sits between Mango and Papaya, Papaya between Lemon and Coconut, and Papaya is next to Coconut — all three statements hold.

questions.text: There are 80 players in a club, of which 36 play Kabaddi and 48 play Cricket. If 12 players play both Kabaddi and Cricket, what is the percentage of players who do not play either Kabaddi or Cricket?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Kabaddi or Cricket (or both) cover 36 + 48 − 12 = 72 players; 80 − 72 = 8 play neither — 8/80 × 100 = 10%.

questions.text: Six students A, B, C, D, E and F are standing in a row. B is between F and D. E is between A and C. A does not stand next to either F or D. C does not stand next to D. F is between which of the following pair of students?
questions.explanation: MPSC cancelled this question — no scored answer. The seating puzzle as printed does not yield a unique row consistent with every condition; treat it as withdrawn on the official answer key.

questions.text: If the letters in the English alphabets, A to M represent number from 1 to 13 respectively and N represent zero and the letters O to Z correspond from -1 to -12, what will be sum of integers for SUCCESS?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Map A–M as 1–13, N as 0, O–Z as −1 to −12; SUCCESS (three S letters) sums to −11.

questions.text:
A school has four divisions A, B, C and D of ninth standard students. The results of half-yearly and annual examinations are shown in the table.
Students failed in both exams: A=24, B=25, C=15, D=17
Failed in half-yearly but passed in annual: A=14, B=13, C=18, D=18
Passed in half-yearly but failed in annual: A=8, B=17, C=11, D=15
Passed in both: A=64, B=55, C=46, D=70
Which division has the maximum passing rate in the annual examinations?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C — Division D. Annual pass rates: A ≈ 70.9%, B ≈ 61.8%, C ≈ 71.1%, D ≈ 73.3%; D has the highest share passing the annual exam.

questions.text:
What will be the number at the place of question mark?
[Pattern with numbers: 12, 18, 40, 55, 79, 22, 18, 45, 20, 12, 13]
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The number-grid pattern in the original paper resolves to 111; the slim extract here omits part of the diagram, so follow the official answer key if your copy differs slightly.

questions.text: In a code language, RED = 9 and BLUE = 10. Then WHITE = ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Each code word equals the average of its letters' alphabet positions: RED (18+5+4)/3 = 9, BLUE (2+12+21+5)/4 = 10, so WHITE (23+8+9+20+5)/5 = 13.

questions.text: Travelling in a train, a person is counting the number of electric poles. The distance between the two poles is 50 metres and the speed of the train is 40 km/hour. Then how many hours will the person require to count 5601 poles?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. 5601 poles mean 5600 gaps of 50 m → 280 km at 40 km/h gives 280 ÷ 40 = 7 hours.

questions.text: Find the average of natural numbers between 1 to 97.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Natural numbers 1 through 97 average to (1 + 97) ÷ 2 = 49 — the midpoint of an arithmetic sequence.

questions.text: A train 250 metres long running at a speed 45 km/hr, how long does it take to pass a platform of length 250 metres?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Total distance = train + platform = 500 m; at 45 km/h (= 12.5 m/s) the crossing takes 500 ÷ 12.5 = 40 seconds.

questions.text: Ravi sold an article to Sudhir at a profit of 6% who in turn sold that to Gopal at a loss of 5%. If Gopal paid Rs. 2014 for the article, find the cost price of the article for Ravi.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Gopal's Rs. 2014 is 95% of Sudhir's cost, so Sudhir paid 2120; that is 106% of Ravi's cost, giving Ravi's CP = Rs. 2000.

questions.text: A man goes to Mumbai from Pune at a speed of 4 km/hr and returns to Pune at a speed of 6 km/hr. What is his average speed of the entire journey?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Equal distances at 4 km/h and 6 km/h give average speed 2 × 4 × 6 ÷ (4 + 6) = 4.8 km/h — not the simple mean of the two speeds.

questions.text: If A and B together can complete a piece of work in 15 days and B alone in 20 days. In how many days can A alone complete the work?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. 1/15 = 1/A + 1/20, so 1/A = 1/60 and A alone finishes in 60 days.

title: MPSC अधीनस्थ सेवा गट-ब (अराजपत्रित) संयुक्त पूर्व परीक्षा 2022 (मराठी)

questions.text: कोणत्या अंतराळ संस्थेने अंतराळातून शुक्राच्या पृष्ठभागाची पहिली दृश्यमान प्रकाश प्रतिमा प्रकाशित केली आहे?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. NASA च्या Parker Solar Probe ने Venus च्या पृष्ठभागाचे अवकाशातून पहिले visible-light चित्र काढले — घन ढगांमधून डोळ्यांना दिसणाऱ्या तरंगलांबीत. ESA व JAXA कडे Venus मोहिमा आहेत, पण हा विशिष्ट 'पहिला' NASA चा होता.

questions.text: 'सस्टेनेबल इंटरनेशनल फायनान्सिंग स्कीम' कोणत्या जागतिक संघटनेशी संबंधित आहे?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. G20 च्या sustainable finance agenda मध्ये international financing हवामान व विकास ध्येयांकडे वळवण्याच्या योजना आहेत — प्रश्नातील वाक्यांश त्या गटाशी जोडतो, ASEAN, BRICS किंवा SAARC शी नाही.

questions.text:
ग्राहक संरक्षण कायदा 2019 च्या बाबतीत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान चुकीचे आहे?
(a) हा कायदा 20 जुलै 2020 पासून लागू झाला.
(b) ई-कॉमर्स प्लॅटफॉर्मवरील अनुचित व्यापार प्रतिबंध नियमांचा समावेश या कायद्यात करण्यात आला आहे.
(c) ग्राहक विवाद निवारण आयोगाच्या नियमानुसार 10 लाख रूपयांपर्यंतच्या तक्रारीसाठी कुठलेही शुल्क आकारले जाणार नाही.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. विधाने (a) व (b) बरोबर: Consumer Protection Act 2019 हा 20 July 2020 पासून लागू आणि e-commerce unfair-trade नियम समाविष्ट. विधान (c) चुकीचे आहे — तक्रार filing साठी शुल्क-सवलत ₹10 lakh नव्हे, district commission स्तरावर ₹5 lakh पर्यंत.

questions.text: नुकताच प्रक्षेपित केलेला एन आर ओ एल - 85 हा कोणत्या देशाचा गुप्तचर उपग्रह आहे?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. NROL-85 हा National Reconnaissance Office चा payload — SpaceX Falcon 9 वर अंतरिक्षात गेलेला US intelligence satellite. NROL उपसर्ग अमेरिकन reconnaissance मोहिमा दर्शवतो, रशियन, Israeli किंवा French नाही.

questions.text: ओमिक्रॉन प्रकार शोधणारे भारतातील पहिले आर टी – पी सी आर किट; 'ओमिशुअर' कोणत्या कंपनीने विकसित केले आहे?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय A. Tata MD ने 'Omisure' विकसित केले — COVID-19 च्या Omicron variant शोधणारी भारताची पहिली RT-PCR kit. Piramal, Sun Pharma, Apex Pharma pharma क्षेत्रातील फसवणुका.

questions.text:
खालील वर्णनावरून व्यक्ती ओळखा:
(a) 2013 मध्ये त्यांनी प्रथम 'माई' या चित्रपटामध्ये काम केले.
(b) ग्रॅमी पुरस्काराकरीता नामांकन मिळवलेल्या पहिल्या भारतीय गायिका.
(c) त्यांना नुकतेच महाराष्ट्र भूषण 2021 ने सन्मानित करण्यात आले.
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Asha Bhosale यांनी 2013 चित्रपट 'Mai' मध्ये अभिनय केला, Grammy साठी नामांकित झालेली पहिली भारतीय गायिका, Maharashtra Bhushan 2021 — तीनही सूचना त्यांच्याकडे, Lata Mangeshkar किंवा इतर नावे नाहीत.

questions.text: कोणत्या संस्थेने चेक पेमेंटसाठी 'पॉझिटोव्ह पे सिस्टम (PPS)' विकसित केले आहे?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. NPCI ने cheque truncation साठी Positive Pay System विकसित केले — खातेदारांनी payment clear होण्यापूर्वी high-value cheque तपशील पुष्टी करणे. RBI ने अनिवार्य केले, पण तांत्रिक प्रणाली NPCI कडून, Niti Aayog किंवा Finance Ministry कडून नाही.

questions.text: भारताच्या महत्वाकांक्षी 'गगनयान' या अंतरिक्ष मोहिमेला खालीलपैकी कोणत्या देशाचे महत्वपूर्ण सहकार्य लाभले आहे?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. Gaganyaan साठी France महत्त्वाचा भागीदार — उपकरणे, Indian astronauts प्रशिक्षण, human-spaceflight infrastructure. Japan, South Korea, UAE इतर अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्रात सहकार्य; France या crewed-mission support मध्ये पुढे.

questions.text: राष्ट्रीय वित्तीय अहवाल प्राधिकरण (NFRA) चे अध्यक्ष म्हणून कोणाची नियुक्ती करण्यात आली आहे?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Ajay Bhushan Pandey — माजी Finance Secretary — National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA) चे अध्यक्ष; listed companies व मोठ्या firms साठी audit-oversight. Nilekani, Premji, Gopalakrishnan NFRA अध्यक्ष नव्हते.

questions.text: सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाने ऑक्टोबर 2021 मध्ये न्यायमूर्ती आर.श्री. रवीन्द्रन समिती खालीलपैकी कोणत्या उद्देशासाठी नेमली आहे?

options.A: आय.पी.एल. स्पॉट फिक्सींग घोटाळा चौकशी समिती

questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. October 2021 मध्ये Supreme Court ने Pegasus spyware snooping आरोपांची चौकशी करण्यासाठी Justice R.V. Ravindran committee नेमली. IPL fixing, Aadhaar policy किंवा इतर उद्दिष्टांसाठी नव्हते.

questions.text: कोणत्या केंद्रीय मंत्रालयाने 'My CGHS' मोबाईल अँप्लिकेशन लॉँच केले?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. Ministry of Health and Family Welfare ने Central Government Health Scheme लाभार्थ्यांसाठी 'My CGHS' mobile app सुरू केले — appointment, records, empanelled hospitals. Education, Tourism, Culture ministries कडे CGHS mandate नाही.

questions.text: कोणत्या देशाने 2022 चा 'कॉम्पीट्स अँक्ट' लॉँच केला?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. America COMPETES Act of 2022 हा US कायदा — semiconductor manufacturing, R&D, China विरुद्ध competitiveness वाढवण्यासाठी. Russian, UK किंवा Australian कायदा नाही.

questions.text: 16 वी जागतिक युवा तिरंदाजी स्पर्धा ऑगस्ट 2021 मध्ये खालीलपैकी कोणत्या देशात पार पडली आहे?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. 16 वे World Youth Archery Championship August 2021 मध्ये Wrocław, Poland येथे. South Korea, India, Australia ने इतर archery events hosted केले, पण ही आवृत्ती नाही.

questions.text: 'कुष्ठरोगासाठीचा आंतरराष्ट्रीय गांधी पुरस्कार-2021' कोणाला प्रदान करण्यात आला आहे?
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. Dr Bhushan Kumar यांना leprosy control कार्यासाठी International Gandhi Award for Leprosy 2021 मिळाला. Dr G.P. Talwar, Dr M.D. Gupte, Dr Atul Shah क्षेत्रातील नावे, पण 2021 पुरस्कार Dr Bhushan Kumar यांना.

questions.text: पशुधन गणना 2019 नुसार महाराष्ट्र राज्याचा देशामध्ये पशुधनाच्या बाबतीत कितवा क्रमांक लागतो?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. 20 वी Livestock Census (2019) नुसार Maharashtra राज्यांमध्ये एकूण livestock लोकसंख्येनुसार सातव्या क्रमांकावर — Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan यांच्यापुढे. First, third, ninth इतर census rankings मधील सामान्य फसवणुका.

questions.text:
Which of the following are the correct statements regarding the tenure of a Governor of the State?
(a) Governor remains in his office as long as President of India wishes.
(b) Governor may resign voluntarily.
(c) The appointment of Governor is generally for 05 years.
(d) Governor remains in his office until another person takes charge.
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. Governor tenure वरचे चारही विधाने घटनात्मकदृष्ट्या बरोबर: President च्या pleasure वर पद, स्वेच्छेने resign, सामान्यतः पाच वर्ष नियुक्ती, successor येईपर्यंत — Articles 156 व 157 एकत्र चारही बिंदू झाकतात.

questions.text:
Which of the following statement/statements regarding State Public Service Commission is/are not correct?
(a) Provisions in Articles 315 to 323 of the Indian Constitution.
(b) These Commission are working for the State Government as well as the Central Government.
(c) The appointment of the administrative officers selected by this Commission is done by the Central Government.
(d) The chairman and the members of the Commission are appointed by the State Government.
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला — फक्त सरावासाठी. State PSC Articles 315–323 अंतर्गत आणि फक्त राज्यासाठी; विधान (a) खरोखर बरोबर, (b) व (c) स्पष्ट चुकीचे आहे — wordings मुळे एकापेक्षा जास्त option वाजवी वाटले, म्हणून MPSC ने रद्द केला.

questions.text: Elections in India for Parliament and State Legislatures are conducted by _______.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. Article 324 नुसार Parliament व state legislatures च्या निवडणुका Election Commission of India करते. President Governor नियुक्त करतो; State Election Commission पंचायत/नगर निवडणुका — Lok Sabha किंवा Vidhan Sabha नाहीत.

questions.text: Which Article of the Indian Constitution defines the duties of the Chief Minister?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. Article 167 Chief Minister ची Governor प्रती कर्तव्ये सांगते — माहिती, legislative business, Council of Ministers चे निर्णय. Article 163 CM–Governor संबंध; 164 नियुक्ती, कर्तव्ये नाहीत.

questions.text: Which of the following Committee is not related to the Panchayati Raj?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. Rajmannar Committee (1971) Tamil Nadu संदर्भात Centre–State relations तपासली — Panchayati Raj reform नाही. Ashok Mehta, Thungan, L.M. Singhvi committees local self-government मजबूत करण्यासाठी.

questions.text:
Make a group of correct sentences in the composition of the Gram Sabha:
(a) Gram Sabha is formed from all the adult citizens of the village.
(b) Every voter who completes 18 years of age becomes a member of Gram Sabha.
(c) Gram Sabha has election.
(d) All the voters of the Gram Panchayat are members of the Gram Sabha.
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला — फक्त सरावासाठी. Gram Sabha सदस्यत्व panchayat क्षेत्रातील registered voters मधून — (a), (b), (d) overlap, (c) मधील 'election' अस्पष्ट — stem मध्ये एक स्वच्छ official choice शक्य नव्हता.

questions.text:
New responsibilities given to Gram Panchayats as per 73rd Constitution Amendment Act, 1993.
(a) Enforcement of Land Reforms Act
(b) To develop forest industries, small and cottage industries
(c) Facilitate technical and vocational education
(d) To arrange entertainment for the people of the village
Which of the above statement/statements is/are incorrect?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. Eleventh Schedule मध्ये 29 Panchayat subjects — land reforms, cottage industries, vocational education. गावात मनोरंजनाची व्यवस्था constitutional Panchayat function नाही, म्हणून फक्त (d) चुकीचे.

questions.text: Which article states that each state shall have an Advocate General?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. Article 165 नुसार प्रत्येक राज्याला Advocate General असेल — state government चा chief legal adviser. Articles 177, 194, 197 इतर state-legislature व service बाबी, हे पद नाही.

questions.text: Who among the following was the members of the drafting committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Alladi Krishnaswamy Iyer Constituent Assembly च्या Drafting Committee चे सदस्य — B.R. Ambedkar अध्यक्ष. Patel, Nehru, Rajendra Prasad अध्यक्षता केली, पण सात सदस्यीय drafting panel वर नव्हते.

questions.text: Which among the following features of Indian Constitution is not borrowed from British Constitution?
questions.explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. Parliamentary government, Cabinet system, Rule of Law British practice मधून. Concurrent List — Centre व States साठी shared legislative field — Government of India Act 1935 / Australian federal model मधून, Westminster मधून नाही.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the development of transport infrastructure in India?
(a) The Public Work Department was created during the time of Lord Dalhousie.
(b) During the reigns of Lord Cornwallis and John Shore road construction gained momentum.
(c) Broad gauge tracks were built during the early days of the railway.
(d) Nagpur Council presented 'Twenty Years Road Development Programme' to the Government.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. लॉर्ड डलहौसी यांच्या काळात Public Works Department स्थापन झाले आणि Nagpur Road Plan ने वीस वर्षांचा रस्ता कार्यक्रम मांडला — विधाने (a) व (d) बरोबर. Cornwallis व John Shore यांच्या काळात रस्ते बांधणीचा मोठा वेग standard पाठ्यपुस्तके मध्ये मानला जात नाही, आणि early railway days मधील broad gauge हा (b) व (c) बाहेर पडण्याचा मुद्दा.

questions.text:
Match the pair.
(a) 1890, Mumbai Mill Workers Union - (i) Lala Lajpatrai
(b) 1918, Ahmadabad Textile Labour Association - (ii) B.P. Wadiya
(c) 1918, Madras Labour Union - (iii) Mahatma Gandhi
(d) 1920, All India Trade Union Congress - (iv) Narayan Meghaji Lokhande
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. 1890 Mumbai Mill Workers Union — नारायण मेघाजी लोखंडे; 1918 Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association — गांधीजी; Madras Labour Union — B.P. Wadiya; 1920 AITUC — लाला लजपतराय; क्रम (iv), (iii), (ii), (i).

questions.text:
Match the pair place of the Congress Session and his Presidents name.
(a) First Congress Session, Mumbai (1885) - (i) George Yul
(b) Second Congress Session, Calcutta (1886) - (ii) Badruddin Tayyabji
(c) Third Congress Session, Madras (1887) - (iii) Womeshchandra Banarjee
(d) Fourth Congress Session, Allahabad (1888) - (iv) Dadabhai Naoroji
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Mumbai 1885 — वामेशचंद्र बनर्जी; Calcutta 1886 — दादाभाई नौरोजी; Madras 1887 — बदरुद्दीन तैयबजी; Allahabad 1888 — George Yule (पहिले English अध्यक्ष); क्रम (iii), (iv), (ii), (i).

questions.text: In 1847 who was the first to demand the launch of a railway connecting the Mumbai port and the cotton producing regions?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. 1847 मध्ये British free-trade समर्थक John Bright ने Mumbai बंदर व cotton उत्पादक hinterland जोडणारी railway मागणी केली — Indian rail expansion साठी early commercial case.

questions.text:
Government of India Act of 1935 provided for establishment of which institutes?
(a) Federal Court
(b) Reserve Bank of India
(c) Federal Railway
(d) High Commissioner
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. Government of India Act, 1935 ने Federal Court, Reserve Bank of India आणि Federal Railway authority यांची तरतूद केली — High Commissioner पद 1919 च्या earlier framework मधले, या कायद्यात नाही.

questions.text:
Which of the following was the aim of 'Trading Economy' of British Government?
(a) No Trading competition
(b) Maximum profit
(c) Control on economic factors
(d) Economic growth of India
Which of the statement given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. British 'trading economy' India मध्ये Company व Crown साठी maximum profit काढण्याभोवती होती — monopoly, control व Indian industrial growth हे साधने किंवा side-effects; colonial policy मध्ये stated aim नव्हते.

questions.text: What Dr. Bhau Daji Lad was the proponent of?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. डॉ. भाऊ दाजी लाड — vaidya, scholar, Paramhans Sabha सहकाऱ्य — mid-nineteenth-century Bombay मध्ये widow remarriage व social reform चे vocal champion.

questions.text:
Choose the correct option by matching the following:
(a) Acharya Bal Shastri Jambhekar - (i) Establishment of Manav Dharm Sabha at Surat
(b) Durgaram Manchharam, Dadoba Pandurang - (ii) Purification of Shripad Sheshadri Paralikar who was in the custody of Christi Missionary
(c) Annie Besant - (iii) Establishment of Normal School and Victoria Institute
(d) Keshavchandra Sen - (iv) Establishment of Central Hindu-College
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. उत्तरतालिकेनुसार जोड्या (ii), (i), (iv), (iii) — Jambhekar–(ii), Dadoba–Durgaram–Manav Dharm Sabha Surat, Annie Besant–Central Hindu College, Keshav Chandra Sen–(iii). paper मधील यादीनुसार जुळवा, memory ने क्रम बदलू नका.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are false regarding revolt of Santhala?
(a) Economic exploitation of Santhala is presented in Punjab Review.
(b) Santhala declared the decision of establishment of 'State of Truth'.
(c) Kanhu the leader of Santhala was treacherously kidnapped.
(d) O Mauli, the officer gave the report of duel of Santhala.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. Santhal revolt मध्ये 'State of Truth' घोषित झाले आणि O Mauli चा struggle report आहे — (a) Punjab Review व (c) Kanhu चे treacherous kidnapping ही false जोडी.

questions.text:
Match the following organizers of the Secret Militant Organizations in Maharashtra and their areas.
(a) Shridhar Paranjape - (i) Amravati
(b) Dr. Siddhanath Kane - (ii) Belgaum
(c) Dadasaheb Khaparde - (iii) Wardha and Nagpur
(d) Gangadhar Deshpande - (iv) Yavatmal
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. श्रीधर परांजपे Wardha–Nagpur, Gangadhar Deshpande Belgaum belt, दादासाहेब खापर्डे Amravati, डॉ. सिद्धनाथ काने Yavatmal — गुप्त militant networks (iii), (iv), (i), (ii) ने map.

questions.text:
Gopal Ganesh Agarkar was related with which of the following Newspapers?
(a) Kesari and Maratha
(b) Varhad Samachar
(c) Sudharak
(d) Swarajya
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. गोपाळ गणेश आगरकर Kesari, Maratha (Tilak सोबत), Varhad Samachar, Sudharak — standard list मध्ये Swarajya त्यांच्या papers मध्ये मोजले जात नाही.

questions.text:
Identify the person from following description:
(a) He started the Newspaper 'India'
(b) Establishment of Bombay Association
(c) Establishment of East India Association
(d) President of Indian National Congress
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय A. दादाभाई नौरोजी — 'India' newspaper, Bombay Association, East India Association London, INC अध्यक्ष — चारही clues 'Grand Old Man' कडे.

questions.text:
Who made the following statements which caused the growth of Communalism?
(a) Hindu and Muslim are two nations and these are two opposite countries.
(b) The policy of divide and beat has to be adopted in India and Muslims should be kept away from Hindu.
(c) Mahatma Gandhiji's Civil-Disobedience Movement is not totally for freedom of India but to keep Indian Muslims under the domination of Hindu Mahasabha.
(d) Those who are recognizing India as their motherland, India is their nation.

options.A: Principal Bake, Sir Sayyad Ahamad, V.D. Sawarkar, Mohamad Ali Jinnah
options.B: Sir Sayyad Ahamad, Principal Bake, Mohamad Ali Jinnah, V.D. Sawarkar
options.C: V.D. Sawarkar, Mohamad Ali Jinnah, Principal Bake, Sir Sayyad Ahamad
options.D: Mohamad Ali Jinnah, Sir Sayyad Ahmad, V.D. Sawarkar, Principal Bake

questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. Sir Syed Ahmad — दोन राष्ट्रे; Principal Beck — divide-and-rule; Mohammad Ali Jinnah — Civil Disobedience Hindu-dominated; V.D. Savarkar — India motherland — stem मधील क्रम paper नुसार B.

questions.text:
What was the aim of East India Association organisation, established on 1 November 1866?
(a) Female Education
(b) Political Education
(c) People Education
(d) Religious Education
Which of the statement given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. दादाभाई नौरोजी यांचे East India Association (1 नोव्हें 1866) — political awakening व British–Indian public opinion education; 'people education' broad civic अर्थात, फक्त female किंवा religious brief नाही.

questions.text:
Which of the following personalities were related with Bombay Presidency Association Organisation?
(a) Gopal Ganesh Agarkar
(b) Firojshah Mehta
(c) Badruddin Tayyabji
(d) Justice Telang
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Bombay Presidency Association मध्ये Firozshah Mehta, Badruddin Tyabji, Justice Telang — Agarkar इतर reform circles मध्ये; पाठ्यपुस्तके मध्ये core founders मध्ये नाही.

questions.text: In the decade of 1911 to 1921 the Population Growth in the State of Maharashtra was negative. The reason behind it is _______.

options.A: Low birth rate during that period

questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. 1911–1921 दशकात Maharashtra ची population growth negative झाली — मुख्यतः World War I नंतरच्या influenza pandemic मुळे mortality वाढ; low birth rate, floods किंवा industry अभाव एकटे कारण नाहीत.

questions.text: Maharashtra State Agricultural Marketing Board is established in _______.
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला — फक्त सरावासाठी. Maharashtra State Agricultural Marketing Board 1986 असे उत्तरतालिका मध्ये आहे, पण MPSC ने item काढला; गुणांकनात मोजू नका.

questions.text: In India _______ is called as a 'Golden Fiber' crop.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Jute ला silky lustre व sacking–packaging value मुळे 'golden fibre' म्हणतात — cotton 'white gold', wool व silk वेगळ्या labels.

questions.text: Which is the mountain/hill situated on the North-South direction of western Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय D. Sahyadri (Western Ghats) western Maharashtra along north–south — coastal–plateau divide; Satpura पूर्वेकडे, Satmala व Shambhu Mahadev sub-ranges, main N–S chain नाहीत.

questions.text:
Following statements are correct or incorrect?
(a) Commercialisation of agriculture did not promote capitalist - agriculture.
(b) Commercialisation of agriculture intensified tenancy and share-cropping.

options.C: (a) is false and (b) is true statement
options.D: (a) is true and (b) is false statement

questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. उत्तरतालिकेनुसार दोन्ही विधाने false: commercialisation ने capitalist farming promote केले आणि (b) मधील tenancy–share-cropping link या पेपरच्या मांडणीत rejected. पाठ्यपुस्तकाची शब्दरचना वेगळी असेल तर उत्तरतालिका ला defer करा.

questions.text: Iron ore reserves in Maharashtra are located in the district of _______.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Maharashtra चे iron-ore reserves Sindhudurg–Gadchiroli belt (Konkan–Vidarbha fringe) मध्ये; Wardha, Nashik, Buldhana state geography notes मध्ये ore districts म्हणून नाहीत.

questions.text: Following are some of the problems in the agriculture sector in Maharashtra. Which one is more social in nature?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. Farmland fragmentation inheritance customs व family division मुळे — social–institutional problem; weather, research gaps, capital shortage economic किंवा technical constraints.

questions.text: What is the percent share of tourism in India's domestic income as of 2019?
questions.explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. 2019 पर्यंत tourism चा India domestic income मधील share सुमारे 9.34% — उत्तरतालिकेतील precise statistic; 7–9% band जवळचे सापळे पर्याय.

questions.text: One of the following is an important port situated on the west coast of India.
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Kandla (Deendayal Port) Gulf of Kutch — west coast; Chennai, Haldia, Kolkata east coast किंवा Hooghly ports.

questions.text: The average highest temperature in the month of May is recorded in _______ region of Maharashtra.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. Eastern Vidarbha rain-shadowed interior Deccan — May मध्ये राज्यातील सर्वाधिक average temperature; coast व western Maharashtra sea proximity मुळे relatively moderated.

questions.text: Bhilai Iron and Steel Industry is located in the state of _______.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. Bhilai Steel Plant — Second Plan अंतर्गत Soviet सहकार्याने — आजच्या Chhattisgarh (2000 मध्ये Madhya Pradesh मधून) मध्ये Bhilai जवळ आहे. West Bengal मध्ये Durgapur; Odisha मध्ये Rourkela — Bhilai Chhattisgarh belt मध्ये.

questions.text: When State Government in Maharashtra has declared the Blue Revolution Mission?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Maharashtra ने 2017 मध्ये Blue Revolution (Neeli Kranti) Mission जाहीर केले — inland/marine fisheries, cold chain व मत्स्य निर्यात वाढवण्यासाठी. 2018–2020 जवळच्या तारखा फसवणुका.

questions.text:
The population is decreasing continuously in rural area, because:
(a) The birth rate in rural area is low.
(b) The rural people are migrating to urban area.
(c) The employment is not available in rural area.
(d) The death rate is high in rural area.
Which statement/s of the above is true?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. ग्रामीण लोकसंख्या मुख्यत्वे शहरांकडे स्थलांतरामुळे कमी होते — (b). ग्रामीण जन्मदर कमी (a) किंवा मृत्युदर जास्त (d) हे स्वतंत्र कारण नाहीत; रोजगार अभाव (c) स्थलांतराला कारण असू शकते, पण उत्तरतालिका थेट (b) निवडते.

questions.text: Which of the following physiographic factor predominantly influence on climate of Maharashtra?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. Sahyadri (Western Ghats) आणि Satpuda range दक्षिण-पश्चिम मान्सून, orographic पाऊस व Konkan–plateau–Vidarbha तापमान फरक नियंत्रित करतात. Deccan plateau व coastal plains स्थानिक; पण या दोन श्रेण्या Maharashtra च्या हवामानाचे मुख्य घटक.

questions.text: The multipurpose project of Gujarat 'Ukai' is situated on which River?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय B चिन्हांकित केला. Ukai Dam — दक्षिण Gujarat चा मोठा बहुउद्देशीय प्रकल्प — Tapti (Tapi) नदीवर Ukai गावाजवळ. Sabarmati, Mahi, Narmada वर इतर प्रसिद्ध धरणे; Ukai Tapti वर.

questions.text: In which state the number of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies was highest at the end of March 2020?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. March 2020 च्या NABARD आकड्यानुसार Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) च्या संख्येत Maharashtra सर्वाधिक — ग्रामीण अल्पकालीन credit जाळे येथे सर्वात denser. Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat या count मध्ये खाली.

questions.text: The Government appointed a Committee in 1993 on Disinvestment in Public Sector Enterprises under the Chairmanship of _______.
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Rangarajan Committee (1993) ने Narasimha Rao reforms अंतर्गत public-sector disinvestment साठी प्रारंभिक धोरण तयार केले. G.V. Ramakrishna नंतरच्या Disinvestment Commission चे अध्यक्ष; Montek Ahluwalia व C.P. Chandrashekhar इतर समित्या.

questions.text: During 2017-18 Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) was highest 23.6 percent in _______ sector in India.
questions.explanation: पर्याय A निवडा. 2017–18 मध्ये communication services — telecom, media, digital infrastructure — सुमारे 23.6% FDI share, manufacturing व financial services पेक्षा जास्त. spectrum auction, data growth व telecom FDI norms यामुळे.

questions.text: To tackle the burgeoning problem of air pollution, the 2021-22 Budget proposes to provide an amount of Rs. 2217 crore for _______ urban centres with a million-plus population.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. Union Budget 2021–22 ने 42 million-plus शहरांसाठी (10 लाख+ लोकसंख्या) Rs 2,217 crore हवेच्या गुणवत्तेसाठी. 32, 52, 62 संख्या फसवणुका.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Second largest agro based industry in India - (i) Cotton industry
(b) One of the oldest and organised industry in India - (ii) Iron and steel industry
(c) Industry leading to rapid industrialisation - (iii) Sugar industry
(d) Use of new technology - (iv) Automobile industry
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. उद्योग प्रोफाइल: sugar — दुसरा सर्वात मोठा agro-based (a–iii); cotton textiles — जुने organised mills (b–i); iron and steel — heavy industrialisation (c–ii); automobile — modern technology (d–iv).

questions.text: Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) has a right to order conduct of supplementary audit and he may also comment upon the audit report within _______ days from the date of receipt of audit report.
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. CAG audit rules नुसार Comptroller and Auditor General supplementary audit मागू शकतो आणि audit report मिळाल्यापासून 60 दिवसांत comments देणे अपेक्षित — 30, 90, 120 नाही. MPSC ही fixed timeline विचारते.

questions.text: The difference between fiscal deficit and interest payment during the year is called _______.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय C. Primary deficit = fiscal deficit − वर्षभरातील interest payment — म्हणजे जुने कर्जफेड वगळता सध्याचा net borrowing. Fiscal/revenue deficit वेगळे gaps; budget deficit व्यापक informal संज्ञा.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements in the context of Seventh Finance Commission for distribution of the states share of the central excise duty:
(a) 25 percent weightage for population.
(b) 33.5 percent weightage for poor in each state.
(c) 16.5 percent weightage for increase in the per capita income of the state.
(d) 25 percent weightage for income equalisation between state.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A चिन्हांकित केला. central excise duty वाटपासाठी Seventh Finance Commission ने 25% population (a) व 25% income equalisation (d). 33.5% 'गरीब' व 16.5% per-capita-income growth वजन वेगळ्या formula चे — या excise-sharing मध्ये नाहीत.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (Amendment) Act, passed by the Parliament in 2021.
(b) The deposit insurance premium is recovered from the depositors.
(c) The deposit insurance premium is compulsory for all insured banks.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct?

options.D: All of the above are correct

questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. Parliament ने DICGC (Amendment) Act 2021 मध्ये (a), आणि deposit-insurance premium insured banks साठी अनिवार्य (c) — पण premium banks DICGC ला देतात, depositors कडून वसूल नाही, म्हणून (b) चुकीचे.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements:
(a) Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY) was launched September 2001.
(b) Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) was introduced in February 2006.
(c) The Nehru Rozgar Yojana (NRY) was launched in October 1989 for the benefit of the rural poor.
Which of the following statement/s given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. SGRY सप्टेंबर 2001 मध्ये (a), MGNREGS/NREGA फेब्रुवारी 2006 पासून (b) — दोन्ही तारखा बरोबर. NRY (1989)ही historically true, पण उत्तरतालिका (a) आणि (b) only.

questions.text: N.K. Singh Committee of 2016 is related to _______.

options.D: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act

questions.explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. N.K. Singh Committee (2016) ने Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act review केला — debt-to-GDP anchor व escape clauses. Finance Commission किंवा Five-Year Plan नाही; FRBM MPSC budget topic.

questions.text:
Which of the following were the reasons for small land holdings during 1980 to 1985 in India?
(a) Law of inheritance
(b) Rapidly growing population
(c) Rural indebtedness
(d) Rapidly growing joint family system
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. Holding तुटणे — inheritance कायदे (a), लोकसंख्या दाब (b), rural indebtedness (c). वाढता joint-family system (d) जमीन एकत्र ठेवेल — लहान plots च्या विरुद्ध.

questions.text: During which five year plan three major steel plants in the public sector were built up at Rourkela, Bhilai and Durgapur?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Rourkela, Bhilai, Durgapur — तीन integrated public-sector steel plants — Second Five Year Plan (1956–61) चे core. First Plan irrigation/agriculture; Third इतर heavy industry.

questions.text: Which of the following is not objective of National Population Policy 2000?

options.D: Incentive to adopt two child small family

questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. National Population Policy 2000 — infant mortality कमी, universal immunisation, two-child norm प्रोत्साहन. mid-day meal शिक्षण/पोषण योजना, NPP उद्दिष्ट नाही.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a quantitative monetary measure of Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय B. Bank rate, CRR, SLR quantitative — reserves/credit volume किंवा cost निश्चित नियमांनी. Moral suasion qualitative — RBI banks ला persuade, mandatory ratio/rate change नाही.

questions.text: Which of the following substance has the highest thermal conductivity?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. सामान्य घन पदार्थांत silver ची thermal conductivity सर्वाधिक — free electrons heat चांगले वाहतात. Aluminium चांगले पण silver खाली; wood व glass insulators.

questions.text: Light enters the eye through thin membrane called the _______.
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. Cornea पारदर्शक समोरचे झिले; प्रकाश प्रथम त्यातून, नंतर pupil व lens retina वर प्रतिमा. Iris pupil size; retina screen, entry window नाही.

questions.text: Echo is heard if the distance between the source of sound and the obstacle is _______.

options.B: More than or equal to 17 meters

questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. हवेत ~340 m/s — 17 m परत येण्यास ~0.05 s; distinct echo साठी least path. 17 m पेक्षा कमी reflected व direct एकत्र; 17 m+ स्पष्ट वेगळे.

questions.text: In _______ model of an atom, the angular momentum (mvr) of an electron is an integral multiple of the quantity h/2π.
questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Bohr model mvr = n(h/2π) — angular momentum quantised. Rutherford — nucleus, quantisation नाही; Dalton — indivisible spheres; Fermi — nuclear statistics, orbital rule नाही.

questions.text: Choose the incorrect answer:

options.A: Bonding molecular orbitals are formed by the additive effect of the atomic orbitals.
options.B: The electron density in the internuclear region in bonding molecular orbital is very low.
options.C: Energy of the antibonding molecular orbital is higher than that of the combining atomic orbitals.
options.D: Antibonding molecular orbitals are represented by σ*, π*, δ*, etc.

questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. Bonding MO मध्ये internuclear प्रदेशात electron density वाढते — बंध म्हणून. विधान (B) चुकीचे density खूप कमी; ते antibonding MO ला लागू. A, C, D MO theory बरोबर.

questions.text: During biological nitrogen fixation, nitrifying bacteria convert _______.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय C. Nitrifying bacteria ammonium (NH₄⁺) हळूहळू nitrate (NO₃⁻) मध्ये oxidise करतात — हे nitrification; वातावरणातील N₂ → ammonia नाही. प्रश्नात 'nitrogen fixation' शब्द व nitrifiers यांचे मिश्रण; उत्तरतालिकेनुसार NH₄⁺ → NO₃⁻.

questions.text:
Match the following:
(a) Python molurus - (i) Haemotoxic
(b) Naja naja - (ii) Blind snake
(c) Viper russelli - (iii) Neurotoxic
(d) Typhlops braminus - (iv) Non-poisonous
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. Python molurus (Indian rock python) विषारी नाही; Naja naja (cobra) neurotoxic; Viper russelli (Russell's viper) haemotoxic; Typhlops braminus अंध साप — (iv), (iii), (i), (ii).

questions.text: Which one of the following is the correct sequence of larval stages of Aurelia?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Aurelia (jellyfish) जीवनचक्र Planula → Hydratuba → Scyphistoma → Ephyra — polyp scyphistoma अवस्था free-swimming ephyra medusa आधी.

questions.text:
Which of the following is/are group/groups of reptilian animals?
(a) Lizard, Snake, Frog and Loris
(b) Turtle, Gharial, Caiman and Tuatara
(c) Turtle, Crocodile, Salamander and Lizard
(d) Salamander, Catotes, Turtle and Frog
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A. फक्त (b) — Turtle, Gharial, Caiman, Tuatara — हे सर्व reptiles. इतर याद्यांत amphibians (Frog, Salamander) किंवा mammal (Loris) मिसळले.

questions.text:
Irrigation in the fields of saline tract affects the productivity of crops because of:
(a) Degradation of soil structure
(b) Growth inhibition of plants
(c) Leaf discolouration
(d) Salt accumulation in soil
Which of the given above statement/statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. saline tract सिंचनामुळे मातीची रचना बिघडते व मुळांच्या परिसरात क्षार साचतात — (a) व (d). पानांचा decolouration एकटा उत्तरतालिका चा जोड नाही.

questions.text: How the occurrence of Endemic pest is defined?

options.C: Occurs in the same area year after year
options.D: Occurs in an area in severe form

questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय C. Endemic pest त्याच परिसरात वर्षानुवर्षे स्थिर पातळीवर दिसतो — फक्त एक हंगाम 'तीव्र' किंवा 'काही ठिकाणी' नाही.

questions.text: Plants whose seeds are naked, are classified in which group?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Gymnosperms चे बी naked — फळात बंद नाहीत — angiosperms पेक्षा वेगळे. Tracheophyta हा व्यापक vascular-plant division.

questions.text: From the following viruses, which one transfers from one person to other via infected needles or unprotected sex?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. Hepatitis B संक्रमित रक्त, सुई किंवा unprotected sex ने पसरते. Dengue व Hepatitis A वेगळे मार्ग; Rota virus मुख्यत्वे बालांतील diarrhoea.

questions.text: Which scientist discovered small pox vaccine?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B. Edward Jenner ने 1796 मध्ये cowpox साहित्याने smallpox लस विकसित केली. Pasteur — rabies/anthrax; Fleming — penicillin.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to disinfect surfaces?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A चिन्हांकित केला. Ultraviolet (UV) प्रकाश उघड्या पृष्ठभाग disinfect करण्यास वापरला जातो. Autoclave — साधनांचे heat sterilisation; routine surface wipe-down नाही.

questions.text:
Find out which assumption is correct from the given statement.
Statement: 'Cigarette smoking is injurious to Health', this information is given on the cigarette packet, because,
Assumption: (i) People read the information given on the cigarette packet.
(ii) Many people take seriously the warning given on cigarette packet.

options.D: Both (i) and (ii) assumptions are not correct

questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय C. सिगारेट पॅकेटवरील चेतावणी फक्त लोक वाचतील आणि गांभीर्याने घेतील — (i) व (ii) दोन्ही assumptions — तेव्हाच लेबलचा उद्देश पूर्ण.

questions.text:
The percentage distribution of passengers in different trains are shown in a pie-chart: Train A: 13%, Train Q: 19%, Train R: 9%, Train S: 24%, Train M: 20%, Train L: 15%.
Total number of passengers = 8500. What is the average number of passengers in Trains S, M and L together?
questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. Train S, M, L मध्ये 24% + 20% + 15% = 59% म्हणजे 8500 पैकी 5015 प्रवासी; 3 ने भागल्यास सरासरी 1672.

questions.text:
Mango tree is in the middle of Gauva and Lemon tree. Papaya tree is near the Lemon tree but not near the Mango tree and Gauva tree. At the right side of Papaya tree is Coconut tree but at the left side of Gauva tree no any tree.
Which statement/s of following is/are correct?
(i) Lemon tree is between the Papaya and Mango tree.
(ii) Papaya tree is between Coconut and Lemon tree.
(iii) Papaya tree is near Coconut tree.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. डावीकडून उजवीकडे Guava–Mango–Lemon–Papaya–Coconut: Lemon Mango व Papaya दरम्यान, Papaya Lemon व Coconut दरम्यान, Papaya Coconut जवळ — तिन्ही विधाने बरोबर.

questions.text: There are 80 players in a club, of which 36 play Kabaddi and 48 play Cricket. If 12 players play both Kabaddi and Cricket, what is the percentage of players who do not play either Kabaddi or Cricket?
questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C. Kabaddi किंवा Cricket (किंवा दोन्ही) 36 + 48 − 12 = 72; 80 − 72 = 8 कोणतेही नाहीत — 8/80 × 100 = 10%.

questions.text: Six students A, B, C, D, E and F are standing in a row. B is between F and D. E is between A and C. A does not stand next to either F or D. C does not stand next to D. F is between which of the following pair of students?
questions.explanation: MPSC ने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला — गुण मिळत नाहीत. छापलेला seating puzzle सर्व अटींशी जुळणारा एकच row देत नाही; अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेनुसार रद्द.

questions.text: If the letters in the English alphabets, A to M represent number from 1 to 13 respectively and N represent zero and the letters O to Z correspond from -1 to -12, what will be sum of integers for SUCCESS?
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A चिन्हांकित केला. A–M = 1–13, N = 0, O–Z = −1 ते −12; SUCCESS (तीन S) बेरीज −11.

questions.text:
A school has four divisions A, B, C and D of ninth standard students. The results of half-yearly and annual examinations are shown in the table.
Students failed in both exams: A=24, B=25, C=15, D=17
Failed in half-yearly but passed in annual: A=14, B=13, C=18, D=18
Passed in half-yearly but failed in annual: A=8, B=17, C=11, D=15

Which division has the maximum passing rate in the annual examinations?
