title: MPSC Subordinate Services Group B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Pre 2021 (English)

questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. The post of the Sarpanch (who is elected by the members of Gram Panchayat) or Upa Sarpanch, as the case may be, that has fallen vacant (due to resignation) shall be filled in within thirty days from the date of such vacancy.
b. The post of the directly elected Sarpanch that has fallen vacant shall be filled within three months from the date of such vacancy.
c. A member of a Gram Panchayat whose post has become vacant due to absence for continuous meetings of the Gram Panchayat shall not be eligible for re-election.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Under Maharashtra's Gram Panchayat rules, a Sarpanch or Upa-Sarpanch vacancy caused by resignation must be filled within thirty days — statement (a) holds. A directly elected Sarpanch vacancy follows a longer election cycle (not the three-month rule in (b)), and absence from meetings alone does not permanently bar re-election as (c) claims.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements about the provisions of the Village Development Committees of Maharashtra Gram Panchayat Act :
a. The total number of members in a Village Development Committee shall not be less than seven and not more than seventeen.
b. Not less than one-third of its members shall be from amongst the members of the Gram Panchayat.
c. Not less than one-half of the members shall be women.
d. The Deputy Sarpanch shall be its ex-officio chairman.
e. Gram Sevak shall be its ex-officio member-secretary.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?

options.A: Only a, b, c and d
options.C: Only a, b, c and e

questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. A Village Development Committee must have at least one-third members from the Gram Panchayat, at least half women, and the Gram Sevak as ex-officio member-secretary — (b), (c), and (e). The member ceiling in (a) and making the Deputy Sarpanch ex-officio chairman in (d) do not match the Act.

questions.text: The 'Sarkaria Commission' favoured _______.

options.A: abolition of the office of the Governor

questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Sarkaria Commission (1983) reviewed Centre–State relations and recommended stronger cooperation — it did not call for abolishing the Governor, All India Services, or the Inter-State Council. All three options describe abolition the Commission never favoured.

questions.text: Which one of the following statements is correct about the Advocate General of the State ?

options.A: He shall hold office during the pleasure of the State Council of Ministers.
options.B: His remuneration is determined by the State Legislature.
options.C: He may appear as an advocate in cases against the State Government for a private party.

questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. The Advocate General holds office during the Governor's pleasure (not the Council of Ministers), remuneration is fixed by the Governor (not the Legislature), and he cannot appear against the State Government for a private party — so none of (A)–(C) stands.

questions.text:
Assertion (A) : Legislative control over administration in a Parliamentary system is different from that of Presidential system.
Reason (B) : An important feature of democratic government is the legislative control over administration.

options.A: Both 'A' and 'B' are true and 'B' is the correct explanation of 'A'.
options.B: Both 'A' and 'B' are true, but 'B' is not the correct explanation of 'A'.

questions.explanation: On this one, option B. Both assertions are true: parliamentary and presidential systems exercise legislative control over the executive differently, and democratic government does involve such control. But (B) states a general democratic fact — it does not explain why the two systems differ, so it is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.text:
Which of the following statements related to 'Money Bill' is/are correct ?
a. It can be introduced either by a minister or by a private member.
b. It cannot be introduced except on the recommendation of the Governor.
c. If any question arises whether the bill is a money bill or not, the decision of the Governor is final.
d. In case of a deadlock over a money bill, the Governor can summon a joint sitting of Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: Go with option B. At the state level a Money Bill can be introduced only on the Governor's recommendation — that is (b) alone. Private members cannot introduce it ((a) wrong), the Speaker (not the Governor) decides money-bill disputes ((c) wrong), and there is no joint sitting route for a state money-bill deadlock ((d) wrong).

questions.text: The Parliament of India acquires the power to legislate on any subject on the State List in national interest if a resolution to that effect is passed by the

options.A: Lok Sabha by a majority of its total membership.
options.B: Lok Sabha by a majority of not less than two-thirds of its total membership.
options.C: Rajya Sabha by a majority of its total membership.
options.D: Rajya Sabha by a majority of not less than two-thirds of its members present and voting.

questions.explanation: Pick option D. Article 249 empowers Parliament to legislate on a State List subject when the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution by not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting — not a simple Lok Sabha majority, and not two-thirds of the Rajya Sabha's total strength.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements with reference to Maharashtra :
a. Zilla Parishad may meet as often as may be necessary, but one month shall not intervene its last meeting and the date of its next meeting.
b. The President of Zilla Parishad shall call a special meeting on the written request of not less than one-fifth members.
c. Every meeting shall be presided over by the President, or if he is absent, the Vice President shall preside over it.
d. In the absence of President and Vice President, the meeting shall be presided over by the Chairman of subject committee.
Which of the above statements are correct ?
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The keyed option was A (only a, b and c), but Zilla Parishad meeting intervals and who presides when both President and Vice-President are absent vary across Maharashtra Panchayat Act provisions — the stem allowed more than one reading, so MPSC withdrew it.

questions.text: Generally, the High Court of a State consists of a Chief Justice and _______.

options.B: such other Judges as may be determined by the Governor
options.C: such other Judges as may be determined by the Parliament
options.D: such other Judges as may be determined by the President

questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Article 216 says every High Court consists of a Chief Justice and such other Judges as the President may from time to time deem necessary — not a fixed bench of nine, nor a number fixed by the Governor or Parliament alone.

questions.text: The Constituent Assembly appointed a number of committees to deal with different tasks and works of Constitution-making. Who was the Chairman of the Rules of Procedure Committee ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Dr Rajendra Prasad chaired the Constituent Assembly's Rules of Procedure Committee. Ambedkar headed the Drafting Committee; Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar and K.M. Munshi were on drafting work but not this particular chairmanship.

questions.text:
Match the pairs :
       A                                    B
a. Balshastri Jambhekar      I. Establishment of Widow Home
b. Gopal Hari Deshmukh      II. First supporter of female education
c. Mahatma Jyotiba Phule    III. Congregation for remarriage
d. Maharshi Dhondo Keshav Karve  IV. Orphanage
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Balshastri Jambhekar backed early female education (a–II); Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh worked for widow remarriage (b–III); Jyotiba Phule ran orphanage and social institutions (c–IV); Maharshi Karve founded the Widow Home (d–I). That full set is option B.

questions.text:
The first Aviation Company that was started in 1932 by an Indian Industrialist was :
a. Indian National Airways
b. Tata Airways Ltd.
c. Imperial Airways
d. Indian Trans-Continental Airways Ltd.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The keyed answer was A (Indian National Airways and Tata Airways), but 1932 aviation history is contested — J.R.D. Tata's Tata Airlines is widely cited as the pioneering Indian company while Indian National Airways followed; the wording did not settle one fair choice.

questions.text:
"For realistic progress of the nation, progressive religion should be spread out. As long as religious awareness is happening, till then realistic success is not achieved." This opinion was of
a. Dr. Bhandarkar G.G.
b. Justice Ranade
c. Justice Telang
d. Dr. Atmaram Pandurang Turkhadkar

questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The keyed pairing was Dr Bhandarkar and Dr Atmaram Pandurang Turkhadkar for the progressive-religion quote, but similar reformist language appears across Prarthana Samaj thinkers — attributing the exact sentence to specific names was not reliable enough for scoring.

questions.text: Narayan Meghaji Lokhande presented the questions of workers in which of the following newspapers ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande — Maharashtra's pioneer trade-union organiser — raised mill-workers' demands through the newspaper Deenbandhu from the 1880s. Samachar Chandrika, Prabhakar, and Dnyanprakash were other periodicals, not his labour platform.

questions.text:
Match the following :
       A                        B
a. Pandita Ramabai    I. 'Stree-Purush Tulana' Book
b. Ramabai Ranade     II. Establishment of Nirashrit Seva Sadan
c. Tarabai Shinde     III. Establishment of Sharada Sadan
d. Janakka Shinde     IV. Establishment of 'Hindu Ladies Social Club'
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Pandita Ramabai opened Sharada Sadan (a–III); Ramabai Ranade helped start the Hindu Ladies Social Club (b–IV); Tarabai Shinde authored Stree-Purush Tulana (c–I); Janakka Shinde was linked to Nirashrit Seva Sadan (d–II).

questions.text:
Paramhans Sabha was established at Mumbai in 1849 and gave the emphasis on the following reforms :
a. Widow Remarriage
b. Women's Education
c. Break the Caste Barrier
d. Acceptance of Idol Worship
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. Paramhans Sabha (1849, Mumbai), founded by Dadoba Pandurang, stressed breaking caste barriers and rejected idol worship. Widow remarriage, women's education, and accepting idol worship were not its programme — only (c) fits.

questions.text:
Match the following regarding and emergence of Indian workers and Labour movement :
       A                           B
a. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande   I. First President of All India Trade Union Congress
b. Mahatma Gandhi             II. Establishment of Madras Labour Union
c. B.P. Wadia                 III. Establishment of Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association
d. Lala Lajpat Rai            IV. Placed the problems of labour through Deenbandhu newspaper
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: Go with option A. Lokhande publicised labour issues in Deenbandhu (a–IV); Gandhi built the Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association (b–III); B.P. Wadia helped form the Madras Labour Union (c–II); Lala Lajpat Rai became the first president of the All India Trade Union Congress (d–I).

questions.text:
Who made the following thoughts/statements regarding the effects of colonialism on Indians ?
a. Indian economy ran overseas.
b. Due to economic abstraction, world known enriched India became poverty stricken.
c. An exploitation of Indian economy is like Ransom.
d. By taking sword in hand it is time to manage our business.
Answer Options :

options.A: a-Ramesh Chandra Dutt, b-Justice Ranade, c-Sir George Oxenden, d-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh
options.B: a-Justice Ranade, b-Sir George Oxenden, c-Ramesh Chandra Dutt, d-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh
options.C: a-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh, b-Ramesh Chandra Dutt, c-Justice Ranade, d-Sir George Oxenden
options.D: a-Justice Ranade, b-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh, c-Sir George Oxenden, d-Ramesh Chandra Dutt

questions.explanation: Pick option C. Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh argued the Indian economy was run for overseas benefit (a); R.C. Dutt showed how a once-rich India was reduced to poverty through economic drain (b); Justice Ranade compared colonial exploitation to ransom (c); Sir George Oxenden's line about taking the sword to manage our own business closes the set (d).

questions.text: According to Dadabhai Naoroji, 'What was being drained out was _______, that could generate more economic development if invested in India.' Fill in the blanks with the given right option.
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Dadabhai Naoroji's 'drain of wealth' thesis held that what Britain extracted was India's potential surplus — income that, if invested at home, could have fuelled further development. Handicrafts, currency alone, or cotton output alone miss his core economic argument.

questions.text:
Which of the following crops production increased due to commercialization of agriculture during British Period ?
a. Tea, Wheat
b. Sugarcane, Cotton
c. Jute, Indigo
d. Tobacco, Opium
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Under commercial agriculture the British pushed export-oriented crops — sugarcane and cotton, jute and indigo, tobacco and opium ((b), (c), (d)). Tea expansion and wheat as a paired commercialisation claim in (a) is the weak link here.

questions.text: Which award was given to Pandita Ramabai by the British Government ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The British Government honoured Pandita Ramabai with the Kaisar-i-Hind medal for her social and humanitarian work. The other option spellings are not the actual imperial award title.

questions.text:
Who was the first leader of the revolution of native for farmers ?
a. Baba Bhand    b. Bijania    c. Kajara Singh    d. Tantya Bhilla
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Tantya Bhilla (Tantia Bhil) led one of the earliest armed peasant/tribal revolts against oppressive land revenue — treated in Maharashtra history as the first major leader of the native farmers' rebellion. Baba Bhand, Bijania, and Kajara Singh do not carry that 'first leader' tag in standard texts.

questions.text: The Civil Rebellion began from which of the following regions ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Civil Rebellion phase of 1857 spread earliest and most intensely from Bengal and Bihar — the sepoy mutiny at Meerut linked with civilian uprisings across the Gangetic heartland before rippling elsewhere.

questions.text:
Identify the following people who have done work for emancipation of women :
a. The problem of child marriage was placed in the famous Drama : 'Sharda'.
b. Before the Hunter Commission, the condition of women's education was placed in numerical data.
c. 'Shardashram' was established for widows.
d. 'Maze Puran' an autobiography was written.
Answer Options :

options.A: a-Pandita Ramabai, b-Govind Ballal, c-Anandibai Karve, d-Ramabai Ranade
options.B: a-Ramabai Ranade, b-Anandibai Karve, c-Pandita Ramabai, d-Govind Ballal
options.C: a-Vidhyaben Nilkanth, b-Ramabai Ranade, c-Anandibai Karve, d-Govind Ballal
options.D: a-Govind Ballal, b-Pandita Ramabai, c-Ramabai Ranade, d-Anandibai Karve

questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The keyed mapping was (a) Pandita Ramabai–Sharda drama, (b) Govind Ballal–Hunter Commission data, (c) Anandibai Karve–Shardashram, (d) Ramabai Ranade–Maze Puran, but several reformers share overlapping credits on these themes — the pair list was not exam-safe.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the Revolt of 1857 ?
a. With treacherous attitude Pant Sachiv of Bhor Chimnaji Raghunath (first) tendered Rango Bapuji Gupte to Britishers.
b. Rani Bakabai of Nagpur Bhosale Dynasty supported the revolters.
c. Chimasaheb of Kolhapur Chhatrapati Dynasty participated in revolt.
d. Son of Rango Bapuji Gupte Sitarampant and Ramji Shirsal of Sawantwadi also participated in the Revolt.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. In Maharashtra's 1857 story, Pant Sachiv Chimnaji Raghunath of Bhor betrayed Rango Bapuji Gupte (a); Kolhapur's Chhatrapati Chimasaheb joined the revolt (c); Sitarampant (Rango's son) and Ramji Shirsal of Sawantwadi took part (d). Rani Bakabai of Nagpur did not support the rebels — so (b) is excluded.

questions.text: The longest National Highway in India is _______.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. NH 44 — earlier numbered NH 7 — runs Srinagar to Kanyakumari and is India's longest highway at roughly 4,000 km. NH 1, NH 48, and NH 6 are major corridors but shorter than this north–south trunk route.

questions.text:
Match the Industrial Regions and Industrial Areas :
       District        Irrigation Scheme
a. Nashik          I. Butibori
b. Kolhapur        II. Shendra
c. Nagpur          III. Vinchur
d. Aurangabad      IV. Hupari
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Nashik pairs with Vinchur (III), Kolhapur with Hupari (IV), Nagpur with Butibori (I), and Aurangabad with Shendra (II) — each district mapped to its recognised MIDC/industrial node. Ignore the misprinted 'Irrigation Scheme' header; match the industrial-area names the list gives.

questions.text:
The salient features of Aurangabad Industrial City :
a. Well-planned and greenfield smart city.
b. The abbreviation is AURIC.
c. The total investment will be ₹ 1,000 crs.
d. It is a part of Delhi-Mumbai industrial corridor.
Choose the correct option :
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. AURIC is a DMIC-linked greenfield smart city and its name stands for Aurangabad Industrial City — (a), (b), and (d) hold. Statement (c) fixing total investment at exactly ₹1,000 crore understates the phased project outlay in official briefs.

questions.text: India's population growth and temporal changes during 1981 to 2011 indicates the population transition stage of

options.A: Period of High growth with declining trend

questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Between 1981 and 2011 India's population kept growing in absolute terms but the growth rate was slowing — fertility fell and the curve shows high growth with a declining trend, not rapid acceleration or stagnation.

questions.text: Which State of India accounted for the second rank in National Highway length as per report of Basic Road Statistics of India, 2017 ?
questions.explanation: On this one, option D. Basic Road Statistics of India (2017) placed Uttar Pradesh second among states in National Highway length — Maharashtra often leads the table, but UP held the second slot in that report year.

questions.text: Which one of the following regions indicates the example of high intensity zone of earthquake in India ?

options.B: Himalayan Belt from Kashmir to Assam

questions.explanation: Go with option B. The Himalayan belt from Kashmir to Assam sits in India's highest seismic-intensity zone — young collision tectonics and repeated great earthquakes. The Peninsula, central block, and Ganga plain are comparatively lower-intensity on standard zoning maps.

questions.text:
As per 2011 Census, which sentences is/are false for urbanization in Maharashtra ?
a. The percentage of urban population is 45.23.
b. Maharashtra stands third in urban population.
c. Urban population of Maharashtra is 5,08,27,500.
d. The lowest urbanization level is in the Nandurbar district of Maharashtra.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The 2011 Census urbanisation figures for Maharashtra — percentage, rank, headcount, and district-wise lows — do not line up cleanly enough for one scored option; MPSC withdrew the item.

questions.text:
Match the correct pairs of Irrigation Schemes and Districts in Maharashtra :
       District        Irrigation Scheme
a. Satara          I. Mukane
b. Nashik          II. Vishnupuri
c. Nanded          III. Kanher
d. Yavatmal        IV. Bembala
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: Pick option B. Kanher belongs to Satara (III), Mukane to Nashik (I), Vishnupuri to Nanded (II), and Bembala to Yavatmal (IV) — option B gives a–III, b–I, c–II, d–IV. Swapping Mukane to Satara or Kanher to Nashik breaks the standard Maharashtra irrigation map.

questions.text: The State which produces natural gas and mineral oil in India is _______.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Assam — Digboi and the broader Brahmaputra valley — produces both mineral oil and natural gas among the states listed. Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, and Goa lack comparable hydrocarbon production profiles in Indian energy geography.

questions.text: Which of the following options shows the correct ascending order by length of the tributaries of Godavari river ?
questions.explanation: MPSC cancelled this question — no scored answer. The ascending length order of Godavari tributaries as printed allows more than one defensible sequence depending on source and measuring point; treat it as withdrawn on the official answer key.

questions.text: On the basis of soil formation, the first detailed and scientific soil classification of Maharashtra was done in 1938 by :
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Dr Basu and Dr Shirur carried out the first detailed scientific soil classification of Maharashtra in 1938. Smith, Kellogg–Thorp, and Dokuchaev belong to global or foreign classification traditions, not this state-specific survey.

questions.text: Which creeks are included in the 'Central Konkan' of Maharashtra's Konkan Regional Division ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Central Konkan in Maharashtra's regional division covers Rajapuri, Bankot, and Kelshi creeks — mid-coast estuaries between the southern and northern Konkan blocks. Deogarh–Karli, Dharamtar–Terekhol, and Dahanu–Vasai sets belong to other subdivisions.

questions.text: The Laccadive islands and Minicoy islands are separated by
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The Nine Degree Channel separates the Laccadive island group from Minicoy in the Lakshadweep archipelago. Eight Degree Channel lies further north; Ten Degree separates Andaman from Nicobar.

questions.text: As per G.T. Trewartha's climate classification, Western Coastal Plain and Tripura State exhibit which of the following types of climate ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. In G T Trewartha's scheme the western coastal plain and Tripura fall under tropical monsoon (Am) climate — heavy seasonal rain in humid tropics. Humid mountain, tropical arid, and humid sub-tropical codes fit Himalayan, desert, or interior settings, not this pairing.

questions.text: Which of the following percentage indicates the proportion of rain received in Maharashtra from North-Western monsoon ?
questions.explanation: On this one, option C. According to the answer key, about 85% of Maharashtra's annual rainfall comes from the southwest monsoon current — the bulk of the state's precipitation budget in standard geography texts. The stem says 'North-Western monsoon'; if your textbook wording differs, defer to the key figure of 85%.

questions.text: _______ was introduced in 1995 for inexpensive and speedy settlement of bank customer disputes.
questions.explanation: Go with option C. The Banking Ombudsman Scheme, introduced in 1995, gives bank customers an inexpensive and speedy forum for dispute redress — RBI's dedicated grievance layer. Prudential norms, customer-service committees, and accounting standards serve different regulatory functions.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. After Independence, the Government of India appointed the National Income Committee in August, 1948.
b. The committee consisted of Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis, Prof. D.R. Gadgil and Prof. V.K.R.V. Rao.
c. The first report of the National Income Committee appeared in 1951 and the final report in 1954.
Which of the statements given above is/are incorrect ?
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: Pick option A. The National Income Committee did include Mahalanobis, Gadgil, and V K R V Rao and its reports came in 1951 and 1954 — (b) and (c) stand. Statement (a) alone is keyed incorrect, likely over the August 1948 appointment date versus the accepted 1949 chronology in standard accounts.

questions.text: _______ is the apex organisation to provide credit for the promotion of agriculture and allied activities in rural areas.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. NABARD is the apex body for promoting agricultural and allied rural credit through cooperatives and regional rural banks. RBI regulates; SBI is a commercial bank — neither carries NABARD's distinct apex refinance mandate.

questions.text: What is the biggest source of income for the Central Government in the Union Budget 2021 – 22 ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. In Union Budget 2021–22, borrowing and other liabilities formed the largest single receipt head — ahead of GST, income tax, or corporate tax individually — reflecting pandemic-year deficit financing through market borrowings.

questions.text: According to the 2011 Census, the density of population in the country is _______.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Census 2011 put India's population density at 382 persons per square kilometre — up from 325 in 2001. The 117, 157, and 282 figures belong to earlier decades or misquoted averages, not the all-India 2011 headline.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements is not correct regarding qualitative characteristics of India's population and urbanisation ?
(1) There is positive co-relation between per capital income and urbanisation.
(2) There is no co-relation between urbanisation and employment.
(3) There is increase in standard of living with urbanisation.
(4) There is negative relationship between urbanisation and population below poverty line.

options.A: There is positive co-relation between per capital income and urbanisation.
options.B: There is no co-relation between urbanisation and employment.
options.C: There is increase in standard of living with urbanisation.
options.D: There is negative relationship between urbanisation and population below poverty line.

questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The stem asks which statement about urbanisation and per capita income is not correct, but more than one option could be argued from different textbook framings; MPSC withdrew it rather than score one letter.

questions.text: Which of the following market segments is growth and profit oriented in the Indian Commercial Banking System ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Indian commercial banks treat retail banking — personal accounts, loans, cards, and cross-sell — as the high-growth, profit-oriented segment. Mutual funds, mobile, and internet channels support delivery but retail drives the margin story the syllabus highlights.

questions.text:
Productivity in Indian agriculture is mainly dependent on two sets of factors. Those are :
a. Technological Factors
b. Human Resource
c. Institutional Factors
d. Irrigation Facilities
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Agricultural productivity in India is mainly explained by technological inputs — seeds, mechanisation, plant protection — and institutional factors such as land tenure, credit, extension, and marketing. Human-resource or irrigation-only pairings capture partial drivers, not the keyed dual set.

questions.text:
Which of the following is/are the objectives of Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003 ?
a. To set limits on government borrowings under a time-bound programme.
b. To achieve zero revenue deficit and bring down fiscal deficits.
c. To make the government responsible for ensuring long term macroeconomic stability.
d. Improving transparency in the fiscal operations of the government.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: On this one, option B. The FRBM Act 2003 sets borrowing limits on a time-bound path, targets zero revenue deficit and lower fiscal deficit, secures long-term macro stability, and improves fiscal transparency — all four objectives appear in the statute, so 'all of the above' is the match.

questions.text: Which of the following is not an important objective of Special Economic Zones in India ?
questions.explanation: Go with option C. SEZ policy aims at extra economic activity, exports, and employment through industrial and tax incentives — not primary-sector agriculture development. Agriculture sits outside the export-processing and manufacturing logic SEZ notifications emphasise.

questions.text: The infant mortality rate is the number of deaths of children under _______ of age in a given geographical area during a given year, per 1000 live births.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Infant mortality rate counts deaths of children under one year of age per 1,000 live births in a given area and year — not one month, week, or day.

questions.text: According to Chief Economic Advisor Krishnamurthy Subramaniam (Economic Survey 2020-21), what may be the shape of Economic recovery ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Chief Economic Adviser Krishnamurthy Subramanian, in the Economic Survey 2020-21, argued India's rebound after the COVID shock could follow a V-shaped recovery — a sharp fall followed by a relatively quick upturn.

questions.text: What is the range of tax rates for taxable income as per the Union Budget, 2020 of India ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. Union Budget 2020 retained the new personal income-tax slabs with rates from 5% up to 30% on taxable income — not 25%, 35%, or a 20% ceiling.

questions.text:
Which of the following statements are correct ?
a. The price of electricity for Indian households is lowest in the world.
b. The price of electricity for Indian industries is highest in the world.
c. Cost recovery in distribution of power is satisfactory in India.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Economic Survey data do not support any of the three claims: household power is not the world's cheapest, industrial tariffs are not the world's highest, and cost recovery in distribution remains weak — so none of a, b, or c holds.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. International trade is based on differences in prices of goods and services from country to country.
b. The terms of trade refer to the exchange ratio of export and import goods or their price ratio.
c. The Balance of Payments record in International Trade is maintained in a standard double entry book-keeping method.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. International trade rests on cross-country price differences (a); terms of trade measure export–import price ratios (b); and the balance of payments is kept in standard double-entry form (c) — all three statements stand.

questions.text: A neutron having energy of 0.025 eV is a/an _______.
questions.explanation: On this one, option A. A neutron with about 0.025 eV energy is at room-temperature thermal energy — the slow neutrons used in thermal reactors — not epithermal, fast, or merely 'slow' in the loose sense.

questions.text: Transfer of heat from a body at low temperature to a body at higher temperature is

options.B: possible by keeping both the bodies in contact
options.C: possible by doing some external work

questions.explanation: Go with option C. Heat will not flow spontaneously from a colder to a hotter body, but a refrigerator or heat pump can move it that way by doing external work — exactly what the Second Law allows.

questions.text: The minimum audible frequency of sound means
questions.explanation: Pick option B. The minimum audible frequency is the lower pitch limit of human hearing — roughly 20 Hz — not threshold intensity (loudness) or the upper pitch cut-off.

questions.text: Diamond is a _______.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Diamond is a covalent network crystal — each carbon bonded tetrahedrally in a giant lattice — not metallic, ionic, or a simple molecular crystal.

questions.text: The high strength-to-weight ratio of _______ alloy mainly recommends their use in aircraft and automobile industries.
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Light aluminium alloys give high strength for low weight, which is why aircraft and automobile bodies rely on them more than on light steel, titanium, or copper.

questions.text: In lower atmosphere, smog is formed by the reaction between hydrocarbon and nitrogen oxide. This interaction produces _______ as secondary pollutants.
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. Photochemical smog from hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides yields a full basket of secondary pollutants — ozone, aldehydes, ketones, and peroxyacyl nitrates (PAN) — not just one or two classes.

questions.text:
Amoeba is a protozoan animal because
a. it is a cellular animal without tissues and organs.
b. it is the simplest and most primitive of all animals.
c. pseudopodia is present for locomotion.
d. it is a pore-bearing animal.
Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Amoeba is a single-celled protozoan without tissues or organs (a), among the simplest animals (b), and moves by pseudopodia (c) — pore-bearing (d) describes sponges, not amoeba.

questions.text:
Choose the correct pair/pairs of the animal/animals and their scientific name/names ?
a. Asiatic lion — Panthera leo persica
b. Royal Bengal Tiger — Panthera tigris
c. Indian Rhinoceros — Rhinoceros unicornis
d. Thamin Deer — Cervus eldi
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. All four pairings check out: Asiatic lion — Panthera leo persica; Royal Bengal Tiger — Panthera tigris; Indian Rhinoceros — Rhinoceros unicornis; Thamin Deer — Cervus eldi.

questions.text: Which of the following animal group/groups was/were the first vertebrate to become adapted to life on land ?

options.A: Only c and d (Mammals and Aves)
options.B: Only b and d (Amphibians and Aves)

questions.explanation: On this one, option D. Amphibians were the first vertebrates to colonise land, bridging aquatic and terrestrial life — reptiles, birds, and mammals adapted later.

questions.text: Who discovered the natural classification system of plants ?
questions.explanation: Go with option B. Bentham and Hooker's *Genera Plantarum* laid out a natural classification of flowering plants by affinity — Theophrastus and Linnaeus came earlier; G.M. Smith worked on algae.

questions.text: Which of the following is the causal organism of Wheat Rust disease ?
questions.explanation: Pick option A. Wheat rust is caused by the fungus *Puccinia graminis* tritici — the classic black/stem rust pathogen — not citrus, sorghum, or grape downy-mildew organisms.

questions.text: In Agriculture, groundwater is tapped by _______.
questions.explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Farmers reach groundwater by sinking tubewells or bore wells into the aquifer — canals, ponds, and tanks store or convey surface water instead.

questions.text: Which of the following cholesterol is considered as good cholesterol ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. HDL cholesterol carries excess cholesterol back to the liver for disposal — the 'good' fraction — whereas LDL and VLDL raise arterial risk.

questions.text: When kidney tubular reabsorption fails, copious urination follows. What is this disease (metabolic disorder) called ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. When kidney tubules fail to reabsorb water, the patient passes huge volumes of dilute urine — diabetes insipidus — not the sugar-driven polyuria of diabetes mellitus.

questions.text: Which of the following vaccine is administered by oral route ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Sabin polio vaccine is given orally (OPV); BCG, Salk polio, and MMR are injected routes.

questions.text: A devotee, while going to pray in the temple, put flowers on each step that indicated its number. When he offered 9 flowers to God, he had 17 flowers in balance. If the temple had 24 steps, then how many flowers did the devotee have ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Flowers on steps 1 through 24 total 1+2+…+24 = 300; after offering 9 to God and keeping 17, the devotee started with 300+9+17 = 326 flowers.

questions.text: Srikant stands facing north on the ground. He turns right and travels 30 km. Then he turns left and travels 20 km. Again he turns right and travels 40 km. Again he turns right and travels 35 km. Which direction is he facing now ?
questions.explanation: On this one, option D. From North: right to East (30 km), left to North (20 km), right to East (40 km), right to South (35 km) — he ends facing South.

questions.text:
The following question consists of five statements followed by several options consisting of three statements put together in a specific order. Choose the option which indicates a valid argument i.e. the third statement is a conclusion drawn from the preceding two statements.
Statements :
a. Amit is a boy.
b. Some boys do not play cricket.
c. No girl plays cricket.
d. Amit plays cricket.
e. All those who play cricket are boys.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The official answer key cancelled this question — treat it for practice only. The keyed option was A (d, c, a), but the syllogism chain from 'Amit plays cricket' and 'No girl plays cricket' to 'Amit is a boy' does not follow validly — MPSC withdrew it.

questions.text: In a class of 100 students, 40 students passed in Mathematics and 60 passed in English. 8 students failed in both Mathematics and English. How many students passed in both the subjects ?
questions.explanation: Go with option C. Eight failed both, so 92 passed at least one subject; both-pass = Maths + English − at least one = 40+60−92 = 8.

questions.text: There are 8 points in a plane, no three of which are collinear. If lines are drawn by joining two points, how many such lines would be drawn ?
questions.explanation: Pick option D. With 8 points and no three collinear, every line joins two points — number of lines = ⁸C₂ = 8×7/2 = 28.

questions.text: Niraj's watch is fast by 5½ minutes in a day. Piyush's watch lags behind by 35 seconds per hour. If their watches indicated the same time at 8 o'clock in the morning, then by how many minutes would Neeraj's watch be ahead of Piyush's watch that night at 12 o'clock ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option B. From 8 a.m. to midnight is 16 hours: Niraj's watch gains 5½ × (16/24) = 11/3 minutes, and Piyush's loses 35 × 16 ÷ 60 = 28/3 minutes — together 13 minutes ahead.

questions.text:
By which Venn-diagram can the given sets of words be shown ?
Teachers, Writers, Married persons.

options.C: Two overlapping circles with one separate

questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Some teachers are writers, some writers are married, and each set can overlap the others — three mutually intersecting circles capture all three possibilities.

questions.text: If A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, ....., Z = 26, then how will you write the word 'GODFATHER' ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Letter values G-O-D-F-A-T-H-E-R give 7-15-4-6-1-20-8-5-18 — match each alphabet position to its number in order.

questions.text:
In the following question, events I and II are given. You have to read both carefully and decide their nature of relationship. You have to assume that the given information in I and II are true and decide the correct answer.
Events :
I. Mr. Hari was killed in a fire.
II. A fire broke out in the company.
Answer Options :

options.A: I is the effect and II is its principal cause.
options.B: II is the effect and I is its principal cause.
options.C: II is the effect, but I is not its principal cause.
options.D: None of the above is correct.

questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. A company fire and Mr Hari's death in some fire are separate facts — without proof they are the same incident, no option correctly fixes cause and effect.

questions.text:
Find the odd man out from the following numbers :
343, 324, 3375, 10648, 64
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. 343, 3375, 10648 and 64 are perfect cubes (7³, 15³, 22³, 4³); 324 = 18² is a square, not a cube — the odd one out.

questions.text: Niraj covered the first 20 km distance, out of a total of 60 km, at a speed of 10 km/hr, the next 20 km distance at 12 km/hr and the remaining 20 km distance at 15 km/hr. What is the average speed of Niraj to cover the 60 km distance ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Time for three equal 20 km legs: 20/10 + 20/12 + 20/15 = 5 hours total; average speed = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 km/hr.

questions.text: Neha can do a work in 6 days and Rekha can do it in 18 days. How many days would it take them to do the same work if they worked together ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Combined rate 1/6 + 1/18 = 2/9 per day, so Neha and Rekha finish together in 9/2 = 4.5 days.

questions.text: The simple interest and compound interest for 2 years of a sum is ₹ 1,800 and ₹ 1,890 respectively. What is the rate of interest per cent per annum ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. CI minus SI for 2 years equals P(r/100)²; with SI = 1800 giving Pr/50 = 1800, the extra ₹90 fixes r at 10% per annum.

questions.text: Which of the following is in descending order ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option C. As decimals: 9/13 ≈ 0.692, 11/17 ≈ 0.647, 5/8 = 0.625 — descending order is 9/13, then 11/17, then 5/8.

questions.text: On reducing the entry fee by 35% in a park, the number of visitors increased by 40%. Then the percent increase or decrease in the income from the entry fee is
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. New revenue = 0.65 × 1.40 = 0.91 of the original — a 9% decrease, not a simple 5% net change.

questions.text:
According to the report of the National Crime Registration Department, the information related to Child Crime is as follows :
a. In the year 2018, 109 children were sexually abused every day.
b. 39827 such incidents were reported in 2018.
c. In 2018, there were 21401 incidents of rape of girls.
d. The highest 2832 incidents of rape on children occurred in Maharashtra (2018).
Which of the above statements are correct ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. All four statements match the NCRB 2018 child-crime figures cited in that year's report — daily abuse count, total incidents, girl rape cases and Maharashtra's top rank.

questions.text: Department of AIDS control has been merged with _______ and now it is known as National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO).

options.B: Department of Health and Family Welfare

questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The erstwhile Department of AIDS Control was merged into the Department of Health and Family Welfare and now functions as NACO under that ministry.

questions.text: The schools, colleges, universities, educational as well as private institutions may witness historical places. Keeping this aim in view, which is the first State in India that decided to set up 'Jail Tourism' ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Maharashtra was the first State to launch 'Jail Tourism', opening historic prisons for students and visitors to learn from the freedom struggle.

questions.text:
Following is the work of Dinabandhu Sahu, honoured by NIRI :
a. A book of 'Farming the Ocean' on sea algae.
b. Production of short film 'Biodiversity of Life' based on Mary Kom.
c. Fellowship and Research in International Society for Energy Environment and Sustainability.
d. Sea farm training based on Project Chilika.
Which of the above sentences is/are incorrect ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option B. Dinabandhu Sahu's sea-algae book, ISEES fellowship and Chilika sea-farm training are credited to him; the Mary Kom biodiversity short film is not — only statement (b) is wrong.

questions.text:
Which of the following are characteristics of GSAT-30 ?
a. Weight – 3357 kg
b. Provides high quality Television, Telecommunication and Broadcast services
c. Equipped with 12C, 12Ku Band Transponder
d. High quality communication satellite
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option D. GSAT-30 weighed about 3357 kg, carried 12 C and 12 Ku-band transponders, and served TV, telecom and broadcast needs as a high-quality communication satellite — all four points hold.

questions.text: Which of the following novels written by Sonali Navangul has won the 'Marathi Sahitya Akademi Award' in 2021 ?
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Sonali Navangul's novel 'Madhyaratrinantarche Taas' won the Marathi Sahitya Akademi Award in 2021.

questions.text:
Winner of the Nobel Prize for Economics (2019), Abhijeet Banerjee's life journey till date is given in points below. Reorder them and choose the correct option.
a. Contributed in preparation of Scheme Nyuntam Aay Yojana (NYAY) for poverty eradication in India.
b. Written a book titled 'Poor Economics'.
c. Received the Infosys Prize.
d. Studied economics at Presidency College, Kolkata.
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Chronology: economics at Presidency College, Kolkata (d) → Infosys Prize (c) → 'Poor Economics' (b) → NYAY scheme work (a).

questions.text: Lionel Messi was selected for which of the following awards in 2021 for the seventh time ?

options.C: World Soccer Player of the Year

questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Lionel Messi won the Ballon d'Or in 2021 — his record seventh time — not the Golden Shoe or FIFA's differently named player awards.

questions.text:
On the eve of 75th Independence day, who was honoured with the peacetime Gallantry Award — 'Ashoka Chakra' ?
a. ASI Babu Ram
b. Police Constable Altaf Hussain
c. Lt. Governor Girish Chandra Murmu
d. Governor of Mizoram, P.S. Shreedharan Pillai
Answer Options :
questions.explanation: The right pick is option D. On the 75th Independence Day peacetime gallantry list, ASI Babu Ram alone received the Ashoka Chakra among the names given — not the other three.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements :
a. Kiwi is India's first certified organic fruit.
b. Arunachal Pradesh is the first State in the country to obtain an organic certification for its Kiwis.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Kiwi is India's first certified organic fruit, and Arunachal Pradesh was the first State to obtain organic certification for its kiwi crop — both statements stand.

questions.text: Under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) (PMAY-U), as on 18th January, 2021 _______ houses have been sanctioned.
questions.explanation: The verified answer here is option D. PMAY-U data as on 18 January 2021 put total sanctioned houses at about 109.2 lakh — the figure the answer key selects.

questions.text: In which year did Avani Chaturvedi, Bhawana Kanth and Mohana Singh create history by becoming the first women pilots to be commissioned into the fighter stream of Indian Air Force ?
questions.explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Avani Chaturvedi, Bhawana Kanth and Mohana Singh were commissioned as the IAF's first women fighter pilots in 2016.

questions.text: Which Space agency has launched the first all-electric experimental aircraft 'X-57 Maxwell' ?
questions.explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. NASA developed and tested the all-electric experimental aircraft X-57 Maxwell — not ISRO, LAPAN or CNES.

questions.text: Which artificial satellite was launched by India on 11th December, 2019 through PSLV – C48 launcher ?
questions.explanation: The right pick is option A. PSLV-C48 on 11 December 2019 placed RISAT-2BR1 into orbit along with nine customer satellites.

questions.text:
Select the right option regarding the Chairperson of 93rd Akhil Bhartiya Marathi Sahitya Sammelan, Senior Literary Author and Thinker, Father Francis Dibrito's life happenings till date.
a. National Award for translation of 'Subodh Bible – Nava Karar' book by Sahitya Academy.
b. Chairperson of 15th Marathi Christi Sahitya Sammelan in Pune.
c. The ordination as a Catholic priest.
d. Chief Editor of newsletter 'Suvarta'.

questions.explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Father Francis Dibrito's timeline runs: ordination as priest (c) → chief editor of 'Suvarta' (d) → chair of the 15th Marathi Christi Sahitya Sammelan, Pune (b) → Sahitya Akademi translation award for 'Subodh Bible – Nava Karar' (a).

title: MPSC अधीनस्थ सेवा गट-ब (अराजपत्रित) संयुक्त पूर्व परीक्षा 2021 (मराठी)

questions.text:
खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
अ. सरपंचावे (ज्याची निवड ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सभासदांकडून झालेली आहे) अथवा उपसरपंचावे, रिक्त (राजीनामामुळे) झालेले पद ते रिक्त झाल्याच्या दिनांका पासून तीस दिवसांच्या आत भरले पाहिजे.
ब. थेट जनतेमार्फत निवडलेल्या सरपंचावे रिक्त झालेले पद ते रिक्त झाल्याच्या दिनांका पासून तीन महिन्यांच्या आत भरले पाहिजे.
क. ग्राम पंचायतीच्या ज्या सदस्याचे पद सतत ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सभेला गैरहजर राहण्याच्या कारणास्तव रिकामे झाले असेल तर तो लगेच पुन्हा निवडून येण्यास पात्र नसतो.
वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Maharashtra Gram Panchayat नियमांनुसार resignation मुळे Sarpanch किंवा Upa-Sarpanch पद रिक्त झाल्यास ते तीस दिवसांत भरावे लागते — विधान (a) बरोबर. थेट निवडलेल्या Sarpanch च्या रिक्त जागेस (b) मधील तीन महिन्यांचा नियम लागत नाही, आणि सलग सभा गैरहजरी (c) प्रमाणे re-election अपात्रता निर्माण करत नाही.

questions.text:
महाराष्ट्र ग्राम पंचायत अधिनियमातील 'ग्राम विकास समित्या' संबंधीच्या तरतुदी बाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
अ. ग्राम विकास समितीतील सदस्यांची एकूण संख्या सातपेक्षा कमी नसेल आणि सतरा पेक्षा जास्त नसेल.
ब. ग्राम विकास समितीतील सदस्यांपैकी एकूतीयांशापेक्षा कमी नसतील इतके सदस्य ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सदस्यांमधील असतील.
क. तिच्या सदस्यांपैकी एक द्वितीयांशापेक्षा कमी नसतील इतके सदस्य महिला असतील.
ड. उप सरपंच हा तिचा पदसिद्ध अध्यक्ष असेल.
ई. ग्रामसेवक हा तिचा पदसिद्ध सदस्य-सचिव असेल.
वरीलपैकी कोणती विधाने योग्य आहेत ?

options.A: फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ड
options.C: फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ई

questions.explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Village Development Committee मध्ये किमान एक-third सदस्य Gram Panchayat मधून, अर्धे महिला, आणि Gram Sevak ex-officio member-secretary — (b), (c), (e). (a) मधील सदस्य संख्येची मर्यादा आणि (d) मध्ये Deputy Sarpanch ला ex-officio chairman करणे कायद्याशी जुळत नाही.

questions.text: 'सरकारिया आयोग' _________ यासाठी अनुकूल होते.
questions.explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. Sarkaria Commission (1983) ने Centre–State relations पाहिले आणि सहकार्य मजबूत करण्याची शिफारस केली — Governor, All India Services किंवा Inter-State Council रद्द करण्याचे ते समर्थन करत नव्हते. तीनही पर्याय अशी रद्दीची मागणी सांगतात जी Commission ने केली नाही.

questions.text: राज्याच्या महाधिवक्त्यासंबंधी खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे ?

options.A: तो राज्याच्या मंत्री परिषदेची इच्छा असेपर्यंत आपल्या पदावर राहू शकतो.
options.B: त्याचे मानधन राज्य विधिमंडळाद्वारे निश्चित केले जाते.
options.C: तो राज्यशासना विरुद्ध असलेल्या खटल्यात खाजगी पक्षकारासाठी वकील म्हणून उभा राहू शकतो.

questions.explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Advocate General Governor च्या pleasure वर पद धरतो (Council of Ministers वर नाही), वेतन Governor ठरवतो (Legislature नाही), आणि तो private party साठी State Government विरुद्ध वकिली करू शकत नाही — म्हणून (A)–(C) पैकी काहीही उभे राहत नाही.

questions.text:
विधान (अ) : संसदीय पद्धतीमध्ये प्रशासनावरील कायदेमंडळाचे नियंत्रण अध्यक्षीय पद्धतीपेक्षा भिन्न असते.
कारण (ब) : प्रशासनावर कायदेमंडळाचे नियंत्रण हे लोकसत्ताक शासनाचे महत्त्वाचे वैशिष्ट्य आहे.

options.A: 'अ' आणि 'ब' दोन्हीही बरोबर आणि 'ब' हे 'अ' चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण आहे.
options.B: 'अ' आणि 'ब' दोन्हीही बरोबर, परंतु 'ब' हे 'अ' चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण नाही.
options.C: 'अ' हे बरोबर आहे, परंतु 'ब' हे चुकीचे आहे.
options.D: 'अ' हे चुकीचे आहे, परंतु 'ब' हे बरोबर आहे.

questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. दोन्ही विधाने खरे: parliamentary व presidential प्रणाली executive वर legislative control वेगळ्या पद्धतीने करतात, आणि लोकशाहीत असे नियंत्रण असते. पण (B) सामान्य लोकशाही तथ्य सांगते — दोन प्रणाली का वेगळ्या आहेत हे स्पष्ट करत नाही, म्हणून (A) चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण नाही.

questions.text:
'अर्थ विधेयका' बाबतीत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
अ. ते मंत्री किंवा खाजगी सदस्य मांडू शकतो.
ब. ते राज्यपालांच्या शिफारशी शिवाय मांडता येत नाही.
क. एखादे विधेयक अर्थ विधेयक आहे किंवा नाही असा प्रश्न उपस्थित झाल्यास राज्यपालांचा अंतिम निर्णय असतो.
ड. जर दोन्ही सभागृहांमध्ये अर्थ विधेयका बाबत पेच निर्माण झाल्यास राज्यपाल विधानसभा आणि विधान परिषदेची संयुक्त बैठक बोलावू शकतात.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. राज्यस्तरावर Money Bill फक्त Governor च्या recommendation वरच सादर होऊ शकते — फक्त (b). Private member सादर करू शकत नाही ((a) चुकीचे), money-bill वाद Speaker ठरवतो Governor नाही ((c) चुकीचे), आणि state money-bill deadlock साठी joint sitting मार्ग नाही ((d) चुकीचे).

questions.text: भारतीय संसदेला राज्यसूचीतील कोणत्याही विषयाबाबत राष्ट्रीय हितासाठी कायदा करण्याचा अधिकार आहे जर तसंबंधी _________ ने ठराव मंजूर केला तर.

options.A: लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या बहुमताने
options.B: लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या दोन-तृतीयांश पेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या बहुमताने
options.C: राज्यसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या बहुमताने
options.D: राज्यसभेने हजर राहून मतदान करणाऱ्या दोन-तृतीयांश सदस्य संख्येपेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या बहुमताने

questions.explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. Article 249 नुसार State List विषयावर Parliament ला कायदा करण्याचा अधिकार Rajya Sabha च्या resolution ने मिळतो — उपस्थित व मतदान करणाऱ्यांच्या किमान दोन-third बहुमताने; Lok Sabha चे साधे बहुमत किंवा Rajya Sabha च्या एकूण सदस्यांपैकी दोन-third नाही.

questions.text:
महाराष्ट्राच्या संदर्भात खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या :
अ. जिल्हा परिषदेची बैठक जेंव्हा आवश्यक असेल तेंव्हा भरविता येईल परंतु मागील बैठक आणि पुढील बैठकीच्या तारखेत एक महि-न्यापेक्षा जास्त अंतर नसावे.
ब. जिल्हा परिषद अध्यक्ष एक-पंचमांश पेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या सदस्यांच्या लेखी विनंतीनुसार विशेष बैठक बोलावू शकतात.
क. प्रत्येक बैठकीचे अध्यक्षस्थान-अध्यक्षाने आणि त्याच्या अनुपस्थिती मध्ये उपाध्यक्षाने भूषविले पाहिजे.
ड. अध्यक्ष आणि उपाध्यक्ष यांच्या अनुपस्थिती मध्ये बैठकीचे अध्यक्षस्थान विषय समितीचा सभापती भूषवील.
वरीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?
questions.explanation: अधिकृत उत्तरतालिकेने हा प्रश्न रद्द केला — फक्त सरावासाठी. उत्तरतालिकेतील उत्तर A (फक्त a, b, c) होते, पण Zilla Parishad सभा अंतराल आणि President व Vice-President दोघे अनुपस्थित असताना कोण अध्यक्षता करतो याबाबत Maharashtra Panchayat Act तरतुदींमध्ये वेगवेगळी वाचना शक्य — stem मध्ये एक स्वच्छ official choice नव्हता, म्हणून MPSC ने रद्द केला.

questions.text: सर्वसाधारणपणे, राज्याच्या उच्च न्यायालयामध्ये मुख्य न्यायाधीश आणि _________ समावेश असतो.
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. Article 216 नुसार प्रत्येक High Court मध्ये Chief Justice आणि President वेळोवेळी आवश्यक समजेल तितके इतर न्यायाधीश — नऊ जणांची निश्चित bench नाही, Governor किंवा Parliament एकट्याने ठरवत नाहीत.

questions.text: राज्यघटना निर्मितीची जबाबदारी व कार्ये पार पाडण्यासाठी घटनासमितीने विविध समित्या स्थापन केल्या होत्या. त्यात कार्यपद्धतीविषयक नियम समितीचे अध्यक्ष म्हणून खालीलपैकी कोणी काम केले ?
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. Dr Rajendra Prasad यांनी Constituent Assembly च्या Rules of Procedure Committee चे अध्यक्षपद सांभाळले. Ambedkar Drafting Committee अध्यक्ष; Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar व K.M. Munshi drafting कामात होते, पण या विशिष्ट committee चे अध्यक्ष नव्हते.

questions.text:
वसाहतवादाचे भारतीयांच्या जीवनावर झालेले परिणामा संबंधीत खालील विचार/विधान कोणी मांडले ?

ब. आर्थिक निःसारणामुळे जगातील सर्वात समृद्ध भारत देशात दरिद्री बनवले आहे.

पर्यायी उत्तरे :

options.A: अ-रमेश चंद्र दत्त, ब-न्यायमूर्ती रानडे, क-सर जॉर्ज ऑक्झेंडन, ड-लोकहितवादी गोपाळ हरि देशमुख

questions.explanation: पर्याय C निवडा. Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh — Indian economy overseas चालवली (a); R.C. Dutt — समृद्ध India गरीब झाली (b); Justice Ranade — exploitation ransom सारखे (c); Sir George Oxenden — स्वतःचा व्यवसाय सांभाळण्यास तलवार (d) — हा संपूर्ण जोड उत्तरतालिकेतील उत्तर.

questions.text: दादाभाई नौरोजीच्या मते, '_________ चे निःसारण होते, परंतु तेच जर भारात गुंतवले असते, तर मोठ्या प्रमाणात आर्थिक विकास पहावयास मिळाला असता.' गाळलेल्या जागा खालीलपैकी योग्य पर्यायाने भरा.
questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय D चिन्हांकित केला. Dadabhai Naoroji च्या 'drain of wealth' सिद्धांतानुसार Britain काढून नेलेले India's potential surplus होते — देशात गुंतवले असते तर पुढील विकासाला चालना मिळाली असती. Handicrafts, currency किंवा cotton output एकटे त्यांचा मुख्य आर्थिक तर्क सांगत नाहीत.

questions.text:

questions.text:
1857 च्या उठावाविषयी खालीलपैकी कोणती विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?

ब. नागपूरच्या भोसले घराण्यातील राणी बाकाबाई यांनी बंडवाल्यांना पाठिंबा दिला.
क. कोल्हापूरच्या छत्रपतीच्या घराण्यातील चिमासाहेब उठावात सामील झाले.
ड. रंगो बापूजी गुप्तेचे चिरंजीव सीतारामपंत व सावंतवाडीचे रामजी शिरसाळ यांनीही उठाव केला.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय C. Maharashtra च्या 1857 कथेत Bhor च्या Pant Sachiv Chimnaji Raghunath ने Rango Bapuji Gupte ला British कडे सुपूर्त केले (a); Kolhapur चे Chhatrapati Chimasaheb revolt मध्ये (c); Sitarampant (Rango चा putra) व Sawantwadi चे Ramji Shirsal सहभागी (d). Nagpur ची Rani Bakabai rebels ला support नव्हते — (b) बाहेर.

questions.text: भारतातील सर्वात लांब राष्ट्रीय महामार्ग _________ आहे.
questions.explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. NH 44 — जुने क्रमांक NH 7 — श्रीनगर ते कन्याकुमारी असून सुमारे 4,000 km ने भारतातील सर्वात लांब राष्ट्रीय महामार्ग आहे. NH 1, NH 48 आणि NH 6 महत्त्वाचे पण या उत्तर–दक्षिण trunk route पेक्षा लहान.

questions.text:

questions.text: सन 1981 ते 2011 या कालावधीतील भारतीय लोकसंख्या वाढ आणि काल सापेक्ष बदल कोणती लोकसंख्या संक्रमण अवस्था दर्शविते ?

options.A: उच्च लोकसंख्या वाढीचा कालावधी, तरीही घटता कल

questions.explanation: परीक्षकाने पर्याय A चिन्हांकित केला. 1981–2011 दरम्यान भारताची लोकसंख्या वाढत राहिली पण वाढ दर मंद होत होता — fertility घटली आणि वक्र high growth with declining trend दर्शवते, rapid acceleration किंवा stagnation नाही.

questions.text: भारतीय मूलभूत रस्ते सांख्यिकी, 2017 नुसार भारतातील कोणते राज्य राष्ट्रीय महामार्गाच्या लांबीमध्ये दुसऱ्या क्रमांकाचे राज्य आहे ?
questions.explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय D. Basic Road Statistics of India (2017) नुसार Uttar Pradesh National Highway लांबीत राज्यांमध्ये दुसऱ्या क्रमांकावर — Maharashtra अनेक वेळा अग्रस्थानी, पण त्या अहवाल वर्षात UP दुसरा.

questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणता प्रदेश भारतातील उच्च भूकंप तीव्रता विभाग दर्शवितो ?
questions.explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. Kashmir ते Assam Himalayan belt India च्या highest seismic-intensity zone मध्ये — young collision tectonics व repeated great earthquakes. Peninsula, central block आणि Ganga plain standard zoning maps वर comparatively lower-intensity.

questions.text:
2011 च्या जनगणनेप्रमाणे महाराष्ट्रातील नागरीकरणाबाबत कोणते/कोणती वाक्य चुकीचे आहे/आहेत ?

पर्यायी उत्तरे :
कोणत्या तत्त्वातून न्यायसंस्थेच्या प्रशासकीय कृतीवरील नियंत्रणाचा उगम होतो ?

Which of the following taxes was collected from Hindu and Muslim landlords respectively during the Sultanate rule?
questions.explanation:
Khiraj (Kharaj): This was a land tax levied primarily on agricultural produce from lands held by non-Muslims, including Hindu landlords. While its rate varied depending on the ruler, it often ranged from one-tenth to as high as half (50%) of the produce.
Zakat: This was a mandatory religious tax realized from Muslims. It was typically calculated as 2.5% of their total property and wealth and was intended for charitable and social welfare purposes, such as helping the poor and needy.

questions.text:

जातो?

क. उच्च रक्तदाबाला हायपरटेंशन म्हणतात तो १६०/१२०ााकस च्या वर जातो तेव्हा त्यास हायपरटेंशन
म्हणतात.

ब. सर्पामध्ये चार कप्पी हृदय असते.

टाकली जाते त्या क्रियेस अंतःश्वसन किंवा पेशीश्वसन असे म्हणतात.

रूपात केली जाते.

आहेत. ज्यात विनॉक्सिश्वसन घडते.

करतात, यामुळे पायात गोळे येतात.

क. तर स्रावणे ही क्रिया DCT या भागात घडते.

द्विमान पद्धती बाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या व योग्य विधान निवडा.
अ. अशा प्रकारची प्रजातीनुसार नावे देण्याची पध्दत कालर् लिनीयस या शास्त्रज्ञाने शोधली.
ब. या पद्धतीमध्ये एखाद्या सजीवाला दोन घटकांनी संबोधले जाते.
क. या पद्धतीमध्ये पहिला शब्द जाती दर्शवितो तर दुसरा शब्द प्रजाती दर्शवितो.
ड. दोन्ही शब्द साधारणतः लॅटिन लिपीत लिहितात.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. सर्व सजीवांना त्यांच्या गुणधर्मानुसार व रचनेनुसार वेगवेगळ्या श्रेणी मध्ये वर्गीकरण केले जाते यालाच
ढरुेपोळल उरींशसेीळशी असे म्हणतात.
ब. ढरुेपोळल ही संज्ञा डी. कॅन्डोले या शास्त्रज्ञांनी दिली.
क. या वर्गीकरणाचा सर्वात लहान किंवा खालचा घटक म्हणजे प्रजाती होय.

वनस्पती वर्गीकरणाची नैसगिर्क गुणांवर आधारीत सर्वात चांगली व लोकप्रिय पध्दत खालील पैकी कोणी
शोधुन काढली?

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. १८८३ साली एचर या शास्त्रज्ञाने वनस्पती सृष्टीचे वर्गीकरण दोन उपसृष्टीत केले ते म्हणजे बीजपत्री
(झहरपशीेसरारश) आणि अबीजपत्री (उीूिीेंसरारश).
ब. त्यापैकी उपसृष्टी बीजपत्री चे आर. एच. व्हिटाकार यांनी तीन विभागात विभाजन केले आहे, ते म्हणजे
टेरीडोफायटा, ब्रायोफायटा, थॅलोफायटा

खालील विधाने वाचून ती विधाने कोणाची वैशिष्ट्ये आहे त्याबाबत योग्य पर्याय निवडा?
अ. यामध्ये प्रामुख्याने शैवाळांचा समावेश होतो. म्हणून यांना शैवाळांचा विभाग म्हणून ओळखले जाते.
ब. या वनस्पतींचे शरीर साधे, मऊ व तंतुरुपी असते.
क. या वनस्पतींमध्ये मूळ खोड पान असे अवयव नसतात.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. हिरवे शैवाळ हे बहुतकरून खाèया पाण्यात आढळतात. १० टक्के हिरवे शैवाळ हे गोड्या
पाण्यात आढळतात.
ब. यांना पृथ्वीवरील वनस्पतींचे पुवर्ज असे म्हटले जाते.
क. स्पायरोगायरा हे हिरव्या शैवाळाचे उदाहरण आहे.

खालीलपैकी कोणती वनस्पती टेरीडोफायटा या संवहनी वर्गातत येत नाही?
अ. फिलीसीनी
ब. मुसी (मॉसेस)
क. लायकोपोडीयम
ड. इक्विसेटिनी

खालील विधाने वाचून त्याबाबत योग्य पर्याय निवडा
अ. यांना खरी मुळे, खोडे, पाने नसतात परंतु मूळासारखे दिसणारे मुलाभ असतात.
ब. हे बहुतकरून भूचर वनस्पती असून त्यांच्यात फलन होण्यासाठी बाह्यपाण्याची गरज असते म्हणून यांना
उभयचर वनस्पती म्हणून ओळखले जाते.
वनस्पतीशास्त्राची माहिती जागतिक परिषद कोठे भरली?

टेरिडोफायटाबाबत खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधान कोणते ते निवडा?
अ. बीजपत्रामधील (झहरपशीेसरारश) सर्वात प्रगत व पृथ्वीवरील सर्वात पहिली संवहती सस्था तसेच खुरी
मुळे पाने व खोड असणाèया वनस्पती होत.
ब. टेरिडोफायटा या सर्व प्रकारच्या अधिवासात वाढू शकतात. जमीन, पाणी, सावली
क. नेचे, इक्वीसॅटम, सिलोटम हे टेरिडोफायटाचे उदाहरण आहे.

थ्रिओफ्रस्टस या शास्त्रज्ञांना कशाचे जनक म्हणून संबोधले जाते?
अ. वनस्पतीशास्त्र
ब. टेरिडोफाईट्स
क. पयार्वरण

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. अझोला ही वनस्पती सर्वात लहान टेरिडोफायटा म्हणून ओळखली जाते.
ब. अल्सोफीला ही वनस्पती सर्वात उंच टेरिडोफायटा म्हणून ओळखली जाते.

खालीलपैकी कोणत्या प्रकारचे फुल हे सपुष्प वनस्पतीमध्ये प्रगतीशिलतेचे प्रतिक मानले जाते?
अ. एकांटे फुल
ब. नियमित प्रकारचे फुल
क. अनियमित प्रकारचे फुल
ड. द्विलिंगी प्रकारचे फुल

अनावृत्तबीजी वनस्पतींबाबत खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधान कोणते ते निवडा?
अ. या वनस्प्तींमध्ये बियांची निर्मिती होते परंतु त्या फळांमध्ये बंदिस्त नसतात.
ब. या वनस्पतींमध्ये नर व मादी फुले वेगवेगळ्या बिजाणू पत्रावर येतात त्यांना शंकू म्हणतात.
क. या वनस्पती सरासरी सदाहरित व बहुवाषिर्क नसतात.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. टॅक्झोडियम म्युक्रोनॅटम ही जगातील सर्वात उंच अनावृत्तबीज वनस्पती आहे. यालाच 'उेीीं ठशवुेेव
ेष उरश्रळषेीपळर' असे म्हणतात, यालाच 'ऋरींहशीेषऋेीशीीं' असेही म्हणतात.
ब. सॅमीया पिग्मी ही जगातील सर्वात लहान अनावृत्तबीज आहे.

लायकेन संदर्भात खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे?
अ. शैवाल आर्द्रता व खनिज घटकांचे शोषण करून कवकास उपलब्ध करून देतात आणि कवक प्रकाश संश्लेषण
करून अन्नाचे शोषण करते.
ब. कवक आर्द्रता व अन्नाचे शोषण करून शैवालास उपलब्ध करून देतात व शैवाल प्रकाश संश्लेषण करून अन्न
तयार करते.
क. त्यांच्यामध्ये फॅकल्टेटीव्ह म्युच्युअॅलीझम असते.

सूर्यफूल ही कोणती वनस्पती आहे
अ. अनावृत्तबीज
ब. एकबीजपत्री
क. नचोद् भिदी (ठशव)
ड. द्विबीजपत्री
आवृत्तबीजी वनस्पती वर्गातमधील सर्वात लहान वनस्पती म्हणजे.......

आवृत्तबीजी वनस्स्पती संबंधी खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणते ते निवडा?
अ. या वनस्सपतीत बीया (बिज) हे फळांमध्ये बंदीस्त असते.
ब. या वनस्पतीत फुल हे प्रजनन अवयव असते व एकाच फुलात नर - मादी असे दोन्ही लैंगिक अवयव असू
शकतात.
क. या वनस्पती सरासरी बहूवाषिर्क असतात.
ड. युकॉलिप्टस ही उंच आवृत्तबीज वनस्पती म्हणून ओळखली जाते.

खालीलपैकी कोणता ग्रुप हा ड्युअल प्लान्ट म्हणून ओळखला जातो?
अ. शैवाळ
ब. कवक
क. लायकेन्स
ड. अॅन्जीओस्पमर्स्

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. एफेंड्रा या वनस्पतीला अनावृत्तबीजी व आवृत्तबीजी या दोहांना जोडणारा दुवा मानले जाते.
ब. एफेंड्रा हा अनावृत्तबीजी असून सुद्धा त्याच्यामध्ये दुहेरी फलन घडते.

अ. शैवाळांची पेशीभित्तिका दोन आवरणांनी बनलेली असते बाहेरुन पेक्टीन आतून सेल्युलोज.
ब. शैवाळांमध्ये क्लोरोफिल -अ, कॅरोटीन व झँथोफिल हे रंगद्रव्य असतात.

questions.text:
खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. रिक्सीया, फ्युनारीया, अॅन्थोसिरॉस या वनस्पती ब्रायोफायटा या विभागात येतात.
ब. कारा, थुलोथ्रीक्स, वॉलवॉक्स, उल्व्हा या वनस्पती थॅलोफायटा या विभागात येतात.
पायकस, सायकस या वनस्पती खालीलपैकी कोणत्या विभागात येतात?
स्पायरोगायरा हे कोणते शैवाळ आहे?

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या.
अ. ज्या मूलद्रव्यांचे अणू इलेक्ट्रॉन गमावून अष्टक स्थिती प्राप्त करतात व घन आयन निर्माण करतात त्यांना धातू
असे म्हणतात.
ब. ज्या मूलद्रव्यांचे अणू इलेक्ट्रॉन कमावल्यामुळे ऋण आयन निर्माण करतात त्यांना अधातू म्हणतात.
क. ज्या मूलद्रव्यांचा गुणधर्मात धातू व अधातू या दोन्हींचे गुणधर्म आढळून येतात त्यांना धातूसदृश म्हणतात.

साधारणतः कक्ष तापमानाला (ठेो ढशाि) धातू हे स्थायू अवस्थेत असतात. खालीलपैकी
कोणते धातू हे कक्ष तापमानाला द्रव अवस्थेत असतात.
अ. पारा
ब. गॅलियम
क. चांदी
ड. ब्रोमीन

ब. तन्यता
क. उष्णता वहन
ड.विद्युत वहन
इ. उच्च द्रवणांक आणि उत्कलणांक

अ. स्थायू
ब. वायू
क. द्रव

खालीलपैकी कोणते मूलद्रव्य धातूसदृश्य आहे?
अ. अॅल्युमिनियम
ब. सिलिकॉन

ड. आर्सेनिक
इ. बोरॉन (इ)

खालील धातू विचारात घ्या. चढत्या घनेतनुसार त्यांची क्रमवारी लिहा.
अ. प्लॅटीनम
ब. सोने

ड. शिसे

खालीलपैकी कोणत्या धातूची साधारणतः पाण्याबरोबर अभिक्रिया अजिबात होत नाही?
अ. सोने
ब. चांदी
क. तांबे
ड. मॅग्नेशियम

खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या.
अ. वातावरणात सोडियम उघडा ठेवला असता त्याचे चटकन सोडियम ऑक्साईड मध्ये रूपांतर होते असे
होऊ नये म्हणून सोडियम कायम पाण्यात ठेवतात.
ब. बहूतेक धातूची ऑक्साईड पाण्यात विरघळत नाहीत परंतु काही धातू - ऑक्साईड पाण्यात विरघळून आम्लारी
तयार करतात.

१) चस अश्र नप ऋश

पाठवितात त्यांना अभिवाही चेता असे म्हणतात.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. मेंदू हा असंवेदनशील अवयव आहे.
ब. मेंदूमधून दर मिनिटाला ७५० मिली ते १००० मिली रक्त वाहते.
क. जेव्हा मानसाचा जन्म होतो तेव्हा जेवढ्या चेतापेशी चेतासंस्थेत असतात तेवढ्यात चेतापेशी आयुष्यभर राहतात.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. चेतापेशी या शरीरातील सर्वात मोठी पेशी आहे.
ब. मेंदू पासून निघणाèया चेतांना कपर्रा चेता असे म्हणतात.
ब. मेरुरज्जू पासून निघणाèया चेतांना मेरुचेता असे म्हणतात. याच्या शरीरात ३१ जोड्या
असतात.

थॅलॅमस हा खालीलपैकी कशाचा मुख्य भाग आहे जो स्पशर्, तापमान, दाब, वेदना यांचे नियंत्रण
करतो?

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. ज्या ग्रंथीना त्यांचे स्राव वाहिन्यासाठी विशिष्ट वाहिन्या असतात व या ग्रंथी आपले स्राव रक्तात सोडत नाही
त्यांना अंतस्त्रसावी ग्रंथी असे म्हणतात.
ब. ज्या ग्रंथी आपले स्राव थेट रक्तात सोडतात त्यांना बाह्यस्रावी ग्रंथी असे म्हणतात.

खालीलपैकी कोणत्या ग्रंथीच्या स्रावांना संप्रेरके (करीोपशी) असे म्हणतात?
अ. अंतस्रावी ग्रंथी
ब. बाह्यस्रावी ग्रंथी

खालीलपैकी कोणत्या ग्रंथी या अंतस्रावी ग्रंथी आहेत?
अ. पियूषिका ग्रंथी
ब. कंठग्रंथी
क. अधिवृक्क ग्रंथी
ड. जठर ग्रंथी
क्षार नियंत्रण हे मानवी शरीरातील महत्त्वाचे कार्य अॅड्रेनल ग्रंथीकडून केले जाते त्या कोठे वसल्या असतात?

पियुषिका ग्रंथी बाबत खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. ही ग्रंथी गळ्यामध्ये कंठा जवळ वसलेली असते.
ब. या ग्रंथीस मास्टर ग्रंथी असे म्हणतात.
क. ही ग्रंथी शरीरातील इतर ग्रंथीवर व त्यांच्या स्रावावर नियंत्रण ठेवते.

खालीलपैकी कोणते संप्रेरके हे पिट्युटरी ग्रंथी मार्फत स्रावले जाते?
अ. ग्रोथ हार्मोन्स
ब. थायरॉइड स्टिम्युलेटिंग हार्मोन्स (ढडक)
क. ल्युटोट्रॉपिक हार्मोन्स
ड. मेलॅनोट्रॉपिक हार्मोन्स (चढक)

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. कंठग्रंथी ही शरीरातील सर्वात लहान अंतस्रावी ग्रंथी आहे.
ब. कंठगं्रथी द्वारे थायरॉक्झीन हे संप्रेरक स्रावले जाते ते शरीराचे चयापचय संप्रेरक असून शरीराचे इचठ नियंत्रित
करते.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. मेंदूमध्ये विशिष्ट प्रकारच्या ताऊ प्रथिनांच्या संचयामुळे हा रोग होतो.
ब. यात स्मृतीभ्रंश, संभ्रमावस्था व वागणुकीमधील अयोग्य बदल इत्यादी लक्षणे प्रामुख्याने पाहावयास मिळतात.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. गलगंडचा थॉयरॉक्सीनच्या प्रमाणाशी थेट संबंध असतो. थॉयरॉक्सीनच्या कमतरतेमुळे गलगंड होतो.
ब. थॉयरॉक्सीनच्या जास्त प्रमाणामुळे थायरोटॉक्सीकोसीस हा रोग होतो.
क. प्रौढांमध्ये थॉयरॉक्झीनची कमतरता झाल्यासा मीग्झीडीमा हा रोग होतो.

शरीरातील खालीलपैकी कोणत्या संप्रेरकांला आपातकालीन संप्रेरक (एाशीसशपलू केीोपी) म्हणून ओळखले
जाते?

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. इरिथ्रोपोएटीन व रेनीन हे दोन संप्रेरके यकृताद्वारे स्रावले जातात.
ब. मेंदूमध्ये वसलेली सर्वात लहान ग्रंथी म्हणज पिनिसल ग्रंथी होय.
क. पिनिअल ग्रंथी मार्फत मेलाटॉनीन संप्रेरक स्रावले जाते ज्यामुळे आपल्याला दिवसरात्र असा फरक जाणवतो.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. बाह्यस्रावी ग्रंथींच्या स्रावांना विकरे असे म्हणतात.
ब. बाह्यस्रावी ग्रंथीची गरज जेथे असते तेथेच त्या वसलेल्या असतात.
क. यकृत ही शरीरातील सर्वात मोठी बाह्यस्रावी ग्रंथी आहे.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. ज्या चेतापेशखी आवेगाचे वहन ज्ञानेंद्रियांकडून म्हणजे संवेदन शिल भागाकडून मेंदू व मेरुरज्जूकडे करतात त्यांना
संवेदी चेतापेशी असे म्हणतात.
ब. ज्या चेतापेशखी आवेगावे वहन मेंदू व मेरुरज्जूकडून स्नायू व ग्रंथीसारख्या प्रेरक अवयवांकडे करतात त्यांना
प्रेरक चेतापेशी असे म्हणतात.
मानवी मेंदूचे सरासरी वजन खालीलपैकी किती?

खालीलपैकी कोणते हार्मोन्स हे पोस्टेरिअर पिट्युटरी ग्रंथी मार्फत स्रावले जातात?
अ. अऊक
ब. ऑक्सीसिन
क. कोहेरिन
ड. ॠढक

मेंदूचा खालीलपैकी कोणता भाग हा फक्त सस्तन प्राण्यामध्येच पाहायला मिळतो, जो श्वसनावर चालू व बंध असा
प्रभाव दाखवू शकतो?

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. कपर्रा चेतांपैकी ५ वी चेता ही सर्वात मोठी (जाडी) चेता आहे.
ब. कपर्रा चेतांच्या १२ जोड्यांपैकी ४ जोड्या या प्रेरक चेतांच्या तर ८ जोड्या या समिश्र चेतांच्या असतात.
क. मेंदूतून निघणारी सर्वात लांब कपर्रा चेता म्हणजे १० वी होय.
खालीलपैकी कोणाला एंडोक्रीनोलॉजीचे जनक असे म्हटले जाते?
शरीरातील खालीलपैकी कोणती ग्रंथी ही अंतस्रावी तसेच बाह्यस्रावी असे दोन्हीही गुणधर्म दाखवते?

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. लिनियस यांनी वनस्पती व प्राणी या दोन सृष्टीमध्ये सजीवांचे वर्गीकरण केले होते.
ब. हॅकेल या शास्त्रज्ञाने वनस्पती, प्राणी व प्रोटीस्टा अशा तीन सृष्टीमध्ये सजीवांचे वर्गीकरण केले.
क. जगातील सर्वात स्विकृत वर्गीकरण म्हणजे पंचसृष्टी वर्गीकरण ही पध्दत १९६९ साली आर.आर.एच. व्हीटाकार
यांनी अस्तित्वात आणली.

खालील विधाने कोणत्या सृष्टीबाबत आहेत ते सांगा?
अ. ही सृष्टी जिवाणूची सृष्टी म्हणून ओळखली जाते.
ब. या सृष्टीमध्ये येणारे सजीव हे आद्रिकेंद्रकी असतात.
क. सर्व सजीव एकपेशीय असतात व पेशीभित्तिका असणारे असतात.

खालील विधाने कशाबाबत आहेत ते सांगा?
अ. हे धाग्यासारखे रुप असणारे जिवणू आहेत.
ब. साधारणतः हे मातीमध्ये विघटक म्हणून काम करतात.
क. यातील बहुतांश जिवाणू अॅन्टीबायोटीक्स तयार करतात.

सृष्टी प्रोस्टीस्टाबाबत खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. ही सृष्टी अमिबासारख्या एकपेशीय सजीवांची आहे.
ब. यात आदिकेंद्रकी सजीव येतात.
क. यात स्वयंपोषी व परपोषी या दोन्ही सजीवांचा समावेश होतो.
झुफ्लॅजेलेट्स, सारकोडाईन्स, स्पोरोझोन, सिलीएट्स हे गट सृष्टी प्रोटीस्टाच्या खालीलपैकी कोणत्या गटात मोडतात?

खालीलपैकी कोणते सजीव हे आदिजीवी (झीेीेूेंर) आहेत?
अ. लेशमेपनीया
ब. प्लाझमोडीयम व्हायव्हॅक्स
क. परामेशियम
ड. एन्टअमिबा कोलाडर्
इ. बुरशी
खालीलपैकी कोणत्या सृष्टीला जगातील पहिले सजीव म्हणून ओळखले जाते?

सृष्टी कवकांबाबत खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. या सृष्टीतील सजीव असंश्लेषी (छेप-सीशशप) दृश्यकेंद्रकी आणि परपोषी आहेत.
ब. हे सजीव पेशी भित्तिका असलेले आहेत ज्यांची पेशीभित्तिका कायटिन या शकर्रेपासून बनलेली असते.

क. पेनिसिलियस हे एक कवक आहे.

विषाणूबाबत खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. विषाणू हे एकपेशीय असतात.
ब. विषाणूंना रोगकारक केंद्रकीय प्रथिन असे म्हटले जाते.
क. विषाणू मध्ये फक्त ऊछअ च असतो म्हणूनच ते स्वतंत्र जगू शकत नाही.

विषाणू हे खालीलपैकी कशाकशावर हल्ला करु शकतात?
अ. वनस्पती
ब. प्राणी
क. जिवाणू
ड. कवक
खालीलपैकी कोणता विषाणू हा जगातील पहिला शोधला गेलेला विषाणू आहे?
खालीलपैकी कोणाला ड्युअल ऑरगॅनिझम म्हणून ओळखले जाते?

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. लायकेनमधील बहुतांश ९५% भाग हा कवक घटक असतो.
ब. लायकेन मध्ये शैवाळ कमी म्हणजे ५% घटक असते.
क. लायकेनमधील शैवाळ हा घटक क्षार व अमायनो आम्लाचे शोषण करतो.
ड. लायकेनमधील कवक हा घटक प्रकाश संश्लेषण करून अन्ननिर्मिती करतो.

अ. लायकेन हे खडकावर सर्वप्रथम वसणारे सजीव आहेत.
ब. लायकेन हे हवा प्रदूषणास खूप संवेदनशील असतात त्यामुळे शहरालगत त्यांची वाढ होऊ शकत नाही.

अ. हा प्राण्यांमधील सर्वात मोठा संघ आहे.
ब. यांचे शरीर खंडीभूत असते.
क. हे एकलिंगी असतात व लैंगिक प्रजनन करतात.

अ. शेपूट आणि पाय असणारा सलॅमँडर हा प्राणी सरिसृप (रेप्टीलिया) या वर्गातत येतो.

अ. समान रचना असणाèया व समान कार्य करणाèया पेशींच्या समूहाला ऊती असे म्हणतात.

अ. स्नायूंचे प्रमुख दोन प्रकार आहेत ते म्हणजे इच्छेप्रमाणे काम करणारे ऐच्छिक स्नायू व नियंत्रण नसणारे अनैच्छिक

खालील विधाने कोणत्या ऊतीबाबत आहे ते सांगा?
अ. या ऊतीमधील पेशी जिवंत व लांबट असतात.
ब. या ऊतीमधील पेशींच्या भिंती सेल्युलोज मुळे जाड होतात.

अ. जलवाहिनी यामध्ये वरच्या दिशेने पाणी व क्षार यांचे वहन होते.

अ. मानवी हाडे ही कॅल्शियम, फॉस्फरस, मॅग्नेशियम इत्यादीची साठवणूक केंद्रे म्हणून काम करतात.

ब. ऊछअ च्या अॅसिडिक गुणधर्मामुळे अल्टमॅन यांनी ऊछअ ला न्यूक्लिक अॅसिड असे म्हटले.
क. १९५३ मध्ये वॅटसन आणि क्रिक यांनी ऊछअ चे डबल हेलिक्स मॉडेल शोधून काढले.

ब. न्युक्लीओसाईड मध्ये पेन्टोस शुगर व नायट्रोजन बेस या फक्त दोन घटकांचा समावेश होतो.

ब. सायटोसिन, थायमिन व युरॅसिल हे सिंगल रिंगचे बनलेले असतात म्हणून याला पायरिमिडीन्स
असे म्हणतात.

१) उ५क१०ज५

३) उ६क१२ज५
४) उ६क१२ज६

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. न्यूक्लिओटाईड मध्ये नायट्रोजन बेस हा १ीीं कार्बनला जोडलेला असतो व त्यांच्या जोडणीला ग्लायकासिडीक
बॉन्ड असे म्हणतात.
ब. न्यूक्लिओटाईडच्या ५ींह कार्बनला फॉस्पेट ग्रुप जोडलेला असतो.
क. ऊछअ हा दुहेरी बंध असल्यामुळे नायट्रोजन बेसेस् एकमेकांना जोडलेले असतात. त्यांच्या एकमेकांच्या जोडणीला
हायड्रोजन बॉन्ड असे म्हणतात.

खालील विधाने लक्षात घ्या व योग्य विधाने कोणती ते निवडा?
अ. नायट्रोजन बेस मधील जोडणी नेहमी ठराविकच असते.
ब. अॅडनाईन हा नायट्रोजन बेस नेहमी सायटोसीन सोबतच जोडलेला असतो.

प्रथिनांच्या निर्मितीत खालीलपैकी कोणत्या ठछअ चे कार्य हे सर्वात महत्त्वाचे ठरते?
१)ा- ठछअ
२)ीं-ठछअ
